verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tithai too samarath jithai koi naeh ||
verses.translation: Where You are, Almighty Lord, there is no one else.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖ ਅਗਨੀ ਉਦਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: othai teree rakh aganee udhar maeh ||
verses.translation: There, in the fire of the mother's womb, You protected us.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sun kai jam ke dhoot nai terai chhadd jaeh ||
verses.translation: Hearing Your Name, the Messenger of Death runs away.

verses.original: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur sabadhee paar paeh ||
verses.translation: The terrifying, treacherous, impassible world-ocean is crossed over, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੇਇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau lagee piaas a(n)mrit sei khaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who feel thirst for You, take in Your Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੋ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh eho pu(n)n gun govi(n)dh gaeh ||
verses.translation: This is the only act of goodness in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhasai no kirapaal sam(h)aale saeh saeh ||
verses.translation: He is Merciful to all; He sustains us with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਹਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: birathaa koi na jai j aavai tudh aaeh ||9||
verses.translation: Those who come to You with love and faith are never turned away empty-handed. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa tis na bujhaih paarabraham naam dheh aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Those whom You bless with the Support of Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, do not know any other.

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar saahibo samarath sach dhaataar ||
verses.translation: Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord and Master, All-powerful True Great Giver:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too nihachal niravair sach sachaa tudh dharabaar ||
verses.translation: You are eternal and unchanging, without vengeance and True; True is the Darbaar of Your Court.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kahan na jaieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Your worth cannot be described; You have no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh chhodd hor j ma(n)ganaa sabh bikhiaa ras chhaar ||
verses.translation: To forsake God, and ask for something else, is all corruption and ashes.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: se sukhe'ee sach saeh se jin sachaa biauhaar ||
verses.translation: They alone find peace, and they are the true kings, whose dealings are true.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa lagee preet prabh naam sahaj sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Those who are in love with God's Name, intuitively enjoy the essence of peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਣਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ik aaraadhe sa(n)tan renaar ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak worships and adores the One Lord; he seeks the dust of the Saints. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadh sookh bisraam nit har kaa keeratan gai ||
verses.translation: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, bliss, peace and rest are obtained.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: avar siaanap chhaadd dheh naanak udharas nai ||2||
verses.translation: Forsake other clever tricks, O Nanak; only through the Name will you be saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਿਣਾਵਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa too aaveh vas bahut ghinaavane ||
verses.translation: No one can bring You under control, by despising the world.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਾਵਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa too aaveh vas bedh paRaavane ||
verses.translation: No one can bring You under control, by studying the Vedas.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naa too aaveh vas teerath naieeaai ||
verses.translation: No one can bring You under control, by bathing at the holy places.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naa too aaveh vas dharatee dhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: No one can bring You under control, by wandering all over the world.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਸਿਆਣਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa too aaveh vas kitai siaanapai ||
verses.translation: No one can bring You under control, by any clever tricks.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa too aaveh vas bahutaa dhaan dhe ||
verses.translation: No one can bring You under control, by giving huge donations to charities.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko terai vas agam agocharaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone is under Your power, O inaccessible, unfathomable Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: too bhagataa kai vas bhagataa taan teraa ||10||
verses.translation: You are under the control of Your devotees; You are the strength of Your devotees. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੈਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape vaidh aap naarain ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the true physician.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਵੈਦ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: eh vaidh jeea kaa dhukh lain ||
verses.translation: These physicians of the world only burden the soul with pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat ras khain ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; it is so delicious to eat.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis man vasai tis ke sabh dhookh miTain ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with this Nectar - all his pains are dispelled. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਉਛਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam uchhalai hukame rahai ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of Lord's Command, they move about; by the Lord's Command, they remain still.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukame dhukh sukh sam kar sahai ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, they endure pain and pleasure alike.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukame naam japai dhin raat ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jis no hovai dhaat ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone does so, who is blessed.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam marai hukame hee jeevai ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, they live.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਵਡਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukame naan(h)aa vaddaa theevai ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, they become tiny, and huge.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: hukame sog harakh aana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, they receive pain, happiness and bliss.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: hukame japai nirodhar gurma(n)t ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, they chant the Guru's Mantra, which always works.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hukame aavan jaan rahaae ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, coming and going in reincarnation cease,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jaa kau bhagatee laae ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when He links them to His devotional worship. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੇਵਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau tis ddaaddee kurabaan j teraa sevadhaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that musician who is Your servant, O Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hau tis ddaaddee balihaar j gaavai gun apaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that musician who sings the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੋੜੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: so ddaaddee dhan dha(n)n jis loRe nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is that musician, for whom the Formless Lord Himself longs.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: so ddaaddee bhaagaTh jis sachaa dhuaar baar ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate is that musician who comes to the gate of the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕਲਾਣੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: oh ddaaddee tudh dhiaai kalaane dhin rainaar ||
verses.translation: That musician meditates on You, Lord, and praises You day and night.

verses.original: ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gai a(n)mirat naam na aavai kadhe haar ||
verses.translation: He begs for the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and will never be defeated.

verses.original: ਕਪੜੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਲਿਵੈ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kapaR bhojan sach rahadhaa livai dhaar ||
verses.translation: His clothes and his food are true, and he enshrines love for the Lord within.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: so ddaaddee gunava(n)t jis no prabh piaar ||11||
verses.translation: Praiseworthy is that musician who loves God. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee amiau ras a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||
verses.translation: The Bani of the Guru's Word is Ambrosial Nectar; its taste is sweet. The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan hiradhai simar har aaTh pahar gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord in your mind, body and heart; twenty-four hours a day, sing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: aupadhes sunahu tum gursikhahu sachaa ihai suaau ||
verses.translation: Listen to these Teachings, O Sikhs of the Guru. This is the true purpose of life.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath safal hoi man meh laih bhaau ||
verses.translation: This priceless human life will be made fruitful; embrace love for the Lord in your mind.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aanadh ghanaa prabh japatiaa dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Celestial peace and absolute bliss come when one meditates on God - suffering is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam japat sukh uoopajai dharageh paieeaai thaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace wells up, and one obtains a place in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai gur pooraa mat dhei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is the Teaching imparted by the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai jap tap sa(n)jamo bhaanai hee kadd lei ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, they practice meditation, austerity and self-discipline; in the Lord's Will, they are released.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai jon bhavaieeaai bhaanai bakhas karei ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, they are made to wander in reincarnation; in the Lord's Will, they are forgiven.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੋਗੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai dhukh sukh bhogeeaai bhaanai karam karei ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, pain and pleasure are experienced; in the Lord's Will, actions are performed.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai miTee saaj kai bhaanai jot dharei ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, clay is fashioned into form; in the Lord's Will, His Light is infused into it.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai bhog bhogaidhaa bhaanai maneh karei ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, enjoyments are enjoyed; in the Lord's Will, these enjoyments are denied.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੇ ਭਾਣੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਪਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai narak surag aautaare bhaanai dharan parei ||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, they are incarnated in heaven and hell; in the Lord's Will, they fall to the ground.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaanai hee jis bhagatee laae naanak virale he ||2||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Will, they are committed to His devotional worship and Praise; O Nanak, how rare are these! ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddiaaiee sache naam kee hau jeevaa sun sune ||
verses.translation: Hearing, hearing of the glorious greatness of the True Name, I live.

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਖਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: pasoo paret agiaan udhaare ik khane ||
verses.translation: Even ignorant beasts and goblins can be saved, in an instant.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain teraa naau sadhaa sadh jaapeeaai ||
verses.translation: Day and night, chant the Name, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa bhukh vikaraal nai terai dhraapeeaai ||
verses.translation: The most horrible thirst and hunger is satisfied through Your Name, O Lord.

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog dhukh va(n)n(j)ai jis naau man vasai ||
verses.translation: Disease, sorrow and pain run away, when the Name dwells within the mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat laal jo gur sabadhee rasai ||
verses.translation: He alone attains his Beloved, who loves the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd bea(n)t udhaaranahaariaa ||
verses.translation: The worlds and solar systems are saved by the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: teree sobhaa tudh sache mere piaariaa ||12||
verses.translation: Your glory is Yours alone, O my Beloved True Lord. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਸੁੰਭੈ ਭੁਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: mitr piaaraa naanak jee mai chhadd gavaiaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bhai bhulee ||
verses.translation: I abandoned and lost my Beloved Friend, O Nanak; I was fooled by the transitory color of the safflower, which fades away.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸਜਣ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਉਦੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹਦੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau sajan kee mai keem na paudhee hau tudh bin add na lahadhee ||1||
verses.translation: I did not know Your value, O my Friend; without You, I am not worth even half a shell. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਸੁ ਵਿਰਾਇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਸਸੁਰਾ ਵਾਦੀ ਜੇਠੋ ਪਉ ਪਉ ਲੂਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sas virain naanak jeeau sasuraa vaadhee jeTho pau pau loohai ||
verses.translation: My mother-in-law is my enemy, O Nanak; my father-in-law is argumentative and my brother-in-law burns me at every step.

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਭਸੁ ਪੁਣੇਦੇ ਵਤਨੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: habhe bhas punedhe vatan jaa mai sajan toohai ||2||
verses.translation: They can all just play in the dust, when You are my Friend, O Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis too vuThaa chit tis dharadh nivaarano ||
verses.translation: You relieve the pains of those, within whose consciousness You dwell, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis too vuThaa chit tis kadhe na haarano ||
verses.translation: Those, within whose consciousness You dwell, never lose.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis miliaa pooraa guroo su sarapar taarano ||
verses.translation: One who meets the Perfect Guru will surely be saved.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis no laae sach tis sach sam(h)aalano ||
verses.translation: One who is attached to Truth, contemplates Truth.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਲਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis aaiaa hath nidhaanu su rahiaa bhaalano ||
verses.translation: One, into whose hands the treasure comes, stops searching.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਇਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jis no iko ra(n)g bhagat so jaanano ||
verses.translation: He alone is known as a devotee, who loves the One Lord.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਚਾਰਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: oh sabhanaa kee ren birahee chaarano ||
verses.translation: He is the dust under the feet of all; he is the lover of the Lord's feet.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਣੋ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sabh tere choj viddaan sabh teraa kaarano ||13||
verses.translation: Everything is Your wonderful play; the whole creation is Yours. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਭ ਵਞਾਈ ਛੋੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਝੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat ni(n)dhaa naanak jee mai habh van(j)aiee chhoRiaa habh kijh tiaagee ||
verses.translation: I have totally discarded praise and slander, O Nanak; I have forsaken and abandoned everything.

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਸਾਕ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਤਉ ਪਲੈ ਤੈਡੈ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: habhe saak kooRaave ddiThe tau palai taiddai laagee ||1||
verses.translation: I have seen that all relationships are false, and so I have grasped hold of the hem of Your robe, Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਹਉ ਫਾਵੀ ਥੀਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਸਾਵਰ ਪੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: firadhee firadhee naanak jeeau hau faavee theeiee bahut dhisaavar pa(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: I wandered and wandered and went crazy, O Nanak, in countless foreign lands and pathways.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਲਧਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa hau sukh sukhaalee sutee jaa gur mil sajan mai ladhaa ||2||
verses.translation: But then, I slept in peace and comfort, when I met the Guru, and found my Friend. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe dhukh sa(n)taap jaa(n) tudhahu bhuleeaai ||
verses.translation: When I forget You, I endure all pains and afflictions.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਲਖ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਘੁਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: je keechan lakh upaav taa(n) kahee na ghuleeaai ||
verses.translation: Making thousands of efforts, they are still not eliminated.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis no visarai naau su niradhan kaa(n)ddeeaai ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Name, is known as a poor person.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੋ ਜੋਨੀ ਹਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis no visarai naau so jonee haa(n)ddeeaai ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Name, wanders in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis khasam na aavai chit tis jam dda(n)dd dhe ||
verses.translation: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is punished by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਸੇ ਗਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis khasam na aavee chit rogee se gane ||
verses.translation: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is judged to be a sick person.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁ ਖਰੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis khasam na aavee chit su kharo aha(n)kaareeaa ||
verses.translation: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is egotistical and proud.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: soiee dhuhelaa jag jin naau visaareeaa ||14||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Name is miserable in this world. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੈਡੀ ਬੰਦਸਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਡਿਠਾ ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: taiddee ba(n)dhas mai koi na ddiThaa too naanak man bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: I have not seen any other like You. You alone are pleasing to Nanak's mind.

verses.original: ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੋਲੇ ਜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghol ghumaiee tis mitr vichole jai mil ka(n)t pachhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to that friend, that mediator, who leads me to recognize my Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਵ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਧਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਦੇ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: paav suhaave jaa(n) tau dhir juladhe sees suhaavaa charanee ||
verses.translation: Beautiful are those feet which walk towards You; beautiful is that head which falls at Your Feet.

verses.original: ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਪਇਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mukh suhaavaa jaa(n) tau jas gaavai jeeau piaa tau saranee ||2||
verses.translation: Beautiful is that mouth which sings Your Praises; beautiful is that soul which seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil naaree satasa(n)g ma(n)gal gaaveeaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Lord's brides, in the True Congregation, I sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kaa hoaa ba(n)dhaan bahuR na dhaaveeaa ||
verses.translation: The home of my heart is now held steady, and I shall not go out wandering again.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਕੂੜਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: binaThee dhuramat dhurat soi kooRaaveeaa ||
verses.translation: Evil-mindedness has been dispelled, along with sin and my bad reputation.

verses.original: ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: seelava(n)t paradhaan ridhai sachaaveeaa ||
verses.translation: I am well-known as being calm and good-natured; my heart is filled with Truth.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕ ਰੀਤਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar ik ik reetaaveeaa ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, the One and only Lord is my way.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਣ ਦਾਸਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: man dharasan kee piaas charan dhaasaaveeaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I am a slave at His feet.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਬਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਜਾਂ ਰਾਵੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sobhaa banee seegaar khasam jaa(n) raaveeaa ||
verses.translation: I am glorified and embellished, when my Lord and Master enjoys me.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਆਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੀਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: mileeaa aai sa(n)jog jaa(n) tis bhaaveeaa ||15||
verses.translation: I meet Him through my blessed destiny, when it is pleasing to His Will. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੈਡੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਥੀਏ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: habh gun taidde naanak jeeau mai koo the'ee mai niragun te kiaa hovai ||
verses.translation: All virtues are Yours, Dear Lord; You bestow them upon us. I am unworthy - what can I achieve, O Nanak?

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚੋਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau jevadd dhaataar na koiee jaachak sadhaa jaachovai ||1||
verses.translation: There is no other Giver as great as You. I am a beggar; I beg from You forever. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਛਿਜੰਦੜੀ ਊਣ ਮਝੂਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਜਣਿ ਜੀਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheh chhija(n)dhaRee uoon majhoonaa gur sajan jeeau dharaiaa ||
verses.translation: My body was wasting away, and I was depressed. The Guru, my Friend, has encouraged and consoled me.

verses.original: ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: habhe sukh suhelaRaa sutaa jitaa jag sabaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: I sleep in total peace and comfort; I have conquered the whole world. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਤਖਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa teraa dharabaar sachaa tudh takhat ||
verses.translation: The Darbaar of Your Court is glorious and great. Your holy throne is True.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਉਰੁ ਛਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: sir saahaa paatisaahu nihachal chaur chhat ||
verses.translation: You are the Emperor over the heads of kings. Your canopy and chauree (fly-brush) are permanent and unchanging.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo bhaavai paarabraham soiee sach niaau ||
verses.translation: That alone is true justice, which is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je bhaavai paarabraham nithaave milai thaau ||
verses.translation: Even the homeless receive a home, when it is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਗਲ ॥
verses.translit: jo keen(h)ee karataar saiee bhalee gal ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator Lord does, is a good thing.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਮਲ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee pachhaataa khasam se dharagaeh mal ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize their Lord and Master, are seated in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sahee teraa furamaan kinai na fereeaai ||
verses.translation: True is Your Command; no one can challenge it.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਐ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: kaaran karan kareem kudharat tereeaai ||16||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, Cause of causes, Your creative power is all-powerful. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਦੜੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: soi suna(n)dhaRee meraa tan man maulaa naam japa(n)dhaRee laalee ||
verses.translation: Hearing of You, my body and mind have blossomed forth; chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am flushed with life.

verses.original: ਪੰਧਿ ਜੁਲੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)dh jula(n)dhaRee meraa a(n)dhar Tha(n)ddaa gur dharasan dhekh nihaalee ||1||
verses.translation: Walking on the Path, I have found cool tranquility deep within; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: haTh ma(n)jhaahoo mai maanak ladhaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the jewel within my heart.

verses.original: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਘਿਧਾ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mul na ghidhaa mai koo satigur dhitaa ||
verses.translation: I was not charged for it; the True Guru gave it to me.

verses.original: ਢੂੰਢ ਵਞਾਈ ਥੀਆ ਥਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddoo(n)dd van(j)aiee theeaa thitaa ||
verses.translation: My search has ended, and I have become stable.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath naanak jitaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have conquered this priceless human life. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai masatak karam hoi so sevaa laagaa ||
verses.translation: One who has such good karma inscribed upon his forehead, is committed to the Lord's service.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis gur mil kamal pragaasiaa so anadhin jaagaa ||
verses.translation: One whose heart lotus blossoms forth upon meeting the Guru, remains awake and aware, night and day.

verses.original: ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: lagaa ra(n)g charanaarabi(n)dh sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: All doubt and fear run away from one who is in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

verses.original: ਆਤਮੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਗੰਜਤ ਪਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: aatam jitaa gurmatee aaga(n)jat paagaa ||
verses.translation: He conquers his soul, following the Guru's Teachings, and attains the Imperishable Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh dhiaaiaa paarabraham so kal meh taagaa ||
verses.translation: He alone keeps up in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, who meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat niramalaa aThasaTh majanaagaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he is immaculate, as if he has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis prabh miliaa aapanaa so purakh sabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a man of good fortune, who has met with God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਵਡ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tis balihaaranai jis evadd bhaagaa ||17||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to such a one, whose destiny is so great! ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pir a(n)dhar taa(n) dhan baahar ||
verses.translation: When the Husband Lord is within the heart, then Maya, the bride, goes outside.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pir baahar taa(n) dhan maahar ||
verses.translation: When one's Husband Lord is outside of oneself, then Maya, the bride, is supreme.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਫੇਰੁ ਫਿਰਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai bahu fer firaahar ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, one wanders all around.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sa(n)g dhikhaiaa jaahar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru shows us that the Lord is with us.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sache sach samaahar ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਹਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਆਹਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aahar sabh karadhaa firai aahar ik na hoi ||
verses.translation: Making all sorts of efforts, they wander around; but they do not make even one effort.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jit aahar jag udharai viralaa boojhai koi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how rare are those who understand the effort which saves the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਹੂ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਰਤਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee hoo vaddaa apaar teraa maratabaa ||
verses.translation: The greatest of the great, infinite is Your dignity.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਨ ਜਾਪਨਿੑ ਕਰਤਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g para(n)g anek na jaapani(h) karatabaa ||
verses.translation: Your colors and hues are so numerous; no one can know Your actions.

verses.original: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeeaa a(n)dhar jeeau sabh kichh jaanalaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Soul within all souls; You alone know everything.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh terai vas teraa ghar bhalaa ||
verses.translation: Everything is under Your control; Your home is beautiful.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਵਧਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: terai ghar aana(n)dh vadhaiee tudh ghar ||
verses.translation: Your home is filled with bliss, which resonates and resounds throughout Your home.

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਜਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: maan mahataa tej aapanaa aap jar ||
verses.translation: Your honor, majesty and glory are Yours alone.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa bharapoor dhisai jat kataa ||
verses.translation: You are overflowing with all powers; wherever we look, there You are.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaasan dhaas tudh aagai binavataa ||18||
verses.translation: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, prays to You alone. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਛਤੜੇ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਪਾਰੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: chhataRe baajaar sohan vich vapaare'e ||
verses.translation: Your streets are covered with canopies; under them, the traders look beautiful.

verses.original: ਵਖਰੁ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਟੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vakhar hik apaar naanak khaTe so dhanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is truly a banker, who buys the infinite commodity. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeeraa hamaraa ko nahee ham kis hoo ke naeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, no one is mine, and I belong to no one.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin ih rachan rachaiaa tis hee maeh samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: I am absorbed in the One, who created this creation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਫਲਿਉ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: safaliau birakh suhaavaRaa har safal a(n)mritaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the most beautiful fruit tree, bearing fruits of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਉਨੑ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਘਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: man lochai un(h) milan kau kiau va(n)n(j)ai ghitaa ||
verses.translation: My mind longs to meet Him; how can I ever find Him?

verses.original: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa oh agam ajitaa ||
verses.translation: He has no color or form; He is inaccessible and unconquerable.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਖੋਲੑੈ ਭਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh piaaraa jeea kaa jo khol(h)ai bhitaa ||
verses.translation: I love Him with all my soul; He opens the door for me.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਸਾੜੀਆ ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa karee tusaaReeaa mai dhasih mitaa ||
verses.translation: I shall serve you forever, if you tell me of my Friend.

verses.original: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kurabaanee va(n)n(j)aa vaaranai bale bal kitaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਦਸਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhasan sa(n)t piaariaa sunahu lai chitaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Saints tell us, to listen with our consciousness.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: jis likhiaa naanak dhaas tis naau a(n)mrit satigur dhitaa ||19||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, O slave Nanak, is blessed with the Ambrosial Name by the True Guru. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baiseh gaeh ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but the thieves have come and now sit among them.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharatee bhaar na biaapiee un kau laahoo laeh ||1||
verses.translation: The earth does not feel their weight; even they profit. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee lai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g kusa(n)gee baisate tab poochhe dharam rai ||2||
verses.translation: When one sits in the company of evil people, then he will be called to account by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee vadd paravaar aap ikaateeaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has the greatest family; He Himself is all alone.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee keemat aap aape hee jaateeaa ||
verses.translation: He alone knows His own worth.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap aap upa(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself, by Himself, created everything.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa keetaa aap aap vara(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: Only He Himself can describe His own creation.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su teraa thaan jithai too vuThaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is Your place, where You dwell, Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੂੰ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su tere bhagat jin(h)ee sach too(n) ddiThaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed are Your devotees, who see You, O True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teree dhiaa salaahe soi tudh ||
verses.translation: He alone praises You, who is blessed by Your Grace.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਧੁ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jis gur bheTe naanak niramal soiee sudh ||20||
verses.translation: One who meets the Guru, O Nanak, is immaculate and sanctified. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa bhoom ra(n)gaavalee ma(n)jh visoolaa baag ||
verses.translation: Fareed, this world is beautiful, but there is a thorny garden within it.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo nar peer nivaajiaa tin(h)aa a(n)ch na laag ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by their spiritual teacher are not even scratched. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: fareedhaa umar suhaavaRee sa(n)g suva(n)naRee dheh ||
verses.translation: Fareed, blessed is the life, with such a beautiful body.

verses.original: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: virale keiee paieeani(h) jin(h)aa piaare neh ||2||
verses.translation: How rare are those who are found to love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam dhiaa dharam jis dheh su paae ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains meditation, austerities, self-discipline, compassion and Dharmic faith, whom the Lord so blesses.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis bujhaieh agan aap so naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, whose fire the Lord puts out.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee agam purakh ik dhirasaT dhikhaae ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Inaccessible Primal Lord, inspires us to look upon all with an impartial eye.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਆਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai aasarai prabh siau ra(n)g laae ||
verses.translation: With the support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one falls in love with God.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aaugan kaT mukh ujalaa har naam taraae ||
verses.translation: One's faults are eradicated, and one's face becomes radiant and bright; through the Lord's Name, one crosses over.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟਿਓਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran bhau kaTion fir jon na paae ||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death is removed, and he is not reincarnated again.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਅਨੁ ਲੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਫੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te kaaddian laR aap faRaae ||
verses.translation: God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit, and attaches him to the hem of His robe.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhas milaian rakhe gal laae ||21||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God forgives him, and holds him close in His embrace. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: muhabat jis khudhai dhee rataa ra(n)g chalool ||
verses.translation: One who loves God is imbued with the deep crimson color of His love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak virale paie'eeh tis jan keem na mool ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a person is rarely found; the value of such a humble person can never be estimated. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਵਿਧਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਡਿਠੋਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar vidhaa sach nai baahar bhee sach ddiThom ||
verses.translation: The True Name has pierced the nucleus of my self deep within. Outside, I see the True Lord as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਭ ਥਾਇ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੋਮਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raviaa habh thai van tiran tirabhavan rom ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He is pervading and permeating all places, the forests and the meadows, the three worlds, and every hair. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋ ਰਚਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape keeto rachan aape hee ratiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the Universe; He Himself imbues it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape hoio ik aape bahu bhatiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is One, and He Himself has numerous forms.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape sabhanaa ma(n)jh aape baaharaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is within all, and He Himself is beyond them.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaaneh dhoor aape hee jaaharaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is known to be far away, and He Himself is right here.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aape hoveh gupat aape paragaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kisai na pai teree thaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: No one can estimate the value of Your Creation, Lord.

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਤੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: gahir ga(n)bheer athaahu apaar aganat too(n) ||
verses.translation: You are deep and profound, unfathomable, infinite and invaluable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨੨॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak varatai ik iko ik too(n) ||22||1||2|| sudh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Lord is all-pervading. You are the One and only. ||22||1||2|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਰਾਇ ਬਲਵੰਡਿ ਤਥਾ ਸਤੈ ਡੂਮਿ ਆਖੀ
verses.translit: raamakalee kee vaar rai balava(n)dd tathaa satai ddoom aakhee
verses.translation: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Uttered By Satta And Balwand The Drummer:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੋਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਖੀਵਦੈ ॥
verses.translit: naau karataa kaadhar kare kiau bol hovai jokheevadhai ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Name of the Almighty Creator - how can his words be judged?

verses.original: ਦੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਭੈਣ ਭਰਾਵ ਹੈ ਪਾਰੰਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਪੜੀਵਦੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhe gunaa sat bhain bharaav hai paara(n)gat dhaan paReevadhai ||
verses.translation: His divine virtues are the true sisters and brothers; through them, the gift of supreme status is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਨੀਵ ਦੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak raaj chalaiaa sach koT sataanee neev dhai ||
verses.translation: Nanak established the kingdom; He built the true fortress on the strongest foundations.

verses.original: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਦੈ ॥
verses.translit: lahane dharion chhat sir kar sifatee a(n)mrit peevadhai ||
verses.translation: He installed the royal canopy over Lehna's head; chanting the Lord's Praises, He drank in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਖੜਗਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਪਰਾਕੁਇ ਜੀਅ ਦੈ ॥
verses.translit: mat gur aatam dhev dhee khaRag jor paraakui jeea dhai ||
verses.translation: The Guru implanted the almighty sword of the Teachings to illuminate his soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਈ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਥੀਵਦੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur chele raharaas keeiee naanak salaamat theevadhai ||
verses.translation: The Guru bowed down to His disciple, while Nanak was still alive.

verses.original: ਸਹਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਦਿਤੋਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: seh Tikaa dhitos jeevadhai ||1||
verses.translation: The King, while still alive, applied the ceremonial mark to his forehead. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਹਣੇ ਦੀ ਫੇਰਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੋਹੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: lahane dhee feraieeaai naanakaa dhohee khaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: Nanak proclaimed Lehna's succession - he earned it.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਓਹਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਹਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਲਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jot ohaa jugat sai seh kaiaa fer palaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: They shared the One Light and the same way; the King just changed His body.

verses.original: ਝੁਲੈ ਸੁ ਛਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jhulai su chhat nira(n)janee mal takhat baiThaa gur haTeeaai ||
verses.translation: The immaculate canopy waves over Him, and He sits on the throne in the Guru's shop.

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲ ਜੋਗੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kareh j gur furamaiaa sil jog aloonee chaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: He does as the Guru commands; He tasted the tasteless stone of Yoga.

verses.original: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)gar chalai gur sabadh har toT na aavee khaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: The Langar - the Kitchen of the Guru's Shabad has been opened, and its supplies never run short.

verses.original: ਖਰਚੇ ਦਿਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਆਪ ਖਹਦੀ ਖੈਰਿ ਦਬਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kharache dhit khasa(n)m dhee aap khahadhee khair dhabaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: Whatever His Master gave, He spent; He distributed it all to be eaten.

verses.original: ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਨੂਰੁ ਅਰਸਹੁ ਕੁਰਸਹੁ ਝਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hovai sifat khasa(n)m dhee noor arasahu kurasahu jhaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: The Praises of the Master were sung, and the Divine Light descended from the heavens to the earth.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: tudh ddiThe sache paatisaeh mal janam janam dhee kaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon You, O True King, the filth of countless past lives is washed away.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਏਦੂ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sach j gur furamaiaa kiau edhoo bolahu haTeeaai ||
verses.translation: The Guru gave the True Command; why should we hesitate to proclaim this?

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਉਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਰਹੁ ਕੰਨੑ ਮੁਰਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: putree kaul na paalio kar peerahu ka(n)n(h) muraTeeaai ||
verses.translation: His sons did not obey His Word; they turned their backs on Him as Guru.

verses.original: ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਆਕੀ ਫਿਰਨਿੑ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਨਿੑ ਛਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhil khoTai aakee firani(h) ba(n)ni(h) bhaar uchaini(h) chhaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: These evil-hearted ones became rebellious; they carry loads of sin on their backs.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jin aakhee soiee kare jin keetee tinai thaTeeaai ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Guru said, Lehna did, and so he was installed on the throne.

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਹਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਉਵਟੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaun haare kin uvaTeeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Who has lost, and who has won? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਵਾਹੇ ਸਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin keetee so ma(n)nanaa ko saal jivaahe saalee ||
verses.translation: He who did the work, is accepted as Guru; so which is better - the thistle or the rice?

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਦਲਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai hai dhevataa lai galaa kare dhalaalee ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma considered the arguments and made the decision.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਹਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur aakhai sachaa kare saa baat hovai dharahaalee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the True Guru says, the True Lord does; it comes to pass instantaneously.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀ ਦੋਹੀ ਫਿਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)gadh dhee dhohee firee sach karatai ba(n)dh bahaalee ||
verses.translation: Guru Angad was proclaimed, and the True Creator confirmed it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੈ ਡਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kaiaa palaT kar mal takhat baiThaa sai ddaalee ||
verses.translation: Nanak merely changed his body; He still sits on the throne, with hundreds of branches reaching out.

verses.original: ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਉਮਤਿ ਖੜੀ ਮਸਕਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਗਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhar seve umat khaRee masakalai hoi ja(n)gaalee ||
verses.translation: Standing at His door, His followers serve Him; by this service, their rust is scraped off.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhar dharaves khasa(n)m dhai nai sachai baanee laalee ||
verses.translation: He is the Dervish - the Saint, at the door of His Lord and Master; He loves the True Name, and the Bani of the Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਬਲਵੰਡ ਖੀਵੀ ਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਛਾਉ ਪਤ੍ਰਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: balava(n)dd kheevee nek jan jis bahutee chhaau patraalee ||
verses.translation: Balwand says that Khivi, the Guru's wife, is a noble woman, who gives soothing, leafy shade to all.

verses.original: ਲੰਗਰਿ ਦਉਲਤਿ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੀਰਿ ਘਿਆਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)gar dhaulat va(n)ddeeaai ras a(n)mrit kheer ghiaalee ||
verses.translation: She distributes the bounty of the Guru's Langar; the kheer - the rice pudding and ghee, is like sweet ambrosia.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਥੀਏ ਪਰਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa ke mukh ujale manmukh the'ee paraalee ||
verses.translation: The faces of the Guru's Sikhs are radiant and bright; the self-willed manmukhs are pale, like straw.

verses.original: ਪਏ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਾਂ ਘਾਲ ਮਰਦੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: pe kabool khasa(n)m naal jaa(n) ghaal maradhee ghaalee ||
verses.translation: The Master gave His approval, when Angad exerted Himself heroically.

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਖੀਵੀ ਸਹੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maataa kheevee sahu soi jin goi uThaalee ||3||
verses.translation: Such is the Husband of mother Khivi; He sustains the world. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿਂਓ ਗੰਗ ਵਹਾਈਐ ਦੁਨਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਕਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hori(n)o ga(n)g vahaieeaai dhuniaaiee aakhai k kion ||
verses.translation: It is as if the Guru made the Ganges flow in the opposite direction, and the world wonders: what has he done?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਸਰਿ ਜਗਨਾਥਿ ਉਚਹਦੀ ਵੈਣੁ ਵਿਰਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ieesar jaganaath uchahadhee vain virikion ||
verses.translation: Nanak, the Lord, the Lord of the World, spoke the words out loud.

verses.original: ਮਾਧਾਣਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿੜਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: maadhaanaa parabat kar netr baasak sabadh riRakion ||
verses.translation: Making the mountain his churning stick, and the snake-king his churning string, He has churned the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਚਿਲਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaudheh ratan nikaalian kar aavaa gaun chilakion ||
verses.translation: From it, He extracted the fourteen jewels, and illuminated the world.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਹਿ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਐਵਡ ਪਿਡ ਠਿਣਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat eh vekhaaleean jin aaivadd pidd Thinakion ||
verses.translation: He revealed such creative power, and touched such greatness.

verses.original: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਿਆੜਾ ਛਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: lahane dharion chhatr sir asamaan kiaaRaa chhikion ||
verses.translation: He raised the royal canopy to wave over the head of Lehna, and raised His glory to the skies.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jot samaanee jot maeh aap aapai setee mikion ||
verses.translation: His Light merged into the Light, and He blended Him into Himself.

verses.original: ਸਿਖਾਂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਘੋਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਜਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sikhaa(n) putraa(n) ghokh kai sabh umat vekhahu j kion ||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak tested His Sikhs and His sons, and everyone saw what happened.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਧੋਸੁ ਤਾਂ ਲਹਣਾ ਟਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) sudhos taa(n) lahanaa Tikion ||4||
verses.translation: When Lehna alone was found to be pure, then He was set on the throne. ||4||

verses.original: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: fer vasaiaa feruaan satigur khaaddoor ||
verses.translation: Then, the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam naal tudh hor much garoor ||
verses.translation: Meditation, austerities and self-discipline rest with You, while the others are filled with excessive pride.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਵਿਣਾਹੇ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab vinaahe maanasaa jiau paanee boor ||
verses.translation: Greed ruins mankind, like the green algae in the water.

verses.original: ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਨੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: varihaai dharageh guroo kee kudharatee noor ||
verses.translation: In the Guru's Court, the Divine Light shines in its creative power.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੂੰ ਓਹੁ ਠਰੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jitu su haath na labhiee too(n) oh Tharoor ||
verses.translation: You are the cooling peace, whose depth cannot be found.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam nidhaan hai tudh vich bharapoor ||
verses.translation: You are overflowing with the nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੰਞੈ ਚੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa teree jo kare so va(n)n(j)ai choor ||
verses.translation: Whoever slanders You will be totally ruined and destroyed.

verses.original: ਨੇੜੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: neRai dhisai maat lok tudh sujhai dhoor ||
verses.translation: People of the world can see only what is near at hand, but You can see far beyond.

verses.original: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: fer vasaiaa feruaan satigur khaaddoor ||5||
verses.translation: Then the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: so Tikaa so baihanaa soiee dheebaan ||
verses.translation: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

verses.original: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: piyoo dhaadhe jevihaa potaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੈ ਘਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਮਧਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin baasak netrai ghatiaa kar nehee taan || jin samu(n)dh viroliaa kar mer madhaan ||
verses.translation: He took the thousand-headed serpent as his churning string, and with the force of devotional love, he churned the ocean of the world with his churning stick, the Sumayr mountain.

verses.original: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaudheh ratan nikaalian keeton chaanaan ||
verses.translation: He extracted the fourteen jewels, and brought forth the Divine Light.

verses.original: ਘੋੜਾ ਕੀਤੋ ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਜਤੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਲਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghoRaa keeto sahaj dhaa jat keeo palaan ||
verses.translation: He made intuition his horse, and chastity his saddle.

verses.original: ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਓ ਸਤ ਦਾ ਜਸ ਹੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhanakh chaRaio sat dhaa jas ha(n)dhaa baan ||
verses.translation: He placed the arrow of the Lord's Praise in the bow of Truth.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੂ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਰੈ ਭਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal vich dhoo a(n)dhaar saa chaRiaa rai bhaan ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there was only pitch darkness. Then, He rose like the sun to illuminate the darkness.

verses.original: ਸਤਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਓ ਸਤਹੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satahu khet jamaio satahu chhaavaan ||
verses.translation: He farms the field of Truth, and spreads out the canopy of Truth.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਰਸੋਈ ਤੇਰੀਐ ਘਿਉ ਮੈਦਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: nit rasoiee tereeaai ghiau maidhaa khaan ||
verses.translation: Your kitchen always has ghee and flour to eat.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਸੁਝੀਓਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa(n) sujheeos man meh sabadh paravaan ||
verses.translation: You understand the four corners of the universe; in your mind, the Word of the Shabad is approved and supreme.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun nivaario kar nadhar neesaan ||
verses.translation: You eliminate the comings and goings of reincarnation, and bestow the insignia of Your Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਅਉਤਰਿਆ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aautariaa aautaar lai so purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: You are the Avataar, the Incarnation of the all-knowing Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਝਖੜਿ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhakhaR vaau na ddoliee parabat meraan ||
verses.translation: You are not pushed or shaken by the storm and the wind; you are like the Sumayr Mountain.

verses.original: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaanai birathaa jeea kee jaanee hoo jaan ||
verses.translation: You know the inner state of the soul; You are the Knower of knowers.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਜਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa saalaahee sache paatisaeh jaa(n) too sughaR sujaan ||
verses.translation: How can I praise You, O True Supreme King, when You are so wise and all-knowing?

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaan j satigur bhaavasee so sate dhaan ||
verses.translation: Those blessings granted by the Pleasure of the True Guru - please bless Satta with those gifts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਦਾ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਮਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ha(n)dhaa chhatr sir umat hairaan ||
verses.translation: Seeing Nanak's canopy waving over Your head, everyone was astonished.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: so Tikaa so baihanaa soiee dheebaan ||
verses.translation: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

verses.original: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: piyoo dhaadhe jevihaa potraa paravaan ||6||
verses.translation: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved. ||6||

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n raamadhaas gur jin siriaa tinai savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pooree hoiee karaamaat aap sirajanahaarai dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: Perfect is Your miracle; the Creator Lord Himself has installed You on the throne.

verses.original: ਸਿਖੀ ਅਤੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sikhee atai sa(n)gatee paarabraham kar namasakaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Sikhs and all the Congregation recognize You as the Supreme Lord God, and bow down to You.

verses.original: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aTal athaahu atol too teraa a(n)t na paaraavaariaa ||
verses.translation: You are unchanging, unfathomable and immeasurable; You have no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee too(n) seviaa bhaau kar se tudh paar utaariaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve You with love - You carry them across.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh kaam karodh moh maar kadde tudh saparavaariaa ||
verses.translation: Greed, envy, sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment - You have beaten them and driven them out.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੈਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su teraa thaan hai sach teraa paisakaariaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is Your place, and True is Your magnificent glory.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak too lahanaa toohai gur amar too veechaariaa ||
verses.translation: You are Nanak, You are Angad, and You are Amar Daas; so do I recognize You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur ddiThaa taa(n) man saadhaariaa ||7||
verses.translation: When I saw the Guru, then my mind was comforted and consoled. ||7||

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chain aape hoaa ||
verses.translation: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.

verses.original: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥੰਮਿੑ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapeen(h)ai aap saajion aape hee tha(n)mi(h) khaloaa ||
verses.translation: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape paTee kalam aap aap likhanahaaraa hoaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the paper, He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the writer.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh umat aavan jaavanee aape hee navaa niroaa ||
verses.translation: All His followers come and go; He alone is fresh and new.

verses.original: ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਵੈ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: takhat baiThaa arajan guroo satigur kaa khivai cha(n)dhoaa ||
verses.translation: Guru Arjun sits on the throne; the royal canopy waves over the True Guru.

verses.original: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੈ ਆਥਵਣਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ ਕੀਅਨੁ ਲੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: augavanahu tai aathavanahu chahu chakee keean loaa ||
verses.translation: From east to west, He illuminates the four directions.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਪਇਆ ਮੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee guroo na sevio manmukhaa piaa moaa ||
verses.translation: Those self-willed manmukhs who do not serve the Guru die in shame.

verses.original: ਦੂਣੀ ਚਉਣੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhoonee chaunee karaamaat sache kaa sachaa ddoaa ||
verses.translation: Your miracles increase two-fold, even four-fold; this is the True Lord's true blessing.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chain aape hoaa ||8||1||
verses.translation: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee baanee bhagataa kee ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ
verses.translit: kabeer jeeau
verses.translation: Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਮੇਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kalaalan laahan melau gur kaa sabadh guR keen re ||
verses.translation: Make your body the vat, and mix in the yeast. Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the molasses.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਸੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa kaam karodh madh matasar kaaT kaaT kas dheen re ||1||
verses.translation: Cut up desire, sexuality, anger, pride and envy, and let them be the fermenting bark. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਦੇਉ ਦਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee hai re sa(n)t sahaj sukh a(n)tar jaa kau jap tap dheau dhalaalee re ||
verses.translation: Is there any Saint, with intuitive peace and poise deep within, unto whom I might offer my meditation and austerities as payment?

verses.original: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜੋ ਮਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek boo(n)dh bhar tan man dhevau jo madh dhei kalaalee re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my body and mind to whoever gives me even a drop of this wine from such a vat. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਵਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhavan chatur dhas bhaaThee keen(h)ee braham agan tan jaaree re ||
verses.translation: I have made the fourteen worlds the furnace, and I have burnt my body with the fire of God.

verses.original: ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਦਕ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਪੋਚਨਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mudhraa madhak sahaj dhun laagee sukhaman pochanahaaree re ||2||
verses.translation: My mudra - my hand-gesture, is the pipe; tuning into the celestial sound current within, the Shushmanaa - the central spinal channel, is my cooling pad. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਗਹਨੈ ਦੇਉ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam rav sas gahanai dheau re ||
verses.translation: Pilgrimages, fasting, vows, purifications, self-discipline, austerities and breath control through the sun and moon channels - all these I pledge.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਿਆਲ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੇਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: surat piaal sudhaa ras a(n)mrit eh mahaa ras peau re ||3||
verses.translation: My focused consciousness is the cup, and the Ambrosial Nectar is the pure juice. I drink in the supreme, sublime essence of this juice. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਰਸ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਤੋ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nijhar dhaar chuaai at niramal ieh ras manooaa raato re ||
verses.translation: The pure stream constantly trickles forth, and my mind is intoxicated by this sublime essence.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮਦ ਛੂਛੇ ਇਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer sagale madh chhoochhe ihai mahaa ras saacho re ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, all other wines are trivial and tasteless; this is the only true, sublime essence. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹੂਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਠੀ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar mahooaa bhau bhaaThee man dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Make spiritual wisdom the molasses, meditation the flowers, and the Fear of God the fire enshrined in your mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਪੀਵੈ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukhaman naaree sahaj samaanee peevai peevanahaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Shushmanaa, the central spinal channel, is intuitively balanced, and the drinker drinks in this wine. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਉਧੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaudhoo meraa man matavaaraa ||
verses.translation: O hermit Yogi, my mind is intoxicated.

verses.original: ਉਨਮਦ ਚਢਾ ਮਦਨ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭਇਆ ਉਜਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aunamadh chaddaa madhan ras chaakhiaa tirabhavan bhiaa ujiaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When that wine rises up, one tastes the sublime essence of this juice, and sees across the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਪੁਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਰਸਾਈ ਭਾਠੀ ਪੀਉ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhui pur jor rasaiee bhaaThee peeau mahaa ras bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Joining the two channels of the breath, I have lit the furnace, and I drink in the supreme, sublime essence.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ਜਲੇਤਾ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh dhui ke'ee jaletaa chhooT giee sa(n)saaree ||2||
verses.translation: I have burnt both sexual desire and anger, and I have been emancipated from the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit satigur te sudh paiee ||
verses.translation: The light of spiritual wisdom enlightens me; meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, I have obtained this understanding.

verses.original: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਚਕਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaas kabeer taas madh maataa uchak na kabahoo jaiee ||3||2||
verses.translation: Slave Kabeer is intoxicated with that wine, which never wears off. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੁ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) mero mer parabat suaamee oT gahee mai teree ||
verses.translation: You are my Sumayr Mountain, O my Lord and Master; I have grasped Your Support.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗਿਰਤੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa tum ddolahu naa ham girate rakh leenee har meree ||1||
verses.translation: You do not shake, and I do not fall. You have preserved my honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਜਬ ਕਬ ਤੁਹੀ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab tab jab kab tuhee tuhee ||
verses.translation: Now and then, here and there, You, only You.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੁਅ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham tua parasaadh sukhee sadh hee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I am forever in peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੋਰੇ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਮਗਹਰ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tore bharose magahar basio mere tan kee tapat bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Relying upon You, I can live even in the cursed place of Magahar; You have put out the fire of my body.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਗਹਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਬਸੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pahile dharasan magahar paio fun kaasee base aaiee ||2||
verses.translation: First, I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan in Magahar; then, I came to dwell at Benares. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਸੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa magahar taisee kaasee ham ekai kar jaanee ||
verses.translation: As is Magahar, so is Benares; I see them as one and the same.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਜਿਉ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਰਤੇ ਫੂਟਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham niradhan jiau ih dhan paiaa marate fooT gumaanee ||3||
verses.translation: I am poor, but I have obtained this wealth of the Lord; the proud are bursting with pride, and die. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਚੁਭਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੂਲਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਢਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: karai gumaan chubheh tis soolaa ko kaaddan kau naahee ||
verses.translation: One who takes pride in himself is stuck with thorns; no one can pull them out.

verses.original: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਚੋਭ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਾਤੇ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰ ਪਚਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ajai su chobh kau bilal bilaate narake ghor pachaahee ||4||
verses.translation: Here, he cries bitterly, and hereafter, he burns in the most hideous hell. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੋਊ ਰਾਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: kavan narak kiaa surag bichaaraa sa(n)tan dhouoo raadhe ||
verses.translation: What is hell, and what is heaven? The Saints reject them both.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਢਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ham kaahoo kee kaan na kaddate apane gur parasaadhe ||5||
verses.translation: I have no obligation to either of them, by the Grace of my Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਚਢੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab tau jai chadde si(n)ghaasan mile hai saari(n)gapaanee ||
verses.translation: Now, I have mounted to the throne of the Lord; I have met the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੬॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam kabeeraa ek bhe hai koi na sakai pachhaanee ||6||3||
verses.translation: The Lord and Kabeer have become one. No one can tell them apart. ||6||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਮਾਨਉ ਦੂਤਾ ਡਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਕੁਟਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa maanau dhootaa ddaanau ieh kuTavaaree meree ||
verses.translation: I honor and obey the Saints, and punish the wicked; this is my duty as God's police officer.

verses.original: ਦਿਵਸ ਰੈਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਉ ਪਲੋਸਉ ਕੇਸ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhivas rain tere paau palosau kes chavar kar feree ||1||
verses.translation: Day and night, I wash Your feet, Lord; I wave my hair as the chauree, to brush away the flies. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕੂਕਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ham kookar tere dharabaar ||
verses.translation: I am a dog at Your Court, Lord.

verses.original: ਭਉਕਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਬਦਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaukeh aagai badhan pasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I open my snout and bark before it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: poorab janam ham tum(h)re sevak ab tau miTiaa na jaiee ||
verses.translation: In my past life, I was Your servant; now, I cannot leave You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tere dhuaarai dhun sahaj kee maathai mere dhagaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The celestial sound current resounds at Your Door. Your insignia is stamped upon my forehead. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਾਗੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਗੇ ਭਗਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaage hoh su ran meh joojheh bin dhaage bhag jaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who are branded with Your brand fight bravely in battle; those without Your brand run away.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਏ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhoo hoi su bhagat pachhaanai har le khajaanai paiee ||3||
verses.translation: One who becomes a Holy person, appreciates the value of devotional worship to the Lord. The Lord places him in His treasury. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਠਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਕੋਠੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: koThare meh koTharee param koThee beechaar ||
verses.translation: In the fortress is the chamber; by contemplative meditation it becomes the supreme chamber.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur dheenee basat kabeer kau levahu basat sam(h)aar ||4||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed Kabeer with the commodity, saying, ""Take this commodity; cherish it and keep it secure.""||4||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰਿ ਦੀਈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ਲੀਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer dheeiee sa(n)saar kau leenee jis masatak bhaag ||
verses.translation: Kabeer gives it to the world, but he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras jin paiaa thir taa kaa sohaag ||5||4||
verses.translation: Permanent is the marriage, of one who receives this ambrosial essence. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh mukh bedh gaitree nikasai so kiau brahaman bisar karai ||
verses.translation: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitri prayer issured forth?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kai pai jagat sabh laagai so kiau pa(n)ddit har na kahai ||1||
verses.translation: The whole world falls at His feet; why don't you chant the Name of that Lord, O Pandit? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਮੑਨ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe mere baam(h)n har na kaheh ||
verses.translation: Why, O my Brahmin, do you not chant the Lord's Name?

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam na boleh paadde dhojak bhareh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you don't chant the Lord's Name, O Pandit, you will only suffer in hell. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapan uooch neech ghar bhojan haThe karam kar udhar bhareh ||
verses.translation: You think that you are high, but you take food from the houses of the lowly; you fill up your belly by forcibly practicing your rituals.

verses.original: ਚਉਦਸ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaudhas amaavas rach rach maa(n)geh kar dheepak lai koop pareh ||2||
verses.translation: On the fourteenth day, and the night of the new moon, you go out begging; even though you hold the lamp in your hands, still, you fall into the pit. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਨਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) brahaman mai kaaseek julahaa muh toh baraabaree kaise kai baneh ||
verses.translation: You are a Brahmin, and I am only a weaver from Benares. How can I compare to you?

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: hamare raam naam keh ubare bedh bharose paa(n)dde ddoob mareh ||3||5||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, I have been saved; relying on the Vedas, O Brahmin, you shall drown and die. ||3||5||

verses.original: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: taravar ek ana(n)t ddaar saakhaa puhap patr ras bhareeaa ||
verses.translation: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves are filled with its juice.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਬਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eeh a(n)mirat kee baaRee hai re tin har poorai kareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: This world is a garden of Ambrosial Nectar. The Perfect Lord created it. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaanee jaanee re raajaa raam kee kahaanee ||
verses.translation: I have come to know the story of my Sovereign Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot raam paragaasaa gurmukh biralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How rare is that Gurmukh who knows, and whose inner being is illumined by the Lord's Light. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਹਪ ਰਸ ਬੀਧਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਲੇ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhavar ek puhap ras beedhaa baareh le ur dhariaa ||
verses.translation: The bumble bee, addicted to the nectar of the twelve-petalled flowers, enshrines it in the heart.

verses.original: ਸੋਰਹ ਮਧੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੇ ਫਰੁ ਫਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: soreh madhe pavan jhakoriaa aakaase far fariaa ||2||
