verses.translation: He holds his breath suspended in the sixteen-petalled sky of the Akaashic Ethers, and beats his wings in esctasy. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj su(n)n ik biravaa upajiaa dharatee jalahar sokhiaa ||
verses.translation: In the profound void of intuitive Samaadhi, the one tree rises up; it soaks up the water of desire from the ground.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer hau taa kaa sevak jin ih biravaa dhekhiaa ||3||6||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I am the servant of those who have seen this celestial tree. ||3||6||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhraa mon dhiaa kar jholee patr kaa karahu beechaar re ||
verses.translation: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be your begging bowl.

verses.original: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਅਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khi(n)thaa ih tan seeaau apanaa naam karau aadhaar re ||1||
verses.translation: Sew this body as your patched coat, and take the Lord's Name as your support. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa jog kamaavahu jogee ||
verses.translation: Practice such Yoga, O Yogi.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam gurmukh bhogee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, enjoy meditation, austerities and self-discipline. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: budh bibhoot chaddaavau apunee si(n)gee surat milaiee ||
verses.translation: Apply the ashes of wisdom to your body; let your horn be your focused consciousness.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar bairaag firau tan nagaree man kee ki(n)guree bajaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Become detached, and wander through the city of your body; play the harp of your mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat lai hiradhai raakhahu rahai niraalam taaRee ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the five tatvas - the five elements, within your heart; let your deep meditative trance be undisturbed.

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾੜੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu dharam dhiaa kar baaRee ||3||7||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: make righteousness and compassion your garden. ||3||7||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kaaj siraje jag bheetar janam kavan fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards have you received in this life?

verses.original: ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhav nidh taran taaran chi(n)taaman ik nimakh na ih man laiaa ||1||
verses.translation: God is the boat to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean; He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires. You have not centered your mind on Him, even for an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh ham aaise aparaadhee ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, I am such a sinner!

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਥਾ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin prabh jeeau pi(n)dd thaa dheeaa tis kee bhaau bhagat nahee saadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God gave me body and soul, but I have not practiced loving devotional worship to Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਅਪਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)dhaa par apabaadh na chhooTai ||
verses.translation: Others' wealth, others' bodies, others' wives, others' slander and others' fights - I have not given them up.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aavaa gavan hot hai fun fun ih parasa(n)g na tooTai ||2||
verses.translation: For the sake of these, coming and going in reincarnation happens over and over again, and this story never ends. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹੋਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਨੑੋ ਮੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ghar kathaa hot har sa(n)tan ik nimakh na keen(h)o mai feraa ||
verses.translation: That house, in which the Saints speak of the Lord - I have not visited it, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਦੂਤ ਮਤਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: la(n)paT chor dhoot matavaare tin sa(n)g sadhaa baseraa ||3||
verses.translation: Drunkards, thieves, and evil-doers - I constantly dwell with them. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਸੰਪੈ ਮੋ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa madh matasar e sa(n)pai mo maahee ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, the wine of Maya, and envy - these are what I collect within myself.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dharam ar gur kee sevaa e supana(n)tar naahee ||4||
verses.translation: Compassion, righteousness, and service to the Guru - these do not visit me, even in my dreams. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਭੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaal dhamodhar bhagat bachhal bhai haaree ||
verses.translation: He is merciful to the meek, compassionate and benevolent, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੀਰ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer bheer jan raakhahu har sevaa karau tum(h)aaree ||5||8||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, please protect Your humble servant from disaster; O Lord, I serve only You. ||5||8||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran hoi mukat dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the door of liberation is found.

verses.original: ਜਾਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaeh baiku(n)Th nahee sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: You shall go to heaven, and not return to this earth.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau kai ghar bajaaveh toor ||
verses.translation: In the home of the Fearless Lord, the celestial trumpets resound.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਜਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anahadh bajeh sadhaa bharapoor ||1||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current will vibrate and resonate forever. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa simaran kar man maeh ||
verses.translation: Practice such meditative remembrance in your mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin simaran mukat kat naeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without this meditative remembrance, liberation will never be found. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਨਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran naahee nanakaar ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, you will meet with no obstruction.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mukat karai utarai bahu bhaar ||
verses.translation: You will be liberated, and the great load will be taken away.

verses.original: ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: namasakaar kar hiradhai maeh ||
verses.translation: Bow in humility within your heart,

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: fir fir teraa aavan naeh ||2||
verses.translation: and you will not have to be reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਕੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran kareh too kel ||
verses.translation: Remember Him in meditation, celebrate and be happy.

verses.original: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: dheepak baa(n)dh dhario bin tel ||
verses.translation: God has placed His lamp deep within you, which burns without any oil.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਅਮਰਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so dheepak amarak sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: That lamp makes the world immortal;

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਢੀਲੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh bikh kaaddeele maar ||3||
verses.translation: it conquers and drives out the poisons of sexual desire and anger. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran teree gat hoi ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain salvation.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so simaran rakh ka(n)Th paroi ||
verses.translation: Wear that meditative remembrance as your necklace.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so simaran kar nahee raakh utaar ||
verses.translation: Practice that meditative remembrance, and never let it go.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee utareh paar ||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, you shall cross over. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran naahee tuh kaan ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be obligated to others.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਤਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhar soveh paTa(n)bar taan ||
verses.translation: You shall sleep in your mansion, in blankets of silk.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sej sukhaalee bigasai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Your soul shall blossom forth in happiness, on this comfortable bed.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤੂ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: so simaran too anadhin peeau ||5||
verses.translation: So drink in this meditative remembrance, night and day. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran teree jai balai ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, your troubles will depart.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਪੋਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran tujh pohai na mai ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, Maya will not bother you.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar har har man gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, and sing His Praises in your mind.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eih simaran satigur te paieeaai ||6||
verses.translation: This meditative remembrance is obtained from the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa simar dhin raat ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, remember Him, day and night,

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat saas giraas ||
verses.translation: while standing up and sitting down, with every breath and morsel of food.

verses.original: ਜਾਗੁ ਸੋਇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: jaag soi simaran ras bhog ||
verses.translation: While awake and asleep, enjoy the essence of this meditative remembrance.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har simaran paieeaai sa(n)jog ||7||
verses.translation: The Lord's meditative remembrance is obtained by good destiny. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simaran naahee tujh bhaar ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be loaded down.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: so simaran raam naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Make this meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name your Support.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer jaa kaa nahee a(n)t ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, He has no limits;

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੮॥੯॥
verses.translit: tis ke aage ta(n)t na ma(n)t ||8||9||
verses.translation: no tantras or mantras can be used against Him. ||8||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raamakalee ghar doojaa baanee kabeer jee kee
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Second House, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬੰਧਚਿ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhach ba(n)dhan paiaa ||
verses.translation: Maya, the Trapper, has sprung her trap.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mukatai gur anal bujhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Liberated One, has put out the fire.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab nakh sikh ih man cheen(h)aa ||
verses.translation: When I came to understand this mind, from the tips of my toes to the crown of my head,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tab a(n)tar majan keen(h)aa ||1||
verses.translation: then I took my cleansing bath, deep within my self. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਵਨਪਤਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਖਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pavanapat unaman rahan kharaa ||
verses.translation: The mind, the master of the breath, abides in the state of supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nahee mrit na janam jaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There is no death, no re-birth, and no aging for me now. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਲਟੀ ਲੇ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਹਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: aulaTee le sakat sahaara(n) ||
verses.translation: Turning away from materialism, I have found intuitive support.

verses.original: ਪੈਸੀਲੇ ਗਗਨ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: paiseele gagan majhaara(n) ||
verses.translation: I have entered into the sky of the mind, and opened the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਭੁਅੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedheeale chakar bhua(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The chakras of the coiled Kundalini energy have been opened,

verses.original: ਭੇਟੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਇ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bheTeeale rai nisa(n)gaa ||2||
verses.translation: and I have met my Sovereign Lord King without fear. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੂਕੀਅਲੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਇਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: chookeeale moh miaasaa ||
verses.translation: My attachment to Maya has been eradicated;

verses.original: ਸਸਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੂਰ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sas keeno soor giraasaa ||
verses.translation: the moon energy has devoured the sun energy.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕੁੰਭਕੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab ku(n)bhak bharipur leenaa ||
verses.translation: When I was focused and merged into the all-pervading Lord,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teh baaje anahadh beenaa ||3||
verses.translation: then the unstruck sound current began to vibrate. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਕਤੈ ਬਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bakatai bak sabadh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Speaker has spoken, and proclaimed the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sunatai sun ma(n)n basaiaa ||
verses.translation: The hearer has heard, and enshrined it in the mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: kar karataa utaras paara(n) ||
verses.translation: Chanting to the Creator, one crosses over.

verses.translit: kahai kabeeraa saara(n) ||4||1||10||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, this is the essence. ||4||1||10||

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui jot saroop ||
verses.translation: The moon and the sun are both the embodiment of light.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jotee a(n)tar braham anoop ||1||
verses.translation: Within their light, is God, the incomparable. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar re giaanee braham beechaar ||
verses.translation: O spiritual teacher, contemplate God.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jotee a(n)tar dhariaa pasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this light is contained the expanse of the created universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹੀਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਕਰਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: heeraa dhekh heere karau aadhes ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the diamond, I humbly salute this diamond.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲੇਖੁ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer nira(n)jan alekh ||2||2||11||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Immaculate Lord is indescribable. ||2||2||11||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬੇਦਾਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਮੁਸੀਅਤ ਹਉ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa huseeaar bedhaar jaagat museeat hau re bhaiee ||
verses.translation: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you are being robbed, O Brother.

verses.original: ਨਿਗਮ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਮੁ ਲੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nigam huseeaar paharooaa dhekhat jam le jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: While the Vedas stand guard watching, the Messenger of Death carries you away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੰੀਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਂਬੁ ਆਂਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਨੰੀਬਾ ਕੇਲਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਝਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: na(n)eeb bhio aa(n)b aa(n)b bhio na(n)eebaa kelaa paakaa jhaar ||
verses.translation: He thinks that the bitter nimm fruit is a mango, and the mango is a bitter nimm. He imagines the ripe banana on the thorny bush.

verses.original: ਨਾਲੀਏਰ ਫਲੁ ਸੇਬਰਿ ਪਾਕਾ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naale'eer fal sebar paakaa moorakh mugadh gavaar ||1||
verses.translation: He thinks that the ripe coconut hangs on the barren simmal tree; what a stupid, idiotic fool he is! ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰਿਓ ਹਸਤੰੀ ਚੁਨਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bhio khaa(n)dd ret meh bikhario hasata(n)ee chunio na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is like sugar, spilled onto the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਮੀਰ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: keh kameer kul jaat paa(n)t taj cheeTee hoi chun khaiee ||2||3||12||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, give up your ancestry, social status and honor; be like the tiny ant - pick up and eat the sugar. ||2||3||12||

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: baanee naamadheau jeeau kee raamakalee ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Raamkalee, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਾਟੀਲੇ ਗੂਡੀ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਧੇ ਭਰਮੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaneele kaagadh kaaTeele gooddee aakaas madhe bharameeale ||
verses.translation: The boy takes paper, cuts it and makes a kite, and flies it in the sky.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਊਆ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch janaa siau baat batuooaa cheetu su ddoree raakheeale ||1||
verses.translation: Talking with his friends, he still keeps his attention on the kite string. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: man raam naamaa bedheeale ||
verses.translation: My mind has been pierced by the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਾਂਡੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise kanik kalaa chit maa(n)ddeeale ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: like the goldsmith, whose attention is held by his work. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਪੁਰੰਦਰੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaieele uoodhak raaj kuaar pura(n)dhare'e ||
verses.translation: The young girl in the city takes a pitcher, and fills it with water.

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਕਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hasat binodh beechaar karatee hai cheetu su gaagar raakheeale ||2||
verses.translation: She laughs, and plays, and talks with her friends, but she keeps her attention focused on the pitcher of water. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਆਰ ਦਸ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਛਾਡੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhar ek dhuaar dhas jaa ke guoo charaavan chhaaddeeale ||
verses.translation: The cow is let loose, out of the mansion of the ten gates, to graze in the field.

verses.original: ਪਾਂਚ ਕੋਸ ਪਰ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਛਰਾ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paa(n)ch kos par guoo charaavat cheetu su bachharaa raakheeale ||3||
verses.translation: It grazes up to five miles away, but keeps its attention focused on its calf. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਾਲਨ ਪਉਢੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naamadheau sunahu tilochan baalak paalan pauddeeale ||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, listen, O Trilochan: the child is laid down in the cradle.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਬਿਰੂਧੀ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar kaaj biroodhee cheetu su baarik raakheeale ||4||1||
verses.translation: Its mother is at work, inside and outside, but she holds her child in her thoughts. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਤਾ ਗੀਤ ਕਬਿਤ ਨ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan saasatr aana(n)taa geet kabit na gaavaugo ||
verses.translation: There are countless Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras; I do not sing their songs and hymns.

verses.original: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵਉਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: akha(n)dd ma(n)ddal nira(n)kaar meh anahadh ben bajaavaugo ||1||
verses.translation: In the imperishable realm of the Formless Lord, I play the flute of the unstruck sound current. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: bairaagee raameh gaavaugo ||
verses.translation: Becoming detached, I sing the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਕੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ateet anaahadh raataa aakul kai ghar jaaugo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the unattached, unstruck Word of the Shabad, I shall go to the home of the Lord, who has no ancestors. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਪਉਨੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਉਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa aaur sukhamanaa paunai ba(n)dh rahaaugo ||
verses.translation: Then, I shall no longer control the breath through the energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa.

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui sam kar raakhau braham jot mil jaaugo ||2||
verses.translation: I look upon both the moon and the sun as the same, and I shall merge in the Light of God. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਉ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਨ ਸਤਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: teerath dhekh na jal meh paisau jeea ja(n)t na sataavaugo ||
verses.translation: I do not go to see sacred shrines of pilgrimage, or bathe in their waters; I do not bother any beings or creatures.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੑਾਉਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath guroo dhikhaae ghaT hee bheetar n(h)aaugo ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage within my own heart, where I now take my cleansing bath. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sahaiee jan kee sobhaa bhalo bhalo na kahaavaugo ||
verses.translation: I do not pay attention to anyone praising me, or calling me good and nice.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਉਗੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naamaa kahai chit har siau raataa su(n)n samaadh samaaugo ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, my consciousness is imbued with the Lord; I am absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai na hotee baap na hotaa karam na hotee kaiaa ||
verses.translation: When there was no mother and no father, no karma and no human body,

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham nahee hote tum nahee hote kavan kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: when I was not and you were not, then who came from where? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam koi na kis hee keraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, no one belongs to anyone else.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: We are like birds perched on a tree. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਪਾਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh na hotaa soor na hotaa paanee pavan milaiaa ||
verses.translation: When there was no moon and no sun, then water and air were blended together.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saasat na hotaa bedh na hotaa karam kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: When there were no Shaastras and no Vedas, then where did karma come from? ||2||

verses.original: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khechar bhoochar tulasee maalaa gur parasaadhee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Control of the breath and positioning of the tongue, focusing at the third eye and wearing malas of tulsi beads, are all obtained through Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: naamaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaiaa ||3||3||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv prays, this is the supreme essence of reality; the True Guru has inspired this realization. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Second House:

verses.original: ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਰੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਪੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: baanaarasee tap karai ulaT teerath marai agan dhahai kaiaa kalap keejai ||
verses.translation: Someone may practice austerities at Benares, or die upside-down at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage, or burn his body in fire, or rejuvenate his body to live almost forever;

verses.original: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋਨਾ ਗਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asumedh jag keejai sonaa garabh dhaan dheejai raam naam sar tuoo na poojai ||1||
verses.translation: he may perform the horse-sacrifice ceremony, or give donations of gold covered over, but none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਨ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd chhodd re paakha(n)ddee man kapaT na keejai ||
verses.translation: O hypocrite, renounce and abandon your hypocrisy; do not practice deception.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nit niteh leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Constantly, continually, chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਉ ਗੋਦਾਵਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਭਿ ਜਉ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਸਹਸ ਗਊ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa jau godhaavar jaieeaai ku(n)bh jau kedhaar n(h)aieeaai gomatee sahas guoo dhaan keejai ||
verses.translation: Someone may go to the Ganges or the Godaavari, or to the Kumbha festival, or bathe at Kaydaar Naat'h, or make donations of thousands of cows at Gomti;

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਜਉ ਹਿਵਾਲੇ ਗਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koT jau teerath karai tan jau hivaale gaarai raam naam sar tuoo na poojai ||2||
verses.translation: he may make millions of pilgrimages to sacred shrines, or freeze his body in the Himalayas; still, none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਗਜ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਨਾਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: as dhaan gaj dhaan sihajaa naaree bhoom dhaan aaiso dhaan nit niteh keejai ||
verses.translation: Someone may give away horses and elephants, or women on their beds, or land; he may give such gifts over and over again.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਜਉ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਪ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aatam jau niramail keejai aap baraabar ka(n)chan dheejai raam naam sar tuoo na poojai ||3||
verses.translation: He may purify his soul, and give away in charity his body weight in gold; none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਜਮਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: maneh na keejai ros jameh na dheejai dhos niramal nirabaan padh cheeni(h) leejai ||
verses.translation: Do not harbor anger in your mind, or blame the Messenger of Death; instead, realize the immaculate state of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਜਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jasarath rai na(n)dh raajaa meraa raam cha(n)dh pranavai naamaa tat ras a(n)mrit peejai ||4||4||
verses.translation: My Sovereign Lord King is Raam Chandra, the Son of the King Dasrat'h; prays Naam Dayv, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raamakalee baanee ravidhaas jee kee
verses.translation: Raamkalee, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਨਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਰਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: paReeaai guneeaai naam sabh suneeaai anabhau bhaau na dharasai ||
verses.translation: They read and reflect upon all the Names of God; they listen, but they do not see the Lord, the embodiment of love and intuition.

verses.original: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਉ ਪਾਰਸਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lohaa ka(n)chan hiran hoi kaise jau paaraseh na parasai ||1||
verses.translation: How can iron be transformed into gold, unless it touches the Philosopher's Stone? ||1||

verses.original: ਦੇਵ ਸੰਸੈ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhev sa(n)sai gaa(n)Th na chhooTai ||
verses.translation: O Divine Lord, the knot of skepticism cannot be untied.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਨ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਲੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa madh matasar in pa(n)chahu mil looTe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, Maya, intoxication and jealousy - these five have combined to plunder the world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਡ ਕਬਿ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਹਮ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham badd kab kuleen ham pa(n)ddit ham jogee sa(n)niaasee ||
verses.translation: I am a great poet, of noble heritage; I am a Pandit, a religious scholar, a Yogi and a Sannyaasi;

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਨੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: giaanee gunee soor ham dhaate ieh budh kabeh na naasee ||2||
verses.translation: I am a spiritual teacher, a warrior and a giver - such thinking never ends. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਉਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahu ravidhaas sabhai nahee samajhas bhool pare jaise baure ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, no one understands; they all run around, deluded like madmen.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh adhaar naam naarain jeevan praan dhan more ||3||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my only Support; He is my life, my breath of life, my wealth. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raamakalee baanee benee jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raamkalee, The Word Of Baynee Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa aaur sukhamanaa teen baseh ik Thaiee ||
verses.translation: The energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa: these three dwell in one place.

verses.original: ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਹ ਪਿਰਾਗੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਥਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: benee sa(n)gam teh piraag man majan kare tithaiee ||1||
verses.translation: This is the true place of confluence of the three sacred rivers: this is where my mind takes its cleansing bath. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu tahaa nira(n)jan raam hai ||
verses.translation: O Saints, the Immaculate Lord dwells there;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur gam cheenai biralaa koi ||
verses.translation: how rare are those who go to the Guru, and understand this.

verses.original: ਤਹਾਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਮਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tahaa(n) nira(n)jan ramieeaa hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The all-pervading immaculate Lord is there. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨੈ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhev sathaanai kiaa neesaanee ||
verses.translation: What is the insignia of the Divine Lord's dwelling?

verses.original: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: teh baaje sabadh anaahadh baanee ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates there.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: teh cha(n)dh na sooraj paun na paanee ||
verses.translation: There is no moon or sun, no air or water there.

verses.original: ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saakhee jaagee gurmukh jaanee ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh becomes aware, and knows the Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਪਜੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aupajai giaan dhuramat chheejai ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom wells up, and evil-mindedness departs;

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras gagana(n)tar bheejai ||
verses.translation: the nucleus of the mind sky is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਏਸੁ ਕਲਾ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: es kalaa jo jaanai bheau ||
verses.translation: One who knows the secret of this device,

verses.original: ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bheTai taas param gurdheau ||3||
verses.translation: meets the Supreme Divine Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਘਾਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhasam dhuaaraa agam apaaraa param purakh kee ghaaTee ||
verses.translation: The Tenth Gate is the home of the inaccessible, infinite Supreme Lord.

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਹਾਟ ਪਰਿ ਆਲਾ ਆਲੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: uoopar haaT haaT par aalaa aale bheetar thaatee ||4||
verses.translation: Above the store is a niche, and within this niche is the commodity. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat rahai su kabahu na sovai ||
verses.translation: One who remains awake, never sleeps.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਤਿਲੋਕ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਪਲੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: teen tilok samaadh palovai ||
verses.translation: The three qualities and the three worlds vanish, in the state of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: beej ma(n)tr lai hiradhai rahai ||
verses.translation: He takes the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, and keeps it in his heart.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਹੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: manooaa ulaT su(n)n meh gahai ||5||
verses.translation: Turning his mind away from the world, he focuses on the cosmic void of the absolute Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਅਲੀਆ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat rahai na aleeaa bhaakhai ||
verses.translation: He remains awake, and he does not lie.

verses.original: ਪਾਚਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: paachau i(n)dhree bas kar raakhai ||
verses.translation: He keeps the five sensory organs under his control.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee saakhee raakhai cheet ||
verses.translation: He cherishes in his consciousness the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man tan arapai kirasan pareet ||6||
verses.translation: He dedicates his mind and body to the Lord's Love. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰ ਪਲਵ ਸਾਖਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar palav saakhaa beechaare ||
verses.translation: He considers his hands to be the leaves and branches of the tree.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa janam na jooaai haare ||
verses.translation: He does not lose his life in the gamble.

verses.original: ਅਸੁਰ ਨਦੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੈ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: asur nadhee kaa ba(n)dhai mool ||
verses.translation: He plugs up the source of the river of evil tendencies.

verses.original: ਪਛਿਮ ਫੇਰਿ ਚੜਾਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pachhim fer chaRaavai soor ||
verses.translation: Turning away from the west, he makes the sun rise in the east.

verses.original: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ajar jarai su nijhar jharai ||
verses.translation: He bears the unbearable, and the drops trickle down within;

verses.original: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jaga(n)naath siau gosaT karai ||7||
verses.translation: then, he speaks with the Lord of the world. ||7||

verses.original: ਚਉਮੁਖ ਦੀਵਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: chaumukh dheevaa jot dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The four-sided lamp illuminates the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਪਲੂ ਅਨਤ ਮੂਲੁ ਬਿਚਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: paloo anat mool bichakaar ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord is at the center of the countless leaves.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa le aape rahai ||
verses.translation: He Himself abides there with all His powers.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਹੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: man maanak ratanaa meh guhai ||8||
verses.translation: He weaves the jewels into the pearl of the mind. ||8||

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਦੁਆਲੈ ਮਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: masatak padham dhuaalai manee ||
verses.translation: The lotus is at the forehead, and the jewels surround it.

verses.original: ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: maeh nira(n)jan tirabhavan dhanee ||
verses.translation: Within it is the Immaculate Lord, the Master of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sabadh niramail baaje ||
verses.translation: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, in their purity, resound and vibrate there.

verses.original: ਢੁਲਕੇ ਚਵਰ ਸੰਖ ਘਨ ਗਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: ddulake chavar sa(n)kh ghan gaaje ||
verses.translation: The chauris - the fly brushes wave, and the conch shells blare like thunder.

verses.original: ਦਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੈਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhal mal dhaitahu gurmukh giaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh tramples the demons underfoot with his spiritual wisdom.

verses.translit: benee jaachai teraa naam ||9||1||
verses.translation: Baynee longs for Your Name, Lord. ||9||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: raag naT naarain mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap ahinis naam hare ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT koT dhokh bahu keene sabh parahar paas dhare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Millions and millions of sins and mistakes, committed through countless lifetimes, shall all be put aside and sent away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਖਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japeh aaraadheh sevak bhai khare ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and worship Him in adoration, and serve Him with love, are genuine.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kilabikh dhokh ge sabh neekar jiau paanee mail hare ||1||
verses.translation: All their sins are erased, just as water washes off the dirt. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khin khin nar naarain gaaveh mukh boleh nar narahare ||
verses.translation: That being, who sings the Lord's Praises each and every instant, chants with his mouth the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhokh asaadh nagar meh ik khin pal dhoor kare ||2||
verses.translation: In a moment, in an instant, the Lord rids him of the five incurable diseases of the body-village. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaaveh har ke bhagat hare ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Lord's Name; they alone are the Lord's devotees.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin kee sa(n)gat dheh prabh jaachau mai mooR mugadh nisatare ||3||
verses.translation: I beg for the Sangat, the Congregation; O God, please bless me with them. I am a fool, and an idiot - please save me! ||3||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa dhaar jagajeevan rakh levahu saran pare ||
verses.translation: Shower me with Your Mercy and Grace, O Life of the World; save me, I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jan tumaree saranaiee har raakhahu laaj hare ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; O Lord, please preserve my honor! ||4||1||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam jap jan raamai naam rale ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servants are blended with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam japio gur bachanee har dhaaree har kirapale ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਜਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲ ਸਲਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har agam agochar suaamee jan jap mil salal salale ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable. Meditating on Him, His humble servant merges with Him, like water with water.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t mil raam ras paiaa ham jan kai bal balale ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His humble servants. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: purakhotam har naam jan gaio sabh dhaaladh dhukh dhalale ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Name of the Supreme, Primal Soul, and all poverty and pain are destroyed.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਪਰਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vich dhehee dhokh asaadh pa(n)ch dhaatoo har ke'ee khin parale ||2||
verses.translation: Within the body are the five evil and uncontrollable passions. The Lord destroys them in an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਸਿ ਕਮਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t man preet lagaiee jiau dhekhai sas kamale ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saint loves the Lord in his mind, like the lotus flower gazing at the moon.

verses.original: ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨੁ ਘਨ ਘਨਿਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਰ ਮੁਰਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aunavai ghan ghan ghanihar garajai man bigasai mor murale ||3||
verses.translation: The clouds hang low, the clouds tremble with thunder, and the mind dances joyfully like the peacock. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮ ਲਾਈ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamarai suaamee loch ham laiee ham jeeveh dhekh har mile ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has placed this yearning within me; I live by seeing and meeting my Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਅਨਦ ਭਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har amal har laae har melahu anadh bhale ||4||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is addicted to the intoxication of the Lord; meeting with the Lord, he finds sublime bliss. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap har har naam sakhe ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har naam dhiaaio ham satigur charan pakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: uootam jaga(n)naath jagadheesur ham paapee saran rakhe ||
verses.translation: The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tum vadd purakh dheen dhukh bha(n)jan har dheeo naam mukhe ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun uooch neech ham gaae gur satigur sa(n)g sakhe ||
verses.translation: I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, my Friend.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇ ਬਸਖੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau cha(n)dhan sa(n)g basai ni(n)m birakhaa gun cha(n)dhan ke basakhe ||2||
verses.translation: Like the bitter nimm tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, I am permeated with the fragrance of sandalwood. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਮਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamare avagan bikhiaa bikhai ke bahu baar baar nimakhe ||
verses.translation: My faults and sins of corruption are countless; over and over again, I commit them.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਨਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਖੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: avaganiaare paathar bhaare har taare sa(n)g janakhe ||3||
verses.translation: I am unworthy, I am a heavy stone sinking down; but the Lord has carried me across, in association with His humble servants. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau tum har raakhahu suaamee sabh tin ke paap kirakhe ||
verses.translation: Those whom You save, Lord - all their sins are destroyed.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਣਖੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke dhiaal prabh suaamee tum dhusaT taare haranakhe ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Merciful God, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, You have carried across even evil villains like Harnaakhash. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap har har raam ra(n)ge ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa karee jagadheesur har dhiaaio jan pag lage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, granted His Grace, then I fell at the feet of the humble, and I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਹਮ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke bhool chook ham ab aae prabh saranage ||
verses.translation: Mistaken and confused for so many past lives, I have now come and entered the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਪਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tum saranaagat pratipaalak suaamee ham raakhahu vadd paapage ||1||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are the Cherisher of those who come to Your Sanctuary. I am such a great sinner - please save me! ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree sa(n)gat har ko ko na udhario prabh ke'ee patit pavage ||
verses.translation: Associating with You, Lord, who would not be saved? Only God sanctifies the sinners.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਛੀਪਾ ਦੁਸਟਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਨਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat chheepaa dhusaTaario prabh raakhee paij janage ||2||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv, the calico printer, was driven out by the evil villains, as he sang Your Glorious Praises; O God, You protected the honor of Your humble servant. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo tumare gun gaaveh suaamee hau bal bal bal tinage ||
verses.translation: Those who sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Lord and Master - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਜਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhavan bhavan pavitr sabh ke'ee jeh dhoor paree jan page ||3||
verses.translation: Those houses and homes are sanctified, upon which the dust of the feet of the humble settles. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: tumare gun prabh keh na sakeh ham tum vadd vadd purakh vaddage ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, God; You are the greatest of the great, O Great Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau dhiaa prabh dhaarahu ham seveh tum jan page ||4||4||
verses.translation: Please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, God; I serve at the feet of Yor humble servants. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap har har naam mane ||
verses.translation: O my mind, believe in and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਗੰਨਾਥਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaga(n)naath kirapaa prabh dhaaree mat gurmat naam bane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God, the Master of the Universe, has showered His Mercy upon me, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect has been molded by the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan har jas har har gaio upadhes guroo gur sune ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, listening to the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਿਵ ਖੇਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਿ ਲੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kilabikh paap naam har kaaTe jiv khet kirasaan lune ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name cuts down all sins, like the farmer cutting down his crops. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree upamaa tum hee prabh jaanahu ham keh na sakeh har gune ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your Praises, God; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaise tum taise prabh tum hee gun jaanahu prabh apune ||2||
verses.translation: You are what You are, God; You alone know Your Glorious Virtues, God. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਖੁਲ ਖੁਲਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa faas ba(n)dh bahu ba(n)dhe har japio khul khulane ||
verses.translation: The mortals are bound by the many bonds of Maya's noose. Meditating on the Lord, the knot is untied,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਖਨੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau jal ku(n)char tadhooaai baa(n)dhio har chetio mokh mukhane ||3||
verses.translation: like the elephant, which was caught in the water by the crococile; it remembered the Lord, and chanted the Lord's Name, and was released. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: suaamee paarabraham paramesar tum khojahu jug jugane ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, throughout the ages, mortals search for You.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਡਨੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: tumaree thaeh paiee nahee paavai jan naanak ke prabh vaddane ||4||5||
verses.translation: Your extent cannot be estimated or known, O Great God of servant Nanak. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man kal keerat har pravane ||
verses.translation: O my mind, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is worthy and commendable.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaal dhiaa prabh dhaaree lag satigur har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Merciful Lord God shows kindness and compassion, then one falls at the feet of the True Guru, and meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁੜਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: har tum vadd agam agochar suaamee sabh dhiaaveh har ruRane ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are great, inaccessible and unfathomable; all meditate on You, O Beautiful Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਵਡ ਕਟਾਖ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin kau tum(h)re vadd kaTaakh hai te gurmukh har simarane ||1||
verses.translation: Those whom You view with Your Great Eye of Grace, meditate on You, Lord, and become Gurmukh. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜੁਗਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih parapa(n)ch keeaa prabh suaamee sabh jagajeevan jugane ||
verses.translation: The expanse of this creation is Your work, O God, my Lord and Master, Life of the entire universe, united with all.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਣੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau salalai salal uTheh bahu laharee mil salalai salal samane ||2||
verses.translation: Countless waves rise up from the water, and then they merge into the water again. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਹ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਹਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh keeaa su tum hee jaanahu ham neh jaanee har gahane ||
verses.translation: You alone, God, know whatever You do. O Lord, I do not know.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਰਿਦ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham baarik kau ridh usatat dhaarahu ham kareh prabhoo simarane ||3||
verses.translation: I am Your child; please enshrine Your Praises within my heart, God, so that I may remember You in meditation. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਲਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum jal nidh har maan sarovar jo sevai sabh falane ||
verses.translation: You are the treasure of water, O Lord, the Maansarovar Lake. Whoever serves You receives all fruitful rewards.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਣੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har har har har baa(n)chhai har dhevahu kar kirapane ||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak longs for the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; bless him, Lord, with Your Mercy. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: naT naarain mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal
verses.translation: Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehla, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: mere man sev safal har ghaal ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the Lord, and receive the fruits of your rewards.

verses.original: ਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: le gur pag ren ravaal ||
verses.translation: Receive the dust of the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਭੰਜਿ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhaalidh bha(n)j dhukh dhaal ||
verses.translation: All poverty will be eliminated, and your pains will disappear.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho ho nadhar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord shall bless you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa girahu har aap savaario har ra(n)g ra(n)g mahal bea(n)t laal laal har laal ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself embellishes His household. The Lord's Mansion of Love is studded with countless jewels, the jewels of the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਈ ਹੈ ਬਸੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aapanee kirapaa karee aap gireh aaio ham har kee gur keeiee hai baseeThee ham har dhekhe bhiee nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has granted His Grace, and He has come into my home.The Guru is my advocate before the Lord. Gazing upon the Lord, I have become blissful, blissful, blissful. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨਦੋ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har aavate kee khabar gur paiee man tan aanadho aana(n)dh bhe har aavate sune mere laal har laal ||
verses.translation: From the Guru, I received news of the Lord's arrival. My mind and body became ecstatic and blissful, hearing of the arrival of the Lord, my Beloved Love, my Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਏ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har har mile bhe galataan haal nihaal nihaal ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has met with the Lord, Har, Har; he is intoxicated, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||1||7||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਵੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: man mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat subhava(n)tee ||
verses.translation: O mind, join the Society of the Saints, and become noble and exalted.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun akath kathaa sukhava(n)tee ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Unspoken Speech of the peace-giving Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kilavikh paap laha(n)tee ||
verses.translation: All sins will be washed away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho ho likhat likha(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meet with the Lord, according to your pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਥਾ ਭਜੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat kalajug vich uootam mat gurmat kathaa bhaja(n)tee ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is lofty and exalted. Following the Guru's Teachings, the intellect dwells on the sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin jan sunee manee hai jin jan tis jan kai hau kurabaana(n)tee ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that person who listens and believes. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har akath kathaa kaa jin ras chaakhiaa tis jan sabh bhookh laha(n)tee ||
verses.translation: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Unspoken Speech of the Lord - all his hunger is satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jan har kathaa sun tirapate jap har har har hova(n)tee ||2||2||8||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak listens to the sermon of the Lord, and is satisfied; chanting the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har, he has become like the Lord. ||2||2||8||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aan sunaavai har kee har gaal ||
verses.translation: If only someone would come and tell me the Lord's sermon.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau hau bal bal baal ||
verses.translation: I would be a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਭਲ ਭਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: so har jan hai bhal bhaal ||
verses.translation: That humble servant of the Lord is the best of the best.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਮੇਲਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho ho mel nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord, you be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਾਲ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa maarag gur sa(n)t bataio gur chaal dhikhaiee har chaal ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Saint, has shown me the Lord's Path. The Guru has shown me the way to walk on the Lord's Path.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kapaT chukaavahu mere gursikhahu nihakapaT kamaavahu har kee har ghaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: Cast out deception from within yourself, O my Gursikhs, and without deception, serve the Lord. You shall be enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਏ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: te gur ke sikh mere har prabh bhaae jinaa har prabh jaanio meraa naal ||
verses.translation: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who realize that my Lord God is with them, are pleasing to my Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau mat har prabh dheenee har dhekh nikaT hadhoor nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||2||3||9||
verses.translation: The Lord God has blessed servant Nanak with understanding; seeing his Lord near at hand, he is enraptured, enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||3||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: raag naT naarain mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam hau kiaa jaanaa kiaa bhaavai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, how can I know what pleases You?

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਸਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man piaas bahut dharasaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Within my mind is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee giaanee soiee jan teraa jis uoopar ruch aavai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is Your humble servant, to whom You have given Your approval.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa karahu jis purakh bidhaate so sadhaa sadhaa tudh dhiaavai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on You forever and ever, O Primal Lord, O Architect of Destiny, unto whom You grant Your Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਜੋਗ ਕਵਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੀ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan jog kavan giaan dhiaanaa kavan gunee reejhaavai ||
verses.translation: What sort of Yoga, what spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what virtues please You?

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: soiee jan soiee nij bhagataa jis uoopar ra(n)g laavai ||2||
verses.translation: He alone is a humble servant, and he alone is God's own devotee, with whom You are in love. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saiee mat saiee budh siaanap jit nimakh na prabh bisaraavai ||
verses.translation: That alone is intelligence, that alone is wisdom and cleverness, which inspires one to never forget God, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g lag eh sukh paio har gun sadh hee gaavai ||3||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have found this peace, singing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਸਟਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhio acharaj mahaa ma(n)gal roop kichh aan nahee dhisaTaavai ||
verses.translation: I have seen the Wondrous Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, and now, I see nothing else at all.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲਾਹਿਓ ਤਹ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਹ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak morachaa gur laahio teh garabh jon keh aavai ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has rubbed sway the rust; now how could I ever enter the womb of reincarnation again? ||4||1||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: naT naarain mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਲਾਹਨੋ ਮੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: aulaahano mai kaahoo na dheeo ||
verses.translation: I don't blame anyone else.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man meeTh tuhaaro keeo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do is sweet to my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਜੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaa maan jaan sukh paiaa sun sun naam tuhaaro jeeo ||
verses.translation: Understanding and obeying Your Order, I have found peace; hearing, listening to Your Name, I live.

verses.original: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa(n) uoohaa har tum hee tum hee ih gur te ma(n)tr dhiraReeo ||1||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, O Lord, You, only You. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਓ ॥
verses.translit: jab te jaan paiee eh baataa tab kusal khem sabh theeo ||
verses.translation: Since I came to realize this, I have been blessed with total peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਬੀਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak paragaasio aan naahee re beeo ||2||1||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this has been revealed to Nanak, and now, there is no other for him at all. ||2||1||2||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bhiee tumaaree dheer ||
verses.translation: Whoever has You for support,

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jam kee traas miTee sukh paiaa nikasee haumai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: has the fear of death removed; peace is found, and the disease of egotism is taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਖੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: tapat bujhaanee a(n)mirat baanee tirapate jiau baarik kheer ||
verses.translation: The fire within is quenched, and one is satisfied through the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani, as the baby is satisfied by milk.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa saajan sa(n)t mere sa(n)t sahaiee beer ||1||
verses.translation: The Saints are my mother, father and friends. The Saints are my help and support, and my brothers. ||1||

verses.original: ਖੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੇ ਹੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: khule bhram bheet mile gopaalaa heerai bedhe heer ||
verses.translation: The doors of doubt are thrown open, and I have met the Lord of the World; God's diamond has pierced the diamond of my mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: bisam bhe naanak jas gaavat Thaakur gunee gaheer ||2||2||3||
verses.translation: Nanak blossoms forth in ecstasy, singing the Lord's Praises; my Lord and Master is the ocean of virtue. ||2||2||3||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa jan aapeh aap udhaario ||
verses.translation: He Himself saves His humble servant.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar jan kai sa(n)g basio man te naeh bisaario ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, He dwells with His humble servant; He never forgets him from His Mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: baran chihan naahee kichh pekhio dhaas kaa kul na bichaario ||
verses.translation: The Lord does not look at his color or form; He does not consider the ancestry of His slave.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naam har dheeo sahaj subhai savaario ||1||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Name, and embellishes him with intuitive ease. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa bikham agan kaa saagar tis te paar utaario ||
verses.translation: The ocean of fire is treacherous and difficult, but he is carried across.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano puneh puneh balihaario ||2||3||4||
verses.translation: Seeing, seeing Him, Nanak blossoms forth, over and over again, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||4||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: har har man meh naam kahio ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within his mind

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT apraadh miTeh khin bheetar taa kaa dhukh na rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - millions of sins are erased in an instant, and pain is relieved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat bhio bairaagee saadhoo sa(n)g lahio ||
verses.translation: Seeking and searching, I have become detached; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaag ek liv laagee har har charan gahio ||1||
verses.translation: Renouncing everything, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord. I grab hold of the feet of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kahat mukat sunate nisataare jo jo saran pio ||
verses.translation: Whoever chants His Name is liberated; whoever listens to it is saved, as is anyone who seeks His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa kahu naanak anadh bhio ||2||4||5||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God the Lord and Master, says Nanak, I am in ecstasy! ||2||4||5||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal sa(n)g laagee ddoree ||
verses.translation: The string of my love is tied to Your Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar kar param gat moree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, ocean of peace, please bless me with the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਚਲਾ ਗਹਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬੀਧੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)chalaa gahaio jan apune kau man beedho prem kee khoree ||
verses.translation: He has inspired His humble servant to grasp the hem of His robe; his mind is pierced through with the intoxication of divine love.

verses.original: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jas gaavat bhagat ras upajio maiaa kee jaalee toree ||1||
verses.translation: Singing His Praises, love wells up within the devotee, and the trap of Maya is broken. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh aan na pekhau horee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; I do not see any other at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak mel leeo dhaas apunaa preet na kabahoo thoree ||2||5||6||
verses.translation: He has united slave Nanak with Himself; His Love never diminishes. ||2||5||6||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap jap har naarain ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant, and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kabahoo na bisarahu man mere te aaTh pahar gun gain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I shall never forget Him from my mind; twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo dhoor karau nit majan sabh kilabikh paap gavain ||
verses.translation: I take my daily cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy, and I am rid of all my sins.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh ghaT ghaT dhisaT samain ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; He is seen to be contained in each and every heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: jaap taap koT lakh poojaa har simaran tul na lain ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands and millions of meditations, austerities and worships are not equal to remembering the Lord in meditation.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੭॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR naanak dhaan maa(n)gai tere dhaasan dhaas dhasain ||2||6||7||
verses.translation: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of Your slaves. ||2||6||7||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: merai sarabas naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is everything for me.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g milio satigur dheeno dhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He has led me to join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the True Guru has granted this gift. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ਗਾਉ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa dhukh bha(n)janahaaraa gaau keeratan pooran giaan ||
verses.translation: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord, the Giver of peace, the Destroyer of pain; He shall bless you with perfect spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh kha(n)dd kha(n)dd keen(h)e binasio mooR abhimaan ||1||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and greed shall be shattered and destroyed, and your foolish ego will be dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant? O God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੮॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saran sukh saagar naanak sadh kurabaan ||2||7||8||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord, ocean of peace; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||7||8||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaar vaar jaau gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh niragun tum pooran dhaate dheenaa naath dhiaal ||1||
verses.translation: I am unworthy; You are the Perfect Giver. You are the Merciful Master of the meek. ||1||

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat jeea praan dhan maal ||2||
verses.translation: While standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, You are my soul, my breath of life, my wealth and property. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥੮॥੯॥
verses.translit: dharasan piaas bahut man merai naanak dharas nihaal ||3||8||9||
verses.translation: Within my mind there is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. Nanak is enraptured with Your Glance of Grace. ||3||8||9||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: naT paRataal mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Nat Partaal, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kouoo hai mero saajan meet ||
verses.translation: Is there any friend or companion of mine,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har naam sunaavai neet ||
verses.translation: who will constantly share the Lord's Name with me?

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: binasai dhukh bipareet ||
verses.translation: Will he rid me of my pains and evil tendencies?

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh arapau man tan cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I would surrender my mind, body, consciousness and everything. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: koiee viralaa aapan keet ||
verses.translation: How rare is that one whom the Lord makes His own,

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g charan kamal man seet ||
verses.translation: and whose mind is sewn into the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa har jas dheet ||1||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Praise. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaj janam padhaarath jeet ||
verses.translation: Vibrating, meditating on the Lord, he is victorious in this precious human life,

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: koT patit hoh puneet ||
verses.translation: and millions of sinners are sanctified.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas bal bal keet ||2||1||10||19||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||10||19||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: naT asaTapadheeaa mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Nat Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam mere man tan naam adhaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal reh na sakau bin sevaa mai gurmat naam sam(h)aare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har har man dhiaavahu mai har har naam piaare ||
