verses.translation: Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal bhe prabh Thaakur gur kai sabadh savaare ||1||
verses.translation: When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: madhasoodhan jagajeevan maadho mere Thaakur agam apaare ||
verses.translation: Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessible and infinite:

verses.original: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eik binau benatee karau gur aagai mai saadhoo charan pakhaare ||2||
verses.translation: I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sahas netr netr hai prabh kau prabh eko purakh niraare ||
verses.translation: The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahas moorat eko prabh Thaakur prabh eko gurmat taare ||3||
verses.translation: The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam dhamodhar paiaa har har naam ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਗਟਕ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa banee at meeThee jiau goo(n)gaa gaTak sam(h)aare ||4||
verses.translation: The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste its sweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦ ਚਖੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa saadh chakhai bhai dhoojai at feeke lobh bikaare ||
verses.translation: The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਭ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh saadh chakheh raam naamaa sabh an ras saadh bisaare ||5||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors are forgotten. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat raam naam dhan paiaa sun kahatiaa paap nivaare ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name; hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dharam rai jam neR na aavai mere Thaakur ke jan piaare ||6||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approach the beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas saas hai jete mai gurmat naam sam(h)aare ||
verses.translation: With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.

verses.original: ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: saas saas jai naamai bin so birathaa saas bikaare ||7||
verses.translation: Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is useless and corrupt. ||7||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar dheen prabh saranee mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
verses.translation: Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaasan dhaas kahat hai ham dhaasan ke panihaare ||8||1||
verses.translation: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, says, I am the water-carrier of Your slaves. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam ham paathar niraguneeaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I am an unworthy stone.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar guroo milaae ham paahan sabadh gur taare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord, in His Mercy, has led me to meet the Guru; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this stone is carried across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੈਲਾਗਰੁ ਮਲਗਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur naam dhiraRaae at meeThaa mailaagar malagaare ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted within me the exceedingly sweet Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is like the most fragrant sandalwood.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਹੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਮੁਸਕ ਗੰਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naamai surat vajee hai dheh dhis har musakee musak ga(n)dhaare ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Name, my awareness extends in the ten directions; the fragrance of the fragrant Lord permeates the air. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teree niragun kathaa kathaa hai meeThee gur neeke bachan samaare ||
verses.translation: Your unlimited sermon is the most sweet sermon; I contemplate the most Sublime Word of the Guru.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gaavat gaavat har gun gaae gun gaavat gur nisataare ||2||
verses.translation: Singing, singing, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; singing His Glorious Praises, the Guru saves me. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bibek guroo guroo samadharasee tis mileeaai sa(n)k utaare ||
verses.translation: The Guru is wise and clear; the Guru looks upon all alike. Meeting with Him, doubt and skepticism are removed.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai param padh paiaa hau satigur kai balihaare ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਜਗਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd paakha(n)dd kar kar bharame lobh paakha(n)dd jag buriaare ||
verses.translation: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed and hypocrisy are evils in this world.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: halat palat dhukhadhaiee hoveh jamakaal khaRaa sir maare ||4||
verses.translation: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers over their heads, and strikes them down. ||4||

verses.original: ਉਗਵੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: augavai dhinas aal jaal sam(h)aalai bikh maiaa ke bisathaare ||
verses.translation: At the break of day, they take care of their affairs, and the poisonous entanglements of Maya.

verses.original: ਆਈ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aaiee rain bhiaa supana(n)tar bikh supanai bhee dhukh saare ||5||
verses.translation: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਲਰੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੇ ਖਲਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kalar khet lai kooR jamaiaa sabh kooRai ke khalavaare ||
verses.translation: Taking a barren field, they plant falsehood; they shall harvest only falsehood.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saakat nar sabh bhookh bhukhaane dhar Thaadde jam ja(n)dhaare ||6||
verses.translation: The materialistic people shall all remain hungry; the brutal Messenger of Death stands waiting at their door. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karaj chaRiaa bikh bhaaree utarai sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh has accumulated a tremendous load of debt in sin; only by contemplating the Word of the Shabad, can this debt be paid off.

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਕਰਜ ਕਰਜ ਕੇ ਮੰਗੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jitane karaj karaj ke ma(n)ge'ee kar sevak pag lag vaare ||7||
verses.translation: As much debt and as many creditors as there are, the Lord makes them into servants, who fall at his feet. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਕਿ ਖੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਨਥਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaga(n)naath sabh ja(n)tr upaae nak kheenee sabh nathahaare ||
verses.translation: All the beings which the Lord of the Universe created - He puts the rings through their noses, and leads them all along.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਵ ਚਲੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh khi(n)chai tiv chaleeaai jiau bhaavai raam piaare ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as God drives us on, so do we follow; it is all the Will of the Beloved Lord. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam har a(n)mirat sar naavaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur giaan majan hai neeko mil kalamal paap utaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is the most excellent cleansing bath; bathing in it, all the filthy sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਪੜਿ ਸੂਆ ਗਨਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat kaa gun bahut adhikaiee paR sooaa ganak udhaare ||
verses.translation: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even the prostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਪਰਸ ਨਪਰਸ ਭਏ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਕਉ ਲੈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paras naparas bhe kubijaa kau lai baiku(n)Th sidhaare ||1||
verses.translation: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she was transported to the heavens. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬੋਲਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ajaamal preet putr prat keenee kar naarain bolaare ||
verses.translation: Ajaamal loved his son Naaraayan, and called out his name.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur kai man bhai bhaavanee jamaka(n)kar maar bidhaare ||2||
verses.translation: His loving devotion pleased my Lord and Master, who struck down and drove off the Messengers of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਥਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maanukh kathai kath lok sunaavai jo bolai so na beechaare ||
verses.translation: The mortal speaks and by speaking, makes the people listen; but he does not reflect upon what he himself says.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦਿੜਤਾ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat milai ta dhiRataa aavai har raam naam nisataare ||3||
verses.translation: But when he joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, he is confirmed in his faith, and he is saved by the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਤਬ ਲਗਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag jeeau pi(n)dd hai saabat tab lag kichh na samaare ||
verses.translation: As long as his soul and body are healthy and strong, he does not remember the Lord at all.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਕਢੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jab ghar ma(n)dhar aag lagaanee kadd koop kaddai panihaare ||4||
verses.translation: But when his home and mansion catch fire, then, he wants to dig the well to draw water. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat siau man mel na kareeahu jin har har naam bisaare ||
verses.translation: O mind, do not join with the faithless cynic, who has forgotten the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਛੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਸੀਐ ਤਜਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saakat bachan bichhooaa jiau ddaseeaai taj saakat parai paraare ||5||
verses.translation: The word of the faithless cynic stings like a scorpion; leave the faithless cynic far, far behind. ||5||

verses.original: ਲਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: lag lag preet bahu preet lagaiee lag saadhoo sa(n)g savaare ||
verses.translation: Fall in love, fall deeply in love with the Lord; clinging to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you will be exalted and embellished.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur ke bachan sat sat kar maane mere Thaakur bahut piaare ||6||
verses.translation: Those who accept the Word of the Guru as True, totally True, are very dear to my Lord and Master. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਪਰਚੂਨ ਕਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: poorab janam parachoon kamaae har har har naam piaare ||
verses.translation: Because of actions committed in past lives, one comes to love the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh a(n)mirat ras paiaa ras gaavai ras veechaare ||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the ambrosial essence; sing of this essence, and reflect upon this essence. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har roop ra(n)g sabh tere mere laalan laal gulaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, all forms and colors are Yours; O my Beloved, my deep crimson ruby.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaisaa ra(n)g dheh so hovai kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaare ||8||3||
verses.translation: Only that color which You impart, Lord, exists; O Nanak, what can the poor wretched being do? ||8||3||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam gur saran prabhoo rakhavaare ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord God saves and protects us,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau ku(n)char tadhooaai pakar chalaio kar uoopar kadd nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: as He protected the elephant, when the crocodile seized it and pulled it into the water; He lifted him up and pulled him out. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ke sevak bahut at neeke man saradhaa kar har dhaare ||
verses.translation: God's servants are sublime and exalted; they enshrine faith for Him in their minds.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mere prabh saradhaa bhagat man bhaavai jan kee paij savaare ||1||
verses.translation: Faith and devotion are pleasing to my God's Mind; He saves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har sevak sevaa laagai sabh dhekhai braham pasaare ||
verses.translation: The servant of the Lord, Har, Har, is committed to His service; He sees God pervading the entire expanse of the universe.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek purakh ik nadharee aavai sabh ekaa nadhar nihaare ||2||
verses.translation: He sees the One and only Primal Lord God, who blesses all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਚੇਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh Thaakur raviaa sabh Thaiee sabh cheree jagat samaare ||
verses.translation: God, our Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading all places; He takes care of the whole world as His slave.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaal dhiaa dhaan dhevai vich paathar keere kaare ||3||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself mercifully gives His gifts, even to worms in stones. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੁਸਕਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਸਿੰਙ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vaas bahut musakaiee bhram bhoolaa mirag si(n)n(g)haare ||
verses.translation: Within the deer is the heavy fragrance of musk, but he is confused and deluded, and he shakes his horns looking for it.

verses.original: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ban ban ddoodd ddoodd fir thaakee gur poorai ghar nisataare ||4||
verses.translation: Wandering, rambling and roaming through the forests and woods, I exhausted myself, and then in my own home, the Perfect Guru saved me. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: baanee guroo guroo hai baanee vich baanee a(n)mrit saare ||
verses.translation: The Word, the Bani is Guru, and Guru is the Bani. Within the Bani, the Ambrosial Nectar is contained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur baanee kahai sevak jan maanai paratakh guroo nisataare ||5||
verses.translation: If His humble servant believes, and acts according to the Words of the Guru's Bani, then the Guru, in person, emancipates him. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਖਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh hai braham braham hai pasariaa man beejiaa khaavaare ||
verses.translation: All is God, and God is the whole expanse; man eats what he has planted.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਨ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹਾਂਸੁ ਦੁਖਿਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟਬੁਧੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਲੂਕੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jiau jan cha(n)dhrahaa(n)s dhukhiaa dhirasaTabudhee apunaa ghar lookee jaare ||6||
verses.translation: When Dhrishtabudhi tormented the humble devotee Chandrahaans, he only set his own house on fire. ||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਲੋਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau jan a(n)tar ridh lochai prabh jan ke saas nihaare ||
verses.translation: God's humble servant longs for Him within his heart; God watches over each breath of His humble servant.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar bhagat dhiraRaae jan peechhai jag nisataare ||7||
verses.translation: Mercifully, mercifully, He implants devotion within his humble servant; for his sake, God saves the whole world. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aapan aap aap prabh Thaakur prabh aape sirasaT savaare ||
verses.translation: God, our Lord and Master, is Himself by Himself; God Himself embellishes the universe.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai kar kirapaa aap nisataare ||8||4||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, He Himself is all-pervading; in His Mercy, He Himself emancipates all. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam kar kirapaa leh ubaare ||
verses.translation: Grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਦੁਸਟਾਂ ਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau pakar dhropatee dhusaTaa(n) aanee har har laaj nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: as You saved Dropadi from shame when she was seized and brought before the court by the evil villians. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jaachik jan tere ik maagau dhaan piaare ||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your Grace - I am just a humble beggar of Yours; I beg for a single blessing, O my Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur kee nit saradhaa laagee mo kau har gur mel savaare ||1||
verses.translation: I long constantly for the True Guru. Lead me to meet the Guru, O Lord, that I may be exalted and embellished. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਥੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਝੋਲ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat karam paanee jiau matheeaai nit paanee jhol jhulaare ||
verses.translation: The actions of the faithless cynic are like the churning of water; he churns, constantly churning only water.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਢਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਕੇ ਗਟਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat param padh paiaa kadd maakhan ke gaTakaare ||2||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the supreme status is obtained; the butter is produced, and eaten with delight. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit kaiaa majan keeaa nit mal mal dheh savaare ||
verses.translation: He may constantly and continually wash his body; he may constantly rub, clean and polish his body.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਭਾਏ ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mere satigur ke man bachan na bhaae sabh fokaT chaar seegaare ||3||
verses.translation: But if the Word of my True Guru is not pleasing to his mind, then all his preparations and beautiful decorations are useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਟਕਿ ਮਟਕਿ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maTak maTak chal sakhee sahelee mere Thaakur ke gun saare ||
verses.translation: Walk playfully and carefree, O my friends and companions; cherish the Glorious Virtues of my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevaa mere prabh bhaiee mai satigur alakh lakhaare ||4||
verses.translation: To serve, as Gurmukh, is pleasing to my God. Through the True Guru, the unknown is known. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naaree purakh purakh sabh naaree sabh eko purakh muraare ||
verses.translation: Women and men, all the men and women, all came from the One Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee ren man bhaiee mil har jan har nisataare ||5||
verses.translation: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those who meet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਗਰ ਸਭ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: graam graam nagar sabh firiaa ridh a(n)tar har jan bhaare ||
verses.translation: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by the Lord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.

verses.original: ਸਰਧਾ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saradhaa saradhaa upai milaae mo kau har gur gur nisataare ||6||
verses.translation: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord; the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||

verses.original: ਪਵਨ ਸੂਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pavan soot sabh neekaa kariaa satigur sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: nij ghar jai a(n)mirat ras peeaa bin nainaa jagat nihaare ||7||
verses.translation: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, I see the world, without my eyes. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਗੁਨ ਈਸ ਬਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਮ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tau gun iees baran nahee saakau tum ma(n)dhar ham nik keere ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord; You are the temple, and I am just a tiny worm.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa karahu gur melahu mai raam japat man dheere ||8||5||
verses.translation: Bless Nanak with Your Mercy, and unite him with the Guru; meditating on my Lord, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bhaj Thaakur agam apaare ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham paapee bahu niraguneeaare kar kirapaa gur nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am such a great sinner; I am so unworthy. And yet the Guru, in His Mercy, has saved me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo purakh saadh jan paae ik binau karau gur piaare ||
verses.translation: I have found the Holy Person, the Holy and humble servant of the Lord; I offer a prayer to Him, my Beloved Guru.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan poojee dhevahu sabh tisanaa bhookh nivaare ||1||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with the wealth, the capital of the Lord's Name, and take away all my hunger and thirst. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਚੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਮੀਨ ਇਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਘਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pachai pata(n)g mirag bhira(n)g ku(n)char meen ik i(n)dhree pakar saghaare ||
verses.translation: The moth, the deer, the bumble bee, the elephant and the fish are ruined, each by the one passion that controls them.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bhoot sabal hai dhehee gur satigur paap nivaare ||2||
verses.translation: The five powerful demons are in the body; the Guru, the True Guru turns out these sins. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸੋਧਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saasatr bedh sodh sodh dhekhe mun naaradh bachan pukaare ||
verses.translation: I searched and searched through the Shaastras and the Vedas; Naarad the silent sage proclaimed these words as well.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam paRahu gat paavahu satasa(n)gat gur nisataare ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, salvation is attained; the Guru saves those in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਵ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam preet lagee prabh keree jiv sooraj kamal nihaare ||
verses.translation: In love with the Beloved Lord God, one looks at Him as the lotus looks at the sun.

verses.original: ਮੇਰ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਮੋਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਬ ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨ ਘਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mer sumer mor bahu naachai jab unavai ghan ghanahaare ||4||
verses.translation: The peacock dances on the mountain, when the clouds hang low and heavy. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਸਭ ਡਾਲ ਫੂਲ ਬਿਸੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat kau a(n)mirat bahu si(n)chahu sabh ddaal fool bisukaare ||
verses.translation: The faithless cyinc may be totally drenched with ambrosial nectar, but even so, all his branches and flowers are filled with venom.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਛੇੜਿ ਛੇੜਿ ਕਢੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau niveh saakat nar setee chheR chheR kaddai bikh khaare ||5||
verses.translation: The more one bows down in humility before the faithless cyinc, the more he provokes, and stabs, and spits out his poison. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan sa(n)t saadh mil raheeaai gun boleh paraupakaare ||
verses.translation: Remain with the Holy man, the Saint of the Saints, who chants the Lord's Praises for the benefit of all.

verses.original: ਸੰਤੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tai sa(n)t milai man bigasai jiau jal mil kamal savaare ||6||
verses.translation: Meeting the Saint of Saints, the mind blossoms forth, like the lotus, exalted by obtaining the water. ||6||

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਹਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਲਕਿਓ ਸਭਹਿ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: lobh lahar sabh suaan halak hai halakio sabheh bigaare ||
verses.translation: The waves of greed are like mad dogs with rabies. Their madness ruins everything.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਹੋੁਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur kai dheebaan khabar huoiee gur giaan khaRag lai maare ||7||
verses.translation: When the news reached the Court of my Lord and Master, the Guru took up the sword of spiritual wisdom, and killed them. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raakh raakh raakh prabh mere mai raakhahu kirapaa dhaare ||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, save me, O my God; shower me with Your Mercy, and save me!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak mai dhar avar na kaiee mai satigur gur nisataare ||8||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have no other support; the Guru, the True Guru, has saved me. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: chhakaa 1 ||
verses.translation: First Set of Six Hymns||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: raag maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar rahe har a(n)t naahee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Countless have tried, but none have found the Lord's limit.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agam agaadh bodh aadhes har prabh raiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable; I humbly bow to the Lord God, my King. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਤੇ ਝਗਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh nit jhagarate jhagaraiaa ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment bring continual conflict and strife.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham raakh raakh dheen tere har saran har prabh aaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, I am your humble creature, O Lord; I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saranaagatee prabh paalate har bhagat vachhal naiaa ||
verses.translation: You protect and preserve those who take to Your Sanctuary, God; You are called the Lover of Your devotees.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਨਾਖਿ ਪਕਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prahilaadh jan haranaakh pakariaa har raakh leeo taraiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prahlaad, Your humble servant, was caught by Harnaakhash; but You saved Him and carried him across, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਣ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har chet re man mahal paavan sabh dhookh bha(n)jan raiaa ||
verses.translation: Remember the Lord, O mind, and rise up to the Mansion of His Presence; the Sovereign Lord is the Destroyer of pain.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhau janam maran nivaar Thaakur har gurmatee prabh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master takes away the fear of birth and death; following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord God is found. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਉ ਭਗਤ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har patit paavan naam suaamee bhau bhagat bha(n)jan gaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, our Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners; I sing of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fears of His devotees.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: har haar har ur dhaario jan naanak naam samaiaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: One who wears the necklace of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his heart, O servant Nanak, merges in the Naam. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil har saadh aaiaa gurmukh braham pachhaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and enjoys the sublime taste of the Lord, as Gurmukh, comes to realize God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur dharasan paiaa gur miliaai har prabh jaataa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; meeting with the Guru, the Lord God is known.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuramat mail giee sabh neekar har a(n)mirat har sar naataa ||1||
verses.translation: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, bathing in the Lord's ambrosial pool of nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੂਛਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan saadh jin(h)ee har prabh paiaa tin(h) poochhau har kee baataa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who have found their Lord God; I ask them to tell me the stories of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਉ ਜੁਦਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pai lagau nit karau judhareeaa har melahu karam bidhaataa ||2||
verses.translation: I fall at their feet, and always pray to them, to mercifully unite me with my Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਿਲਾਟ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: lilaaT likhe paiaa gur saadhoo gur bachanee man tan raataa ||
verses.translation: Through the destiny written on my forehead, I have found the Holy Guru; my mind and body are imbued with the Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har prabh aai mile sukh paiaa sabh kilavikh paap gavaataa ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord God has come to meet me; I have found peace, and I am rid of all the sins. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam rasain jin(h) gurmat paiaa tin(h) kee uootam baataa ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find the Lord, the source of nectar; their words are sublime and exalted.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee pa(n)k paieeaai vaddabhaagee jan naanak charan paraataa ||4||2||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak falls at their feet. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sidh saadhik mun janaa man bhaavanee har dhiaaio ||
verses.translation: All the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages, with their minds full of love, meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apara(n)paro paarabraham suaamee har alakh guroo lakhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, my Lord and Master, is limitless; the Guru has inspired me to know the unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮਧਿਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: ham neech madhim karam ke'ee nahee chetio har raio ||
verses.translation: I am low, and I commit evil actions; I have not remembered my Sovereign Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aan melio satiguroo khin ba(n)dh mukat karaio ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me from bondage. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਸਤਕੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: prabh masatake dhur leekhiaa gurmatee har liv laio ||
verses.translation: Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sabadh dharageh baajiaa har milio ma(n)gal gaio ||2||
verses.translation: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resound in the Court of the Lord; meeting the Lord, I sing the songs of joy. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan naam narahar ma(n)dhabhaageeaa(n) nahee bhaio ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretches do not like this.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਗਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: te garabh jonee gaale'eeh jiau lon jaleh galaio ||3||
verses.translation: They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: mat dheh har prabh agam Thaakur gur charan man mai laio ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord and Master, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: har raam naamai rahau laago jan naanak naam samaio ||4||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak remains attached to the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Naam. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man raam naam ras laagaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is addicted to the juice of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kamal pragaas bhiaa gur paiaa har japio bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and I have found the Guru. Meditating on the Lord, my doubts and fears have run away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhai bhagat laago meraa heearaa man soio gurmat jaagaa ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, my heart is committed in loving devotion to Him; following the Guru's Teachings, my sleeping mind has awakened.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kilabikh kheen bhe saa(n)t aaiee har ur dhaario vaddabhaagaa ||1||
verses.translation: All my sins have been erased, and I have found peace and tranquility; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart, by great good fortune. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ra(n)g kasu(n)bh hai kachooaa jiau kusam chaar dhin chaagaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is like the false color of the safflower, which fades away; its color lasts for only a few days.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khin meh binas jai parataapai dda(n)dd dharam rai kaa laagaa ||2||
verses.translation: He perishes in an instant; he is tormented, and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat preet saadh at gooRee jiau ra(n)g majeeTh bahu laagaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Love, found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is absolutely permanent, and colorfast.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kaapar cheer bahu faare har ra(n)g na lahai sabhaagaa ||3||
verses.translation: The cloth of the body may be torn to shreds, but still, this beautiful color of the Lord's Love does not fade away. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਾਰ੍ਹਿਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har chaariho ra(n)g milai gur sobhaa har ra(n)g chaloolai raa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Blessed Guru, one is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, imbued with this deep crimson color.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tin ke charan pakhaarai jo har charanee jan laagaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble being, who is attached to the feet of the Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bhaj har har naam gupaalaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate, vibrate upon the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan leen bhiaa raam naamai mat gurmat raam rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are merged in the Lord's Name, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect is imbued with the Lord, the source of nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam dhiaaieeaai har har man japeeaai har japamaalaa ||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Chant, and meditate, on the beads of the mala of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kai masatak leekhiaa har miliaa har banamaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads, meet with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) har naam dhiaaiaa tin(h) chooke sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord - all their entanglements are ended.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin(h) jam neR na aaviee gur raakhe har rakhavaalaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Guru, the Savior Lord, saves them. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik kichhoo na jaanahoo har maat pitaa pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: I am a child; I know nothing at all. The Lord cherishes me, as my mother and father.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਲਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar maiaa agan nit melate gur raakhe dheen dhiaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: I continually put my hands into the fire of Maya, but the Guru saves me; He is merciful to the meek. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu maile niramal hoiaa sabh kilabikh har jas jaalaa ||
verses.translation: I was filthy, but I have become immaculate. Singing the Lord's Praises, all sins have been burnt to ashes.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: man anadh bhiaa gur paiaa jan naanak sabadh nihaalaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: My mind is in esctasy, having found the Guru; servant Nanak is enraptured through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har bhaj sabh kilabikh kaaT ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate, vibrate on the Lord, and all sins will be eradicated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har ur dhaario gur poorai meraa sees keejai gur vaaT ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has enshried the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; I place my head on the Guru's Path. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: mere har prabh kee mai baat sunaavai tis man dhevau kaT kaaT ||
verses.translation: Whoever tells me the stories of my Lord God, I would cut my mind into slices, and dedicate it to him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਹਟਿ ਹਾਟ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har saajan melio gur poorai gur bachan bikaano haT haaT ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, my Friend; I have sold myself at each and every store for the Guru's Word. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਗਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਧ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: makar praag dhaan bahu keeaa sareer dheeo adh kaaT ||
verses.translation: One may give donations in charity at Prayaag, and cut the body in two at Benares,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin har naam ko mukat na paavai bahu ka(n)chan dheejai kaT kaaT ||2||
verses.translation: but without the Lord's Name, no one attains liberation, even though one may give away huge amounts of gold. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਘਰੇ ਕਪਟ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat gurmat jas gaio man ughare kapaT kapaaT ||
verses.translation: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, and sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the doors of the mind, held shut by deception, are thrown open again.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਲਜ ਭਾਨੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tirakuTee for bharam bhau bhaagaa laj bhaanee maTukee maaT ||3||
verses.translation: The three qualities are shattered, doubt and fear run away, and the clay pot of public opinion is broken. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: kalajug gur pooraa tin paiaa jin dhur masatak likhe lilaaT ||
verses.translation: They alone find the Perfect Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਖਾਟ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ras a(n)mrit peeaa sabh laathee bhookh tikhaaT ||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; all his hunger and thirst are quenched. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: chhakaa 1 ||
verses.translation: Set of Six Hymns 1||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: re man Tahal har sukh saar ||
verses.translation: O mind, true peace comes from serving the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਟਹਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar Tahalaa jhooTheeaa nit karai jam sir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Other services are false, and as punishment for them, the Messenger of Death bashes in one's head. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa masatak leekhiaa te mile sa(n)gaar ||
verses.translation: They alone join the Sangat, the Congregation, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar bhaujal taariaa har sa(n)t purakh apaar ||1||
verses.translation: They are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Saints of the Infinite, Primal Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: nit charan sevahu saadh ke taj lobh moh bikaar ||
verses.translation: Serve forever at the feet of the Holy; renounce greed, emotional attachment and corruption.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤਜਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸੜੀ ਰਖੁ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh tajahu dhoojee aasaRee rakh aas ik nira(n)kaar ||2||
verses.translation: Abandon all other hopes, and rest your hopes in the One Formless Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik bharam bhoole saakataa bin gur a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: Some are faithless cynics, deluded by doubt; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੋ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhur hovanaa su hoiaa ko na meTanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever is pre-ordained, comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: agam roop gobi(n)dh kaa anik naam apaar ||
verses.translation: The beauty of the Lord of the Universe is profound and unfathomable; the Names of the Infinite Lord are immunerable.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n te jan naanakaa jin har naamaa ur dhaar ||4||1||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, O Nanak, who enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kau namasakaar ||
verses.translation: I humbly bow to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaas japat hovat udhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting it, one is saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran miTeh dha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, conflicts are ended.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran chhooTeh ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one's bonds are untied.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਚਤੁਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran moorakh chatur ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, the fool becomes wise.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕੁਲਹ ਉਧਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran kuleh udhar ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one's ancestors are saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran bhau dhukh harai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, fear and pain are taken away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਪਦਾ ਟਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran apadhaa Tarai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, misfortune is avoided.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੁਚਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran muchat paap ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, sins are erased.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran nahee sa(n)taap ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, agony is ended. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਦ ਬਿਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran ridh bigaas ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, the heart blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran kavalaa dhaas ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, Maya becomes one's slave.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran nidh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one is blessed with the treasures of wealth.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤਰੇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran tare nidhaan ||3||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one crosses over in the end. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan naam haree ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: koT bhagat udhaar karee ||
verses.translation: It saves millions of devotees.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਾ ਦੀਨੁ ਸਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaas dhaasaa dheen saran ||
verses.translation: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਥਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak maathaa sa(n)t charan ||4||2||
verses.translation: Nanak lays his forehead on the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso sahaiee har ko naam ||
verses.translation: This is the sort of helper the Name of the Lord is.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat bhaj pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਮਿਲਤ ॥
verses.translit: booddat kau jaise beRee milat ||
verses.translation: It is like a boat to a drowning man.

verses.original: ਬੂਝਤ ਦੀਪਕ ਮਿਲਤ ਤਿਲਤ ॥
verses.translit: boojhat dheepak milat tilat ||
verses.translation: It is like oil to the lamp whose flame is dying out.

verses.original: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਨੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jalat aganee milat neer ||
verses.translation: It is like water poured on the burning fire.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮੁਖਹਿ ਖੀਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaise baarik mukheh kheer ||1||
verses.translation: It is like milk poured into the baby's mouth. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਸਖਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaise ran meh sakhaa bhraat ||
verses.translation: As one's brother becomes a helper on the field of battle;

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaise bhookhe bhojan maat ||
verses.translation: as one's hunger is satisfied by food;

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਿਰਖਹਿ ਬਰਸ ਮੇਘ ॥
verses.translit: jaise kirakheh baras megh ||
verses.translation: as the cloudburst saves the crops;

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਲਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੇਂਘ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaise paalan saran se(n)gh ||2||
verses.translation: as one is protected in the tiger's lair;||2||

verses.original: ਗਰੁੜ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਰਪ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: garuR mukh nahee sarap traas ||
verses.translation: As with the magic spell of Garuda the eagle upon one's lips, one does not fear the snake;

verses.original: ਸੂਆ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sooaa pi(n)jar nahee khai bilaas ||
verses.translation: as the cat cannot eat the parrot in its cage;

verses.original: ਜੈਸੋ ਆਂਡੋ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaiso aa(n)ddo hiradhe maeh ||
verses.translation: as the bird cherishes her eggs in her heart;

verses.original: ਜੈਸੋ ਦਾਨੋ ਚਕੀ ਦਰਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaiso dhaano chakee dharaeh ||3||
verses.translation: as the grains are spared, by sticking to the central post of the mill;||3||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਓਪਮਾ ਥੋਰ ਕਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahut opamaa thor kahee ||
verses.translation: Your Glory is so great; I can describe only a tiny bit of it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agam agaadh tuhee ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਮੂਚੌ ਬਹੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: uooch moochau bahu apaar ||
verses.translation: You are lofty and high, utterly great and infinite.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: simarat naanak tare saar ||4||3||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak, one is carried across. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੀ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: eihee hamaarai safal kaaj ||
verses.translation: Please let my works be rewarding and fruitful.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apune dhaas kau leh nivaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please cherish and exalt Your slave. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਹ ਮਾਥ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: charan sa(n)teh maath mor ||
verses.translation: I lay my forehead on the feet of the Saints,

verses.original: ਨੈਨਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: nain dharas pekhau nis bhor ||
verses.translation: and with my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, day and night.

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਹਮਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ॥
verses.translit: hasat hamare sa(n)t Tahal ||
verses.translation: With my hands, I work for the Saints.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਬਹਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: praan man dhan sa(n)t bahal ||1||
verses.translation: I dedicate my breath of life, my mind and wealth to the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g mere man kee preet ||
verses.translation: My mind loves the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਗੁਨ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t gun baseh merai cheet ||
verses.translation: The Virtues of the Saints abide within my consciousness.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t aagiaa maneh meeTh ||
verses.translation: The Will of the Saints is sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੰਤ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meraa kamal bigasai sa(n)t ddeeTh ||2||
verses.translation: Seeing the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g meraa hoi nivaas ||
verses.translation: I dwell in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kee moh bahut piaas ||
verses.translation: I have such a great thirst for the Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਚਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bachan mere maneh ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Words of the Saints are the Mantras of my mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੰਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh mere bikhai ha(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, my corruption is taken away. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਏਹਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: mukat jugat ehaa nidhaan ||
verses.translation: This way of liberation is my treasure.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhiaal moh dhevahu dhaan ||
verses.translation: O Merciful God, please bless me with this gift.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh dhiaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: O God, shower Your Mercy upon Nanak.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: charan sa(n)tan ke mere ridhe majhaar ||4||4||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the feet of the Saints within my heart. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kai sa(n)gee naahee dhoor ||
verses.translation: He is with all; He is not far away.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan haajaraa hajoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Cause of causes, ever-present here and now. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤ ਜੀਓ ਜਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: sunat jeeo jaas naam ||
verses.translation: Hearing His Name, one comes to life.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh binase sukh keeo bisraam ||
verses.translation: Pain is dispelled; peace and tranquility come to dwell within.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal nidh har har hare ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is all treasure.

verses.original: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mun jan taa kee sev kare ||1||
verses.translation: The silent sages serve Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ghar sagale samaeh ||
verses.translation: Everything is contained in His home.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis te birathaa koi naeh ||
verses.translation: No one is turned away empty-handed.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)tr kare pratipaal ||
verses.translation: He cherishes all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa sevahu kirapaal ||2||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, serve the Merciful Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa dharam jaa kai dheebaan ||
verses.translation: Righteous justice is dispensed in His Court forever.

verses.original: ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: bemuhataaj nahee kichh kaan ||
verses.translation: He is carefree, and owes allegiance to no one.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਨਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh karanaa aapan aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself, by Himself, does everything.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: re man mere too taa kau jaap ||3||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kau hau balihaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaas mil hovai udhaar ||
verses.translation: Joining them, I am saved.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਤਨਹਿ ਰਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: naam sa(n)g man taneh raat ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh karee dhaat ||4||5||
verses.translation: God has blessed Nanak with this gift. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har samarath kee saranaa ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the all-powerful Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan raas meree prabh ek kaaran karanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My soul, body, wealth and capital belong to the One God, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੀਵਣੈ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar sadhaa sukh paieeaai jeevanai kaa mool ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ ਠਾਈ ਸੂਖਮੋ ਅਸਥੂਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa sarabat Thaiee sookhamo asathool ||1||
verses.translation: He is all-pervading, permeating all places; He is in subtle essence and manifest form. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤਜਿ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aal jaal bikaar taj sabh har gunaa nit gaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon all your entanglements and corruption; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: kar joR naanak dhaan maa(n)gai dheh apanaa naau ||2||1||6||
verses.translation: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing; please bless me with Your Name. ||2||1||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: prabh samarath dhev apaar ||
verses.translation: God is all-powerful, divine and infinite.

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਚਲਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaun jaanai chalit tere kichh a(n)t naahee paar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Who knows Your wondrous plays? You have no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik khineh thaap uthaapadhaa ghaR bha(n)n karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; You create and destroy, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇਤ ਕੀਨ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jet keen upaarajanaa prabh dhaan dhei dhaataar ||1||
verses.translation: As many beings as You created, God, so many You bless with Your blessings. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har saran aaio dhaas teraa prabh uooch agam muraar ||
verses.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am Your slave, O Inaccessible Lord God.

verses.original: ਕਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖਮ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: kadd leh bhaujal bikham te jan naanak sadh balihaar ||2||2||7||
verses.translation: Lift me up and pull me out of the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||2||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: man tan bas rahe gopaal ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the World abides in my mind and body.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen baa(n)dhav bhagat vachhal sadhaa sadhaa kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Friend of the meek, Lover of His devotees, forever and ever merciful. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)te madh toohai prabh binaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the end and in the middle, You alone exist, God; there is none other than You.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਡਲ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poor rahiaa sagal ma(n)ddal ek suaamee soi ||1||
verses.translation: He is totally permeating and pervading all worlds; He is the One and only Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan har jas netr dharasan rasan har gun gaau ||
verses.translation: With my ears I hear God's Praises, and with my eyes I behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; with my tongue I sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥੬॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: balihaar jaae sadhaa naanak dheh apanaa naau ||2||3||8||6||14||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You; please, bless me with Your Name. ||2||3||8||6||14||

verses.original: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: maalee gauRaa baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
verses.translation: Maalee Gauraa, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਓ ਰਾਮ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n o raam ben baajai ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is that flute which the Lord plays.

verses.original: ਮਧੁਰ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਗਾਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: madhur madhur dhun anahat gaajai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sweet, sweet unstruck sound current sings forth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਮੇਘਾ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan meghaa romaavalee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the wool of the sheep;

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਓਢੈ ਕਾਂਬਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan kirasan oddai kaa(n)balee ||1||
verses.translation: blessed, blessed is the blanket worn by Krishna. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan too maataa dhevakee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are you, O mother Dayvakee;

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਵਲਾਪਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh gireh ramieeaa kavalaapatee ||2||
verses.translation: into your home the Lord was born. ||2||

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan ban kha(n)dd bi(n)dhraabanaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are the forests of Brindaaban;

verses.original: ਜਹ ਖੇਲੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeh khelai sree naarainaa ||3||
verses.translation: the Supreme Lord plays there. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਗੋਧਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ben bajaavai godhan charai ||
verses.translation: He plays the flute, and herds the cows;

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naame kaa suaamee aanadh karai ||4||1||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master plays happily. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਤੂ ਧਨੁ ਕੇਸੌ ਸਾਂਵਲੀਓ ਬੀਠੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mero baap maadhau too dhan kesau saa(n)valeeo beeThulai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my Father, Lord of wealth, blessed are You, long-haired, dark-skinned, my darling. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਗਜ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਧਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhare chakar baiku(n)Th te aae gaj hasatee ke praan udhaareeale ||
verses.translation: You hold the steel chakra in Your hand; You came down from Heaven, and saved the life of the elephant.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਸਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਸਭਾ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਅੰਬਰ ਲੇਤ ਉਬਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuhasaasan kee sabhaa dhropatee a(n)bar let ubaareeale ||1||
verses.translation: In the court of Duhsaasan, You saved the honor of Dropati, when her clothes were being removed. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਲਿਆ ਤਾਰੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gotam naar ahaliaa taaree paavan ketak taareeale ||
verses.translation: You saved Ahliyaa, the wife of Gautam; how many have You purified and carried across?

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਆਈਅਲੇ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaisaa adham ajaat naamadheau tau saranaagat aaieeale ||2||2||
verses.translation: Such a lowly outcaste as Naam Dayv has come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੈ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮਾ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabhai ghaT raam bolai raamaa bolai ||
verses.translation: Within all hearts, the Lord speaks, the Lord speaks.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam binaa ko bolai re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Who else speaks, other than the Lord? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕਲ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੁੰਜਰ ਚੀਟੀ ਭਾਜਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ekal maaTee ku(n)jar cheeTee bhaajan hai(n) bahu naanaa re ||
verses.translation: Out of the same clay, the elephant, the ant, and the many sorts of species are formed.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਮ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asathaavar ja(n)gam keeT pata(n)gam ghaT ghaT raam samaanaa re ||1||
verses.translation: In stationary life forms, moving beings, worms, moths and within each and every heart, the Lord is contained. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕਲ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਅਉਰ ਤਜਹੁ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ekal chi(n)taa raakh ana(n)taa aaur tajahu sabh aasaa re ||
verses.translation: Remember the One, Infinite Lord; abandon all other hopes.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: pranavai naamaa bhe nihakaamaa ko Thaakur ko dhaasaa re ||2||3||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv prays, I have become dispassionate and detached; who is the Lord and Master, and who is the slave? ||2||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Maaroo, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sadh dhoor ||
verses.translation: O my Friend, I shall forever remain the dust of Your feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadhaa hajoor ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks Your protection, and beholds You ever-present, here and now. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ||
verses.translation: Shabad:

verses.original: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pichhahu raatee sadhaRaa naam khasam kaa leh ||
verses.translation: Those who receive the call in the last hours of the night, chant the Name of their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਖੇਮੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਰਥ ਪੀੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: kheme chhatr saraiche dhisan rath peeRe ||
verses.translation: Tents, canopies, pavilions and carriages are prepared and made ready for them.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jinee teraa naam dhiaaiaa tin kau sadh mile ||1||
verses.translation: You send out the call, Lord, to those who meditate on Your Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa mai karamaheen kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: Father, I am unfortunate, a fraud.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam na paiaa teraa a(n)dhaa bharam bhoolaa man meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have not found Your Name; my mind is blind and deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਦ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਫੁੜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saadh keete dhukh parafuRe poorab likhe mai ||
verses.translation: I have enjoyed the tastes, and now my pains have come to fruition; such is my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਥੋੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਅਗਲੇ ਦੂਖੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sukh thoRe dhukh agale dhookhe dhookh vihai ||2||
verses.translation: Now my joys are few, and my pains are many. In utter agony, I pass my life. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa veechhuRai miliaa kaa kiaa mel ||
verses.translation: What separation could be worse than separation from the Lord? For those who are united with Him, what other union can there be?

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saahib so saalaaheeaai jin kar dhekhiaa khel ||3||
verses.translation: Praise the Lord and Master, who, having created this play, beholds it. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਇਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jogee melaavaRaa in tan keete bhog ||
verses.translation: By good destiny, this union comes about; this body enjoys its pleasures.

verses.original: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: vijogee mil vichhuRe naanak bhee sa(n)jog ||4||1||
verses.translation: Those who have lost their destiny, suffer separation from this union. O Nanak, they may still be united once again! ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil maat pitaa pi(n)dd kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: The union of the mother and father brings the body into being.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin karatai lekh likhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator inscribes upon it the inscription of its destiny.

verses.original: ਲਿਖੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: likh dhaat jot vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: According to this inscription, gifts, light and glorious greatness are received.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil maiaa surat gavaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Joining with Maya, the spiritual consciousness is lost. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh man kaahe karaseh maanaa ||
verses.translation: O foolish mind, why are you so proud?

verses.original: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: auTh chalanaa khasamai bhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall have to arise and depart when it pleases your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: taj saadh sahaj sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Abandon the tastes of the world, and find intuitive peace.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਛਡਣੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar chhaddane rahai na koiee ||
verses.translation: All must abandon their worldly homes; no one remains here forever.

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਧਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kichh khaajai kichh dhar jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Eat some, and save the rest,

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je baahuR dhuneeaa aaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: if you are destined to return to the world again. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਟੁ ਹਢਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saj kaiaa paT haddaae ||
verses.translation: He adorns his body and ress in silk robes.

verses.original: ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: furamais bahut chalaae ||
verses.translation: He issues all sorts of commands.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar sej sukhaalee sovai ||
verses.translation: Preparing his comfortable bed, he sleeps.

verses.original: ਹਥੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hathee paudhee kaahe rovai ||3||
verses.translation: When he falls into the hands of the Messenger of Death, what good does it do to cry out? ||3||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਘੁੰਮਣਵਾਣੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghu(n)manavaanee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Household affairs are whirlpools of entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਪਥਰ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: paap pathar taran na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Sin is a stone which does not float.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਜੀਉ ਚੜਾਊ ॥
verses.translit: bhau beRaa jeeau chaRaauoo ||
verses.translation: So let the Fear of God be the boat to carry your soul across.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਹੂ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak dhevai kaahoo ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, rare are those who are blessed with this Boat. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਖ ਪਏ ॥
verses.translit: karanee kaagadh man masavaanee buraa bhalaa dhui lekh pe ||
verses.translation: Actions are the paper, and the mind is the ink; good and bad are both recorded upon it.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau kirat chalaae tiau chaleeaai tau gun naahee a(n)t hare ||1||
verses.translation: As their past actions drive them, so are mortals driven. There is no end to Your Glorious Virtues, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chit chetas kee nahee baavariaa ||
verses.translation: Why do you not keep Him in your consciousness, you mad man?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, your own virtues shall rot away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਲੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਲੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਜੇਤੀ ਘੜੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਤੇਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaalee rain jaal dhin hooaa jetee ghaRee faahee tetee ||
verses.translation: The night is a net, and the day is a net; there are as many traps as there are moments.

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ras ras chog chugeh nit faaseh chhooTas mooRe kavan gunee ||2||
