verses.translation: With relish and delight, you continually bite at the bait; you are trapped, you fool - how will you ever escape? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਆਰਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa aaran man vich lohaa pa(n)ch agan tit laag rahee ||
verses.translation: The body is a furnace, and the mind is the iron within it; the five fires are heating it.

verses.original: ਕੋਇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਭਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koile paap paRe tis uoopar man jaliaa sa(n)n(h)ee chi(n)t bhiee ||3||
verses.translation: Sin is the charcoal placed upon it, which burns the mind; the tongs are anxiety and worry. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhiaa manoor ka(n)chan fir hovai je gur milai tinehaa ||
verses.translation: What was turned to slag is again transformed into gold, if one meets with the Guru.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek naam a(n)mrit oh dhevai tau naanak tirasaTas dhehaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: He blesses the mortal with the Ambrosial Name of the One Lord, and then, O Nanak, the body is held steady. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bimal majhaar basas niramal jal padhaman jaaval re ||
verses.translation: In the pure, immaculate waters, both the lotus and the slimy scum are found.

verses.original: ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਜਲ ਰਸ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: padhaman jaaval jal ras sa(n)gat sa(n)g dhokh nahee re ||1||
verses.translation: The lotus flower is with the scum and the water, but it remains untouched by any pollution. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਦਰ ਤੂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaadhar too kabeh na jaanas re ||
verses.translation: You frog, you will never understand.

verses.original: ਭਖਸਿ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਖਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhakhas sibaal basas niramal jal a(n)mrit na lakhas re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You eat the dirt, while you dwell in the immaculate waters. You know nothing of the ambrosial nectar there. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਵਸਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਮੇਰ ਚਚਾ ਗੁਨ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bas jal nit na vasat aleeal mer chachaa gun re ||
verses.translation: You dwell continually in the water; the bumble bee does not dwell there, but it is intoxicated with its fragrance from afar.

verses.original: ਚੰਦ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਸਸਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh kumudhanee dhoorahu nivasas anabhau kaaran re ||2||
verses.translation: Intuitively sensing the moon in the distance, the lotus bows its head. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੰਡੁ ਦੂਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਸੰਚਸਿ ਤੂ ਬਨ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kha(n)dd dhoodh madh sa(n)chas too ban chaatur re ||
verses.translation: The realms of nectar are irrigated with milk and honey; you think you are clever to live in the water.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਪਿਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhoddas pisan preet jiau re ||3||
verses.translation: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the love of the flea for blood. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਗਮ ਸਾਸ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit sa(n)g vaseh jan moorakh aagam saas sune ||
verses.translation: The fool may live with the Pandit, the religious scholar, and listen to the Vedas and the Shaastras.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhoddas suaan poochh jiau re ||4||
verses.translation: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the crooked tail of the dog. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਇਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik paakha(n)ddee naam na raacheh ik har har charanee re ||
verses.translation: Some are hypocrites; they do not merge with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Some are absorbed in the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਰੇ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa paavas naanak rasanaa naam jap re ||5||4||
verses.translation: The mortals obtain what they are predestined to receive; O Nanak, with your tongue, chant the Naam. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla,

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet asa(n)kh hoh har charanee man laag ||
verses.translation: Countless sinners are sanctified, attaching their minds to the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath naam prabh naanak jis masatak bhaag ||1||
verses.translation: The merits of the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are found in God's Name, O Nanak, when such destiny is inscribed upon one's forehead. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ||
verses.translation: Shabad:

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee sahelee garab gahelee ||
verses.translation: O friends and companions, so puffed up with pride,

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sun seh kee ik baat suhelee ||1||
verses.translation: listen to this one joyous story of your Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਬੇਦਨ ਸਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo mai bedhan saa kis aakhaa maiee ||
verses.translation: Who can I tell about my pain, O my mother?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bin jeeau na rahai kaise raakhaa maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive; how can I comfort it, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਖਰੀ ਰੰਞਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau dhohaagan kharee ra(n)n(j)aanee ||
verses.translation: I am a dejected, discarded bride, totally miserable.

verses.original: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: giaa su joban dhan pachhutaanee ||2||
verses.translation: I have lost my youth; I regret and repent. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too dhaanaa saahib sir meraa ||
verses.translation: You are my wise Lord and Master, above my head.

verses.original: ਖਿਜਮਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khijamat karee jan ba(n)dhaa teraa ||3||
verses.translation: I serve You as Your humble slave. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਏਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak a(n)dhesaa ehee ||
verses.translation: Nanak humbly prays, this is my only concern:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਵਉ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin dharasan kaise ravau sanehee ||4||5||
verses.translation: without the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, how can I enjoy Him? ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਲ ਖਰੀਦੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: mul khareedhee laalaa golaa meraa naau sabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: I am Your slave, Your bonded servant, and so I am called fortunate.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kee bachanee haaT bikaanaa jit laiaa tit laagaa ||1||
verses.translation: I sold myself at Your store in exchange for the Guru's Word; whatever You link me to, to that I am linked. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tere laale kiaa chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: What cleverness can Your servant try with You?

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saahib kaa hukam na karanaa jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, I cannot carry out the Hukam of Your Command. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾ ਲਾਲੀ ਪਿਉ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maa laalee piau laalaa meraa hau laale kaa jaiaa ||
verses.translation: My mother is Your slave, and my father is Your slave; I am the child of Your slaves.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੀ ਨਾਚੈ ਲਾਲਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laalee naachai laalaa gaavai bhagat karau teree raiaa ||2||
verses.translation: My slave mother dances, and my slave father sings; I practice devotional worship to You, O my Sovereign Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੀਅਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਣੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਸਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pe'eeh ta paanee aanee meeraa khaeh ta peesan jaau ||
verses.translation: If You wish to drink, then I shall get water for You; if You wish to eat, I shall grind the corn for You.

verses.original: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪੈਰ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pakhaa feree pair malovaa japat rahaa teraa naau ||3||
verses.translation: I wave the fan over You, and wash Your feet, and continue to chant Your Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: loon haraamee naanak laalaa bakhaseh tudh vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I have been untrue to myself, but Nanak is Your slave; please forgive him, by Your glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh dhiaapat dhaataa tudh vin mukat na paiee ||4||6||
verses.translation: Since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You have been the merciful and generous Lord. Without You, liberation cannot be attained. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਭੂਤਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aakhai bhootanaa ko kahai betaalaa ||
verses.translation: Some call him a ghost; some say that he is a demon.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਆਦਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koiee aakhai aadhamee naanak vechaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Some call him a mere mortal; O, poor Nanak! ||1||

verses.original: ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhiaa dhivaanaa saeh kaa naanak bauraanaa ||
verses.translation: Crazy Nanak has gone insane, after his Lord, the King.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau har bin avar na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I know of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਭੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tau dhevaanaa jaaneeaai jaa bhai dhevaanaa hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone is known to be insane, when he goes insane with the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਏਕੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ekee saahib baaharaa dhoojaa avar na jaanai koi ||2||
verses.translation: He recognizes none other than the One Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਏਕਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tau dhevaanaa jaaneeaai jaa ekaa kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: He alone is known to be insane, if he works for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa dhoojee avar siaanap kai ||3||
verses.translation: Recognizing the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, what other cleverness is there? ||3||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tau dhevaanaa jaaneeaai jaa saahib dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: He alone is known to be insane, when he falls in love with his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa jaanai aap kau avar bhalaa sa(n)saar ||4||7||
verses.translation: He sees himself as bad, and all the rest of the world as good. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih dhan sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: This wealth is all-pervading, permeating all.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh fireh s jaaneh dhoor ||1||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, thinking that it is far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so dhan vakhar naam ridhai hamaarai ||
verses.translation: That commodity, the wealth of the Naam, is within my heart.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis too dheh tisai nisataarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever You bless with it, is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: n ih dhan jalai na tasakar lai jai ||
verses.translation: This wealth does not burn; it cannot be stolen by a thief.

verses.original: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: n ih dhan ddoobai na is dhan kau milai sajai ||2||
verses.translation: This wealth does not drown, and its owner is never punished. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis dhan kee dhekhahu vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Gaze upon the glorious greatness of this wealth,

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahaje maate anadhin jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: and your nights and days will pass, imbued with celestial peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik baat anoop sunahu nar bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Listen to this incomparably beautiful story, O my brothers, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eis dhan bin kahahu kinai param gat paiee ||4||
verses.translation: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak akath kee kathaa sunaae ||
verses.translation: Nanak humbly prays, I proclaim the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੮॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta ih dhan paae ||5||8||
verses.translation: If one meets the True Guru, then this wealth is obtained. ||5||8||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੋਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੋਮ ਸਰੁ ਪੋਖਿ ਲੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਤੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat kar maratu su sanaba(n)dh keejai ||
verses.translation: Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the left nostril; practicing this breath-control, bring them into perfect balance.

verses.original: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||1||
verses.translation: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਇਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: mooRe kaiche bharam bhulaa ||
verses.translation: You fool, why are you deluded by doubt?

verses.original: ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neh cheeniaa paramaana(n)dh bairaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You do not remember the detached Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਜਰ ਗਹੁ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਗਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਉ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ajar gahu jaar lai amar gahu maar lai bhraat taj chhodd tau apiau peejai ||
verses.translation: Seize and burn the unbearable; seize and kill the imperishable; leave behind your doubts, and then, you shall drink in the Nectar.

verses.original: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||2||
verses.translation: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੋ ਰਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਪਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak jano ravai je har mano man pavan siau a(n)mrit peejai ||
verses.translation: Nanak humbly prays, if the Lord's humble servant dwells upon Him, in his mind of minds, with his every breath, then he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||3||9||
verses.translation: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||3||9||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਈ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਆ ਸਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa muiee na man muaa sar laharee mai mat ||
verses.translation: Maya is not conquered, and the mind is not subdued; the waves of desire in the world-ocean are intoxicating wine.

verses.original: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਜਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਰਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: bohith jal sir tar Tikai saachaa vakhar jit ||
verses.translation: The boat crosses over the water, carrying the true merchandise.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: maanak man meh man maarasee sach na laagai kat ||
verses.translation: The jewel within the mind subdues the mind; attached to the Truth, it is not broken.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਭੈ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਰਤੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raajaa takhat Tikai gunee bhai pa(n)chain rat ||1||
verses.translation: The king is seated upon the throne, imbued with the Fear of God and the five qualities. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa saachaa saahib dhoor na dhekh ||
verses.translation: O Baba, do not see your True Lord and Master as being far away.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jot jagajeevanaa sir sir saachaa lekh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Light of all, the Life of the world; The True Lord writes His Inscription on each and every head. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰਿਖੀ ਮੁਨੀ ਸੰਕਰੁ ਇੰਦੁ ਤਪੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan rikhee munee sa(n)kar i(n)dh tapai bhekhaaree ||
verses.translation: Brahma and Vishnu, the Rishis and the silent sages, Shiva and Indra, penitents and beggars

verses.original: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਕੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanai hukam sohai dhar saachai aakee mareh afaaree ||
verses.translation: - whoever obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, looks beautiful in the Court of the True Lord, while the stubborn rebels die.

verses.original: ਜੰਗਮ ਜੋਧ ਜਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)gam jodh jatee sa(n)niaasee gur poorai veechaaree ||
verses.translation: The wandering beggars, warriors, celibates and Sannyaasee hermits - through the Perfect Guru, consider this:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin sevaa fal kabahu na paavas sevaa karanee saaree ||2||
verses.translation: without selfless service, no one ever receives the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord is the most excellent action. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਧਨਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: nidhaniaa dhan niguriaa gur ni(n)maaniaa too maan ||
verses.translation: You are the wealth of the poor, the Guru of the guru-less, the honor of the dishonored.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhulai maanak gur pakaRiaa nitaaniaa too taan ||
verses.translation: I am blind; I have grasped hold of the jewel, the Guru. You are the strength of the weak.

verses.original: ਹੋਮ ਜਪਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: hom japaa nahee jaaniaa gurmatee saach pachhaan ||
verses.translation: He is not known through burnt offerings and ritual chanting; the True Lord is known through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam binaa naahee dhar ddoiee jhooThaa aavan jaan ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one finds shelter in the Court of the Lord; the false come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa naam salaaheeaai saache te tirapat hoi ||
verses.translation: So praise the True Name, and through the True Name, you will find satisfaction.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan ratan man maajeeaai bahuR na mailaa hoi ||
verses.translation: When the mind is cleaned with the jewel of spiritual wisdom, it does not become dirty again.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag saahib man vasai tab lag bighan na hoi ||
verses.translation: As long as the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, no obstacles are encountered.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak sir dhe chhuTeeaai man tan saachaa soi ||4||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, giving one's head, one is emancipated, and the mind and body become true. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jogee jugat naam niramail taa kai mail na raatee ||
verses.translation: The Yogi who is joined to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is pure; he is not stained by even a particle of dirt.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਗਤਿ ਬੀਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: preetam naath sadhaa sach sa(n)ge janam maran gat beetee ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord, his Beloved, is always with him; the rounds of birth and death are ended for him. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gusaiee teraa kahaa naam kaise jaatee ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, what is Your Name, and what is it like?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਉ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tau bheetar mahal bulaaveh poochhau baat nira(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If You summon me into the Mansion of Your Presence, I will ask You, how I can become one with You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: brahaman braham giaan isanaanee har gun pooje paatee ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who takes his cleansing bath in the spiritual wisdom of God, and whose leaf-offerings in worship are the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eko naam ek naarain tirabhavan ekaa jotee ||2||
verses.translation: The One Name, the One Lord, and His One Light pervade the three worlds. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਡੰਡੀ ਇਹੁ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਬਾ ਤੋਲਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa dda(n)ddee ih ghaT chhaabaa tolau naam ajaachee ||
verses.translation: My tongue is the balance of the scale, and this heart of mine is the pan of the scale; I weigh the immeasurable Naam.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eko haaT saahu sabhanaa sir vanajaare ik bhaatee ||3||
verses.translation: There is one store, and one banker above all; the merchants deal in the one commodity. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੋਵੈ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਬੇੜੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhovai sire satiguroo nibeRe so boojhai jis ek liv laagee jeeahu rahai nibharaatee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru saves us at both ends; he alone understands, who is lovingly focused on the One Lord; his inner being remains free of doubt.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabadh vasaae bharam chukaae sadhaa sevak dhin raatee ||4||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad abides within, and doubt is ended, for those who constantly serve, day and night. ||4||

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਰਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਨਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar gagan gagan par gorakh taa kaa agam guroo pun vaasee ||
verses.translation: Above is the sky of the mind, and beyond this sky is the Lord, the Protector of the World; the Inaccessible Lord God; the Guru abides there as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee baahar ghar eko naanak bhiaa udhaasee ||5||11||
verses.translation: According to the Word of the Guru's Teachings, what is outside is the same as what is inside the home of the self. Nanak has become a detached renunciate. ||5||11||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: raag maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Raag Maaroo, First Mehla, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis jaagai needh na sovai ||
verses.translation: Day and night, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps or dreams.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jaanai jis vedhan hovai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows this, who feels the pain of separation from God.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ ਲਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵੈਦੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prem ke kaan lage tan bheetar vaidh k jaanai kaaree jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: My body is pierced through with the arrow of love. How can any physician know the cure? ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no saachaa sifatee laae || gurmukh virale kisai bujhaae ||
verses.translation: Rare is that one, who as Gurmukh, understands, and whom the True Lord links to His Praise.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kee saar soiee jaanai j a(n)mirat kaa vaapaaree jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone appreciates the value of the Ambsosial Nectar, who deals in this Ambrosia. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pir setee dhan prem rachaae ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is in love with her Husband Lord;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਥਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh tathaa chit laae ||
verses.translation: she focuses her consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj setee dhan kharee suhelee tirasanaa tikhaa nivaaree jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is joyously embellished with intuitive ease; her hunger and thirst are taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੋੜੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa toRe bharam chukaae ||
verses.translation: Tear down skepticism and dispel your doubt;

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje sifatee dhanakh chaRaae ||
verses.translation: with your intuition, draw the bow of the Praise of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh marai man maare su(n)dhar jogaadhaaree jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conquer and subdue your mind; take the support of Yoga - Union with the beautiful Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jaliaa manahu visaare ||
verses.translation: Burnt by egotism, one forgets the Lord from his mind.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਖੜਗ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jam pur vajeh khaRag karaare ||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, he is attacked with massive swords.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਈ ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ab kai kahiaai naam na miliee too sahu jeeaRe bhaaree jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: Then, even if he asks for it, he will not receive the Lord's Name; O soul, you shall suffer terrible punishment. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਖਿਆਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa paveh khiaalee ||
verses.translation: You are distracted by thoughts of Maya and worldly attachment.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਫਾਸਹਿਗਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: jam pur faasahigaa jam jaalee ||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, you will be caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: het ke ba(n)dhan toR na saakeh taa jam kare khuaaree jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: You cannot break free from the bondage of loving attachment, and so the Messenger of Death will torture you. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa hau karataa naa mai keeaa ||
verses.translation: I have done nothing; I am doing nothing now.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam satigur dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jis too dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa naanak saran tumaaree jeeau ||6||1||12||
verses.translation: What other efforts can anyone make, when You bestow Your blessing? Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||6||1||12||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਹ ਬੈਸਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh baisaaleh teh baisaa suaamee jeh bhejeh teh jaavaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever You seat me, there I sit, O my Lord and Master; wherever You send me, there I go.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਥਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh nagaree meh eko raajaa sabhe pavit heh thaavaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the entire village, there is only One King; all places are sacred. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa dheh vasaa sach gaavaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, while I dwell in this body, let me sing Your True Praises,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te sahaje sahaj samaavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that I may intuitively merge with You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਏਈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa kichh aapas te jaaniaa eiee sagal vikaaraa ||
verses.translation: He thinks that good and bad deeds come from himself; this is the source of all evil.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eih furamaiaa khasam kaa hoaa varatai ih sa(n)saaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever happens in this world is only by the Order of our Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਬਲ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree dhaat sabal kaheeat hai i(n)dhree kis te hoiee ||
verses.translation: Sexual desires are so strong and compelling; where has this sexual desire come from?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape khel karai sabh karataa aaisaa boojhai koiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; how rare are those who realize this. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ek liv laagee dhubidhaa tadhe binaasee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is lovingly focused on the One Lord, and then, duality is ended.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaanaa so sat kar maaniaa kaaTee jam kee faasee ||4||
verses.translation: Whatever is in harmony with His Will, he accepts as True; the noose of Death is loosened from around his neck. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak lekhaa maagai kavanaa jaa chookaa man abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, who can call him to account, when the egotistical pride of his mind has been silenced?

verses.original: ਤਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: taas taas dharam rai japat hai pe sache kee saranaa ||5||1||
verses.translation: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma is intimidated and afraid of him; he has entered the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa naa theeaai nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation no longer happens, when one dwells in the home of the self within.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach khajaanaa bakhasiaa aape jaanai soi ||1||
verses.translation: He bestowed the Blessing of His treasure of truth; only He Himself knows. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਚੇਤਿ ਤੂ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: e man har jeeau chet too manahu taj vikaar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remember the Dear Lord, and abandon the corruption of your mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh dhiaai too sach lagee piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad; focus lovingly on the Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai naavahu bhuliaa fir hath kithaauoo na pai ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Name in this world, shall not find any place of rest anywhere else.

verses.original: ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jonee sabh bhavaieean bisaTaa maeh samai ||2||
verses.translation: He shall wander in all sorts of reincarnations, and rot away in manure. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur paiaa poorab likhiaa mai ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, according to my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin sachee bhagat kar sachaa le milai ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, I practice true devotional worship; I am united with the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT sabh saajeean aape nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: He Himself fashioned the entire universe; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vaddiaaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious and great; as He pleases, He bestows His Blessings. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਅਬ ਤੂ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pichhale guneh bakhasai jeeau ab too maarag pai ||
verses.translation: Please forgive my past mistakes, O my Dear Lord; now, please place me on the Path.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kee charanee laag rahaa vichahu aap gavai ||1||
verses.translation: I remain attached to the Lord's Feet, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gurmukh naam har dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa har charanee laag rahaa ik man ekai bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remain attached forever to the Lord's Feet, single-mindedly, with love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naa mai jaat na pat hai naa mai theh na thaau ||
verses.translation: I have no social status or honor; I have no place or home.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh bhedh bhram kaTiaa gur naam dheeaa samajhai ||2||
verses.translation: Pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, my doubts have been cut away. The Guru has inspired me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man laalach karadhaa firai laalach laagaa jai ||
verses.translation: This mind wanders around, driven by greed, totally attached to greed.

verses.original: ਧੰਧੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhai kooR viaapiaa jam pur choTaa khai ||3||
verses.translation: He is engrossed in false pursuits; he shall endure beatings in the City of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kichh aape aap hai dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God Himself Himself is all-in-all. There is no other at all.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion gurmukhaa sukh hoi ||4||3||
verses.translation: He bestows the treasure of devotional worship, and the Gurmukhs abide in peace. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਟੋਲਿ ਲਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach rate se Tol lahu se virale sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Seek and find those who are imbued with Truth; they are so rare in this world.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin miliaa mukh ujalaa jap naam muraar ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with them, one's face becomes radiant and bright, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa saachaa saahib ridhai samaal ||
verses.translation: O Baba, contemplate and cherish the True Lord and Master within your heart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apanaa puchh dhekh leh vakhar bhaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Seek out and see, and ask your True Guru, and obtain the true commodity. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਦੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik sachaa sabh sevadhee dhur bhaag milaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: All serve the One True Lord; through pre-ordained destiny, they meet Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mile se na vichhuReh paaveh sach soi ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs merge with Him, and will not be separated from Him again; they attain the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhagatee saar na jaananee manmukh bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: Some do not appreciate the value of devotional worship; the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: onaa vich aap varatadhaa karanaa kichhoo na jai ||3||
verses.translation: They are fillled with self-conceit; they cannot accomplish anything. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਲੇ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis naal jor na chaliee khale keechai aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Stand and offer your prayer, to the One who cannot be moved by force.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam man vasai taa sun kare saabaas ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the mind of the Gurmukh; hearing his prayer, the Lord applauds him. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਤੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo te seetal kare manoorahu ka(n)chan hoi ||
verses.translation: He transforms the burning desert into a cool oasis; he transmutes rusted iron into gold.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so saachaa saalaaheeaai tis jevadd avar na koi ||1||
verses.translation: So praise the True Lord; there is none other as great as He is. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere man anadhin dhiaai har naau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, night and day, meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bachan araadh too anadhin gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh eko jaaneeaai jaa satigur dhei bujhai ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, one comes to know the One Lord, when the True Guru instructs him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਦੂ ਏਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so satigur saalaaheeaai jidhoo eh sojhee pai ||2||
verses.translation: Praise the True Guru, who imparts this understanding. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur chhodd dhoojai lage kiaa karan agai jai ||
verses.translation: Those who forsake the True Guru, and attach themselves to duality - what will they do when they go to the world hereafter?

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jam pur badhe maare'eh bahutee milai sajai ||3||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they will be beaten. They will be punished severely. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh veparavaahu hai naa tis til na tamai ||
verses.translation: My God is independent and self-sufficient; he does not have even an iota of greed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak tis saranaiee bhaj pau aape bakhas milai ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, run to His Sanctuary; granting His forgiveness, He merges us into Himself. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: japio naam suk janak gur bachanee har har saran pare ||
verses.translation: Suk-deva and Janak meditated on the Naam; following the Guru's Teachings, they sought the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸੁਦਾਮੇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaaladh bha(n)j sudhaame milio bhagatee bhai tare ||
verses.translation: God met Sudama and removed his poverty; through loving devotional worship, he crossed over.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal har naam kirataarath gurmukh kirapaa kare ||1||
verses.translation: God is the Lover of His devotees; the Lord's Name is fufilling; God showers His Mercy on the Gurmukhs. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam japat udhare ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will be saved.

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhraoo prahilaadh bidhar dhaasee sut gurmukh naam tare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dhroo, Prahlaad and Bidar the slave-girl's son, became Gurmukh, and through the Naam, crossed over. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kalajug naam pradhaan padhaarath bhagat janaa udhare ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Naam is the supreme wealth; it saves the humble devotees.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਚਮਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naamaa jaidheau kabeer tiralochan sabh dhokh ge chamare ||
verses.translation: All the faults of Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the leather-worker were covered.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam lage se udhare sabh kilabikh paap Tare ||2||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh, and remain attached to the Naam, are saved; all their sins are washed off. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo naam japai aparaadhee sabh tin ke dhokh parahare ||
verses.translation: Whoever chants the Naam, all his sins and mistakes are taken away.

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਰਵਤ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: besuaa ravat ajaamal udhario mukh bolai naarain narahare ||
verses.translation: Ajaamal, who had sex with prostitites, was saved, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam japat ugrasain gat paiee toR ba(n)dhan mukat kare ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, Ugar Sain obtained salvation; his bonds were broken, and he was liberated. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau aap anugrahu keeaa har a(n)geekaar kare ||
verses.translation: God Himself takes pity on His humble servants, and makes them His own.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak paij rakhai meraa govidh saran pare udhare ||
verses.translation: My Lord of the Universe saves the honor of His servants; those who seek His Sanctuary are saved.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree ur dhario naam hare ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered servant Nanak with His Mercy; he has enshrined the Lord's Name within his heart. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sidh samaadh japio liv laiee saadhik mun japiaa ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi meditate on Him; they are lovingly focused on Him. The seekers and the silent sages meditate on Him as well.

verses.original: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jatee satee sa(n)tokhee dhiaaiaa mukh i(n)dhraadhik raviaa ||
verses.translation: The celibates, the true and contented beings meditate on Him; Indra and the other gods chant His Name with their mouths.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇ ਭਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saran pare japio te bhaae gurmukh paar piaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who seek His Sanctuary meditate on Him; they become Gurmukh and swim across. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam japat tariaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and cross over.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)naa jaT baalameek baTavaaraa gurmukh paar piaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dhanna the farmer, and Balmik the highway robber, became Gurmukh, and crossed over. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬੇ ਜਪਿਓ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਪੁਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar gan ga(n)dharabe japio rikh bapurai har gaiaa ||
verses.translation: Angels, men, heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on Him; even the humble Rishis sing of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਪਿਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kar brahamai dhevee japio mukh har har naam japiaa ||
verses.translation: Shiva, Brahma and the goddess Lakhshmi, meditate, and chant with their mouths the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har naam jinaa man bheenaa te gurmukh paar piaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are drenched with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as Gurmukh, cross over. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koT koT tetees dhiaaio har japatiaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Millions and millions, three hundred thirty million gods meditate on Him; there is no end to those who meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan simirat har japiaa mukh pa(n)ddit har gaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees meditate on the Lord; the Pandits, the religious scholars, sing the Lord's Praises as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam rasaal jinaa man vasiaa te gurmukh paar piaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam, the source of nectar - as Gurmukh, they cross over. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: anat tara(n)gee naam jin japiaa mai ganat na kar sakiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Naam in endless waves - I cannot even count their number.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh kirapaa kare thai paae jo har prabh man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe bestows His Mercy, and those who are pleasing to the Mind of the Lord God, find their place.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur dhaar kirapaa har naam dhiraRaio jan naanak naam liaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: The Guru, granting His Grace, implants the Lord's Name within; servant Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam nidhaan lai gurmat har pat pai ||
verses.translation: Take the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and the Lord shall bless you with honor.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat naal chaladhaa har a(n)te le chhaddai ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, the Lord goes with you; in the end, He shall deliver you.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਵਘਟ ਗਲੀਆ ਭੀੜੀਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jithai avaghaT galeeaa bheeReeaa tithai har har mukat karai ||1||
verses.translation: Where the path is difficult and the street is narrow, there the Lord shall liberate you. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere satiguraa mai har har naam dhiraRai ||
verses.translation: O my True Guru, implant within me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapo mai har bin avar na mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my mother, father, child and relative; I have none other than the Lord, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mai har birahee har naam hai koiee aan milaavai mai ||
verses.translation: I feel the pains of love and yearning for the Lord, and the Name of the Lord. If only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis aagai mai jodhaRee meraa preetam dhei milai ||
verses.translation: I bow in humble devotion to one who inspires me to meet with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh dhiaal prabh har mele ddil na pai ||2||
verses.translation: The almighty and merciful True Guru unites me with the Lord God instantaneously. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin har har naam na chetio se bhaagaheen mar jai ||
verses.translation: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate, and are slaughtered.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oi fir fir jon bhavaie'eeh mar ja(n)meh aavai jai ||
verses.translation: They wander in reincarnation, again and again; they die, and are re-born, and continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi jam dhar badhe maare'eh har dharageh milai sajai ||3||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are cruelly beaten, and punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: too prabh ham saranaagatee mo kau mel laih har rai ||
verses.translation: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary; O my Sovereign Lord King, please unite me with Yourself.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaar kirapaa jagajeevanaa gur satigur kee saranai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Life of the World, please shower me with Your Mercy; grant me the Sanctuary of the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aap dhiaal hoi jan naanak har melai ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord, becoming merciful, has blended servant Nanak with Himself. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਸਾਇਦਾ ਕੋ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau poo(n)jee naam dhasaidhaa ko dhase har dhan raas ||
verses.translation: I inquire about the commodity of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Is there anyone who can show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord?

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau tis viTahu khan kha(n)neeaai mai mele har prabh paas ||
verses.translation: I cut myself into pieces, and make myself a sacrifice to that one who leads me to meet my Lord God.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਜਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai a(n)tar prem pira(n)m kaa kiau sajan milai milaas ||1||
verses.translation: I am filled with the Love of my Beloved; how can I meet my Friend, and merge with Him? ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa mitraa mai har har naam dhan raas ||
verses.translation: O my beloved friend, my mind, I take the wealth, the capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai naam dhiraRaiaa har dheerak har saabaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Lord is my support - I celebrate the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har aap milai gur mai dhase har dhan raas ||
verses.translation: O my Guru, please unite me with the Lord, Har, Har; show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਜਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur prem na labhiee jan vekhahu man nirajaas ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, love does not well up; see this, and know it in your mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har gur vich aap rakhiaa har mele gur saabaas ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord has installed Himself within the Guru; so praise the Guru, who unites us with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: saagar bhagat bha(n)ddaar har poore satigur paas ||
verses.translation: The ocean, the treasure of devotional worship of the Lord, rests with the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦੇਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tuThaa khol dhei mukh gurmukh har paragaas ||
verses.translation: When it pleases the True Guru, He opens the treasure, and and the Gurmukhs are illuminated by the Lord's Light.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਖ ਮੁਈਆ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhaag vihooniaa tikh muieeaa ka(n)dhee paas ||3||
verses.translation: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs die of thirst, on the very bank of the river. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhaataa dhaataar hai hau maagau dhaan gur paas ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Great Giver; I beg for this gift from the Guru,

verses.original: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: chiree vichhu(n)naa mel prabh mai man tan vaddaRee aas ||
verses.translation: that He may unite me with God, from whom I was separated for so long! This is the great hope of my mind and body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur bhaavai sun benatee jan naanak kee aradhaas ||4||2||4||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, O my Guru, please listen to my prayer; this is servant Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa sunai prabh gurmat har ridhai samaanee ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please preach Your sermon to me. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is merged into my heart.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap har har kathaa vaddabhaageeaa har utam padh nirabaanee ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, O very fortunate ones; the Lord shall bless you with the most sublime status of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa man parateet hai gur poorai naam samaanee ||1||
verses.translation: The minds of the Gurmukhs are filled with faith; through the Perfect Guru, they merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: man mere mai har har kathaa man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa nit sadhaa kar gurmukh akath kahaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Continually and forever, speak the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, speak the Unspoken Speech. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan khoj dda(n)ddoliaa kiau paieeaai akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: I have searched through and through my mind and body; how can I attain this Unspoken Speech?

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil paiaa sun akath kathaa man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found it; listening to the Unspoken Speech, my mind is pleased.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: merai man tan naam adhaar har mai mele purakh sujaanee ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the Support of my mind and body; I am united with the all-knowing Primal Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur purakhai purakh milai prabh mil suratee surat samaanee ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Primal Being, has united me with the Primal Lord God. My consciousness has merged into the supreme consciousness.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur seviaa har paiaa sughaR sujaanee ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I serve the Guru, and I have found my Lord, all-wise and all-knowing.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhaag vihooniaa tin dhukhee rain vihaanee ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are very unfortunate; they pass their life-night in misery and pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham jaachik dheen prabh teriaa mukh dheejai a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: I am just a meek beggar at Your Door, God; please, place the Ambrosial Word of Your Bani in my mouth.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa mitr prabh har melahu sughaR sujaanee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is my friend; He unites me with my all-wise, all-knowing Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saranaagatee kar kirapaa naam samaanee ||4||3||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; grant Your Grace, and merge me into Your Name. ||4||3||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਲਗਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaau lagaa bairaageeaa vaddabhaagee har man raakh ||
verses.translation: Detached from the world, I am in love with the Lord; by great good fortune, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)gat saradhaa uoopajai gur sabadhee har ras chaakh ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, faith has welled up within me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I taste the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh man tan hariaa hoiaa gurbaanee har gun bhaakh ||1||
verses.translation: My mind and body have totally blossomed forth; through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: man piaariaa mitraa har har naam ras chaakh ||
verses.translation: O my beloved mind, my friend, taste the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har paiaa halat palat pat raakh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, I have found the Lord, who saves my honor, here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaaieeaai har keerat gurmukh chaakh ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, taste the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: tan dharatee har beejeeaai vich sa(n)gat har prabh raakh ||
verses.translation: Plant the seed of the Lord in the body-farm. The Lord God is enshrined within the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har har naam hai gur poorai har ras chaakh ||2||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Through the Perfect Guru, taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh tirasanaa bhar rahe man aasaa dheh dhis bahu laakh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are filled with hunger and thirst; their minds run around in the ten directions, hoping for great wealth.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhirag jeevadhe vich bisaTaa manmukh raakh ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, their life is cursed; the manmukhs are stuck in manure.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi aaveh jaeh bhavaie'eeh bahu jonee dhuraga(n)dh bhaakh ||3||
verses.translation: They come and go, and are consigned to wander through uncounted incarnations, eating stinking rot. ||3||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: traeh traeh saranaagatee har dhiaa dhaar prabh raakh ||
verses.translation: Begging, imploring, I seek Your Sanctuary; Lord, shower me with Your Mercy, and save me, God.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)gat melaap kar har naam milai pat saakh ||
verses.translation: Lead me to join the Society of the Saints, and bless me with the honor and glory of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhan paiaa jan naanak gurmat bhaakh ||4||4||6||
verses.translation: I have obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; servant Nanak chants the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||4||4||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship to the Lord, Har, Har, is an overflowing treasure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam kare nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is emancipated by the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare meraa suaamee so har ke gun gaavai jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by the Mercy of my Lord and Master sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa kare banavaalee ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, take pity on me,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: har hiradhai sadhaa sadhaa samaalee ||
verses.translation: that within my heart, I may dwell upon You, Lord, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu mere jeeaRe jap har har naam chhaddaavai jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar a(n)mrit har naau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the ocean of peace.

verses.original: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gat jan jaachai har dheh pasaau ||
verses.translation: The beggar begs for it; O Lord, please bless him, in Your kindness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har sat sat sadhaa har sat har sat merai man bhaavai jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: True, True is the Lord; the Lord is forever True; the True Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਹਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: nave chhidhr sraveh apavitraa ||
verses.translation: The nine holes pour out filth.

verses.original: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bol har naam pavitr sabh kitaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are all purified and sanctified.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je har suprasa(n)n hovai meraa suaamee har simarat mal leh jaavai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: When my Lord and Master is totally pleased, He leads the mortal to meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and then his filth is taken away. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh bikham hai bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya is terribly treacherous.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiau tareeaai dhutar sa(n)saaree ||
verses.translation: How can one cross over the difficult world-ocean?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur bohith dhei prabh saachaa jap har har paar la(n)ghaavai jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: The True Lord bestows the boat of the True Guru; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too sarabatr teraa sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: You are everywhere; all are Yours.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo too kareh soiee prabh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, God, that alone comes to pass.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gun gaavai bechaaraa har bhaavai har thai paavai jeeau ||5||1||7||
verses.translation: Poor servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; as it pleases the Lord, He bestows His approval. ||5||1||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu man mere ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kilavikh kaaTai har tere ||
verses.translation: The Lord shall eradicate all your sins.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dhan raakhahu har dhan sa(n)chahu har chaladhiaa naal sakhaiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Treasure the Lord's wealth, and gather in the Lord's wealth; when you depart in the end, the Lord shall go along with you as your only friend and companion. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare so dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nit har jap jaapai jap har sukh paavai ||
verses.translation: He continually chants the Lord's Chant; meditating on the Lord, one finds peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ras aavai jap har har paar la(n)ghaiee jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau nira(n)kaar sat naam ||
verses.translation: The fearless, formless Lord - the Name is Truth.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jag meh sresaT uootam kaam ||
verses.translation: To chant it is the most sublime and exalted activity in this world.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਠੇਹ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhusaman dhoot jamakaal Theh maarau har sevak neR na jaiee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Doing so, the Messenger of Death, the evil enemy, is killed. Death does not even approach the Lord's servant. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis upar har kaa man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is satisfied with the Lord

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so sevak chahu jug chahu ku(n)T jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: that servant is known throughout the four ages, in all four directions.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je us kaa buraa kahai koiee paapee tis jamaka(n)kar khaiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: If some sinner speaks evil of him, the Messenger of Death chews him up. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh ek nira(n)jan karataa ||
verses.translation: The One Pure Creator Lord is in all.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਚਲਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kar kar vekhai apane chalataa ||
verses.translation: He stages all His wondrous plays, and watches them.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis har raakhai tis kaun maarai jis karataa aap chhaddaiee jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: Who can kill that person, whom the Lord has saved? The Creator Lord Himself delivers him. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau anadhin naam liee karataare ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Creator Lord, night and day.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਸਭੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin sevak bhagat sabhe nisataare ||
verses.translation: He saves all His servants and devotees.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: dhas aTh chaar vedh sabh poochhahu jan naanak naam chhaddaiee jeeau ||5||2||8||
verses.translation: Consult the eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas; O servant Nanak, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, will deliver you. ||5||2||8||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddarapai dharat akaas nakhayetraa sir uoopar amar karaaraa ||
verses.translation: The earth, the Akaashic ethers and the stars abide in the Fear of God. The almighty Order of the Lord is over the heads of all.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਡਰਪੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paun paanee baisa(n)tar ddarapai ddarapai i(n)dhr bichaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Wind, water and fire abide in the Fear of God; poor Indra abides in the Fear of God as well. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa nirabhau baat sunee ||
verses.translation: I have heard one thing, that the One Lord alone is fearless.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so sukheeaa so sadhaa suhelaa jo gur mil gai gunee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is at peace, and he alone is embellished forever, who meets with the Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਹਧਾਰ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਡਰਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhehadhaar ar dhevaa ddarapeh sidh saadhik ddar muiaa ||
verses.translation: The embodied and the divine beings abide in the Fear of God. The Siddhas and seekers die in the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh mar mar janame fir fir jonee joiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The 8.4 millions species of beings die and die, being born over and over again. They are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਸੁ ਸਾਤਕੁ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raajas saatak taamas ddarapeh kete roop upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who embody the energies of sattva-white light, raajas-red passion, and taamas-black darkness, abide in the Fear of God, along with the many created forms.

verses.original: ਛਲ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਇਹ ਕਉਲਾ ਡਰਪੈ ਅਤਿ ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhal bapuree ieh kaulaa ddarapai at ddarapai dharam raiaa ||3||
verses.translation: This miserable deceiver Maya abides in the Fear of God; the Righteous Judge of Dharma is utterly afraid of Him as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਡਰਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree ddareh biaapee bin ddar karanaihaaraa ||
verses.translation: The entire expanse of the Universe is in the Fear of God; only the Creator Lord is without this Fear.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bhagatan kaa sa(n)gee bhagat soheh dharabaaraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God is the companion of His devotees; His devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਂਚ ਬਰਖ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਮਰ ਅਟਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paa(n)ch barakh ko anaath dhraoo baarik har simarat amar aTaare ||
verses.translation: The five year old orphan boy Dhroo, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, became stationary and permanent.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: putr het naarain kahio jamaka(n)kar maar bidhaare ||1||
verses.translation: For the sake of his son, Ajaamal called out, ""O Lord, Naaraayan"", who struck down and killed the Messenger of Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਅਗਨਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur kete aganat udhaare ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has saved many, countless beings.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh dheen alap mat niragun pario saran dhuaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am meek, with little or no understanding, and unworthy; I seek protection at the Lord's Door. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਸੁਪਚਾਰੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਬਧਿਕ ਤਰੇ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: baalameek supachaaro tario badhik tare bichaare ||
verses.translation: Baalmeek the outcaste was saved, and the poor hunter was saved as well.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਗਜਪਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh man maeh araadhio gajapat paar utaare ||2||
verses.translation: The elephant remembered the Lord in his mind for an instant, and so was carried across. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੀਨੀ ਰਖਿਆ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੈ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: keenee rakhiaa bhagat prahilaadhai haranaakhas nakheh bidhaare ||
verses.translation: He saved His devotee Prahlaad, and tore Harnaakhash with his nails.

verses.original: ਬਿਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਜਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bidhar dhaasee sut bhio puneetaa sagale kul ujaare ||3||
verses.translation: Bidar, the son of a slave-girl, was purified, and all his generations were redeemed. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਪਰਾਧ ਬਤਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kavan paraadh bataavau apune mithiaa moh maganaare ||
verses.translation: What sins of mine should I speak of? I am intoxicated with false emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਆਇਓ ਸਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaio saam naanak oT har kee leejai bhujaa pasaare ||4||2||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord; please, reach out and take me into Your embrace. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਤ ਨਵਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vit navit bhramio bahu bhaatee anik jatan kar dhaae ||
verses.translation: For the sake of riches, I wandered around in so many ways; I rushed around, making all sorts of efforts.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਹਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo karam ke'ee hau haumai te te bhe ajaae ||1||
verses.translation: The deeds I did in egotism and pride, have all been done in vain. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਦਿਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: avar dhin kaahoo kaaj na laae ||
verses.translation: Other days are of no use to me;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so dhin mo kau dheejai prabh jeeau jaa dhin har jas gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
