verses.translation: please bless me with those days, O Dear God, on which I may sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr gireh dhekh pasaaraa is hee meh urajhaae ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon children, spouse, household and possessions, one is entangled in these.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਚਾਖਿ ਭਏ ਉਦਮਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa madh chaakh bhe udhamaate har har kabahu na gaae ||2||
verses.translation: Tasting the wine of Maya, one is intoxicated, and never sings of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh khojee bahu parakaaraa bin sa(n)tan nahee paae ||
verses.translation: In this way, I have examined lots of methods, but without the Saints, it is not found.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum dhaataar vadde prabh sa(n)mrath maagan kau dhaan aae ||3||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver, the great and almighty God; I have come to beg a gift from You. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tiaagio sagalaa maan mahataa dhaas ren saranaae ||
verses.translation: Abandoning all pride and self-importance, I have sought the Sanctuary of the dust of the feet of the Lord's slave.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਏਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har mil bhe ekai mahaa ana(n)dh sukh paae ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meeting with the Lord, I have become one with Him; I have found supreme bliss and peace. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਥਾਨ ਧੀਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavan thaan dheerio hai naamaa kavan basat aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: In what place is the Name established? Where does egotism dwell?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਛੋਹਿਓ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kavan chihan sun uoopar chhohio mukh te sun kar gaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: What injury have you suffered, listening to abuse from someone else's mouth? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu re too kaun kahaa te aaio ||
verses.translation: Listen: who are you, and where did you come from?

verses.original: ਏਤੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੇਤੀਕ ਮੁਦਤਿ ਚਲਤੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: etee na jaanau keteek mudhat chalate khabar na paio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You don't even know how long you will stay here; you have no hint of when you shall leave. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਪਵਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sahan seel pavan ar paanee basudhaa khimaa nibharaate ||
verses.translation: Wind and water have patience and tolerance; the earth has compassion and forgiveness, no doubt.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਦੁਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat mil bhio sa(n)jogaa in meh kavan dhuraate ||2||
verses.translation: The union of the five tattvas - the five elements - has brought you into being. Which of these is evil? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin rach rachiaa purakh bidhaatai naale haumai paiee ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, formed your form; He also burdened you with egotism.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਓਹਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam maran us hee kau hai re ohaa aavai jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: He alone is born and dies; He alone comes and goes. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baran chihan naahee kichh rachanaa mithiaa sagal pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Nothing of the color and the form of the creation shall remain; the entire expanse is transitory.

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਬ ਖੇਲੁ ਉਝਾਰੈ ਤਬ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak jab khel ujhaarai tab ekai eka(n)kaaraa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, when He brings His play to its close, then only the One, the One Lord remains. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਬੀਓ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: maan moh ar lobh vikaaraa beeo cheet na ghaalio ||
verses.translation: Pride, emotional attachment, greed and corruption are gone; I have not placed anything else, other than the Lord, within my consciousness.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਜੇ ਲਾਦਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam ratan gunaa har banaje laadh vakhar lai chaalio ||1||
verses.translation: I have purchased the jewel of the Naam and the Glorious Praises of the Lord; loading this merchandise, I have set out on my journey. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਓੜਕਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kee oRak nibahee preet ||
verses.translation: The love which the Lord's servant feels for the Lord lasts forever.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਚਲਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat saahib sevio apanaa chalate raakhio cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In my life, I served my Lord and Master, and as I depart, I keep Him enshrined in my consciousness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee aagiaa keenee Thaakur tis te mukh nahee morio ||
verses.translation: I have not turned my face away from my Lord and Master's Command.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਕਉ ਦਉਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaj ana(n)dh rakhio gireh bheetar uTh uaahoo kau dhaurio ||2||
verses.translation: He fills my household with celestial peace and bliss; if He asks me to leave, I leave at once. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaa meh bhookh soiee kar sookhaa sog harakh nahee jaanio ||
verses.translation: When I am under the Lord's Command, I find even hunger pleasurable; I know no difference between sorrow and joy.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਮਾਥੈ ਲੇ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo jo hukam bhio saahib kaa so maathai le maanio ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever the Command of my Lord and Master is, I bow my forehead and accept it. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਵਰੇ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal Thaakur sevak kau savare halat palaataa ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master has become merciful to His servant; He has embellished both this world and the next.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n sevak safal oh aaiaa jin naanak khasam pachhaataa ||4||5||
verses.translation: Blessed is that servant, and fruitful is his birth; O Nanak, he realizes his Lord and Master. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੁਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khuliaa karam kirapaa bhiee Thaakur keeratan har har gaiee ||
verses.translation: Good karma has dawned for me - my Lord and Master has become merciful. I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sram thaakaa paae bisraamaa miT giee sagalee dhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: My struggle is ended; I have found peace and tranquility. All my wanderings have ceased. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh jeevan padhavee paiee ||
verses.translation: Now, I have obtained the state of eternal life.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aaio man purakh bidhaataa sa(n)tan kee saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has come into my conscious mind; I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਿਵਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh nivaare nivare sagal bairaiee ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are eradicated; all my enemies are eliminated.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadh hajoor haajar hai naajar kateh na bhio dhooraiee ||2||
verses.translation: He is always ever-present, here and now, watching over me; He is never far away. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh seetal saradhaa sabh pooree hoe sa(n)t sahaiee ||
verses.translation: In peace and cool tranquility, my faith has been totally fulfilled; the Saints are my Helpers and Support.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paavan patit ke'ee khin bheetar mahimaa kathan na jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: He has purified the sinners in an instant; I cannot express His Glorious Praises. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਖੋਏ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe sagal bhai khoe gobidh charan oTaiee ||
verses.translation: I have become fearless; all fear has departed. The feet of the Lord of the Universe are my only Shelter.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak jas gaavai Thaakur kaa rain dhinas liv laiee ||4||6||
verses.translation: Nanak sings the Praises of his Lord and Master; night and day, he is lovingly focused on Him. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo samarath sarab gun naik tis kau kabahu na gaavas re ||
verses.translation: He is all-powerful, the Master of all virtues, but you never sing of Him!

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਉਆ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhodd jai khin bheetar taa kau uaa kau fir fir dhaavas re ||1||
verses.translation: You shall have to leave all this in an instant, but again and again, you chase after it. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਸਮਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apune prabh kau kiau na samaaras re ||
verses.translation: Why do you not contemplate your God?

verses.original: ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਜਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bairee sa(n)g ra(n)g ras rachiaa tis siau jeearaa jaaras re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are entangled in association with your enemies, and the enjoyment of pleasures; your soul is burning up with them! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai naam suniaai jam chhoddai taa kee saran na paavas re ||
verses.translation: Hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death will release you, and yet, you do not enter His Sanctuary!

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਿਆਲ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਟਿਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaadd dhei siaal bapure kau taa kee oT Tikaavas re ||2||
verses.translation: Turn out this wretched jackal, and seek the Shelter of that God. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਭਵ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa jaas sunat bhav tareeaai taa siau ra(n)g na laavas re ||
verses.translation: Praising Him, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and yet, you have not fallen in love with Him!

verses.original: ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਟਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: thoree baat alap supane kee bahur bahur aTakaavas re ||3||
verses.translation: This meager, short-lived dream, this thing - you are engrossed in it, over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhio prasaadh kirapaa nidh Thaakur sa(n)tasa(n)g pat paiee ||
verses.translation: When our Lord and Master, the ocean of mercy, grants His Grace, one finds honor in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak trai gun bhram chhooTaa jau prabh bhe sahaiee ||4||7||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am rid of the illusion of the three-phased Maya, when God becomes my help and support. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਦੁਲਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai tis te kahaa dhulaario ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; what can anyone hide from Him?

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਝਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hasat paav jhare khin bheetar agan sa(n)g lai jaario ||1||
verses.translation: Your hands and feet will fall off in an instant, when you are burnt in the fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੂੜੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: mooRe tai man te raam bisaario ||
verses.translation: You fool, you have forgotten the Lord from your mind!

verses.original: ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: loon khai kareh haraamakhoree pekhat nain bidhaario ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You eat His salt, and then you are untrue to Him; before your very eyes, you shall be torn apart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: asaadh rog upajio tan bheetar Tarat na kaahoo Taario ||
verses.translation: The incurable disease has arisen in your body; it cannot be removed or overcome.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: prabh bisarat mahaa dhukh paio ih naanak tat beechaario ||2||8||
verses.translation: Forgetting God, one endures utter agony; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||2||8||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal prabh raakhe cheet ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the lotus feet of God within my consciousness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaaveh neetaa neet ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, continually, continuously.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na kouoo ||
verses.translation: There is none other than Him at all.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਊ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t hai souoo ||1||
verses.translation: He alone exists, in the beginning, in the middle, and in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kee oT aape aap ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Shelter of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai vas hai sagal sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The entire universe is under His control.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap aap nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself, the Formless Lord, is Himself by Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹਿਓ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gahio saachaa soi ||
verses.translation: Nanak holds tight to that True Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: sukh paiaa fir dhookh na hoi ||2||9||
verses.translation: He has found peace, and shall never suffer pain again. ||2||9||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਥ ॥
verses.translit: praan sukhadhaataa jeea sukhadhaataa tum kaahe bisaario agiaanath ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of peace to the breath of life, the Giver of life to the soul; how can you forget Him, you ignorant person?

verses.original: ਹੋਛਾ ਮਦੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hochhaa madh chaakh hoe tum baavar dhulabh janam akaarath ||1||
verses.translation: You taste the weak, insipid wine, and you have gone insane. You have uselessly wasted this precious human life. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਐਸੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਆਨਥ ॥
verses.translit: re nar aaisee kareh iaanath ||
verses.translation: O man, such is the foolishness you practice.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਤੂ ਭੂਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਨਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taj saara(n)gadhar bhram too bhoolaa moh lapaTio dhaasee sa(n)g saanath ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renouncing the Lord, the Support of the earth, you wander, deluded by doubt; you are engrossed in emotional attachment, associating with Maya, the slave-girl. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਥ ॥
verses.translit: dharaneedhar tiaag neech kul seveh hau hau karat bihaavath ||
verses.translation: Abandoning the Lord, the Support of the earth, you serve her of lowly ancestry, and you pass you life acting egotistically.

verses.original: ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਕਹਾਵਥ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: fokaT karam kareh agiaanee manmukh a(n)dh kahaavath ||2||
verses.translation: You do useless deeds, you ignorant person; this is why you are called a blind, self-willed manmukh. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ਅਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਾਨਥ ॥
verses.translit: sat hotaa asat kar maaniaa jo binasat so nihachal jaanath ||
verses.translation: That which is true, you believe to be untrue; what is transitory, you believe to be permanent.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਐਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਭੁਲਾਨਥ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: par kee kau apanee kar pakaree aaise bhool bhulaanath ||3||
verses.translation: You grasp as your own, what belongs to others; in such delusions you are deluded. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਨਥ ॥
verses.translit: khatree braahaman soodh vais sabh ekai naam taraanath ||
verses.translation: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas all cross over, through the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਥ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gur naanak upadhes kahat hai jo sunai so paar paraanath ||4||1||10||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak speaks the Teachings; whoever listens to them is carried across. ||4||1||10||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਹਕਾਵਏ ਮਨੁਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gupat karataa sa(n)g so prabh ddahakaave manukhai ||
verses.translation: You may act in secrecy, but God is still with you; you can only deceive other people.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੈ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਤਪਤ ਥੰਮ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisaar har jeeau bikhai bhogeh tapat tha(n)m gal lai ||1||
verses.translation: Forgetting your Dear Lord, you enjoy corrupt pleasures, and so you shall have to embrace red-hot pillars. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਇ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: re nar kai par gireh jai ||
verses.translation: O man, why do you go out to the households of others?

verses.original: ਕੁਚਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਗਰਧਭ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kuchal kaThor kaam garadhabh tum nahee sunio dharam rai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You filthy, heartless, lustful donkey! Haven't you heard of the Righteous Judge of Dharma? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਾਥਰ ਗਲਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਨਿੰਦ ਪੋਟ ਸਿਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bikaar paathar galeh baadhe ni(n)dh poT sirai ||
verses.translation: The stone of corruption is tied around your neck, and the load of slander is on your head.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਮੁਦੁ ਲੰਘਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਰਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahaa saagar samudh la(n)ghanaa paar na paranaa jai ||2||
verses.translation: You must cross over the vast open ocean, but you cannot cross over to the other side. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਖੇ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh biaapio netr rakhe firai ||
verses.translation: You are engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment; you have turned your eyes away from the Truth.

verses.original: ਸੀਸੁ ਉਠਾਵਨ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਿਲਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sees uThaavan na kabahoo miliee mahaa dhutar mai ||3||
verses.translation: You cannot even raise your head above the water of the vast, impassable sea of Maya. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਸੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਲਿਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: soor mukataa sasee mukataa braham giaanee alipai ||
verses.translation: The sun is liberated, and the moon is liberated; the God-realized being is pure and untouched.

verses.original: ਸੁਭਾਵਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: subhaavat jaise baisa(n)tar alipat sadhaa niramalai ||4||
verses.translation: His inner nature is like that of fire, untouched and forever immaculate. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis karam khuliaa tis lahiaa paRadhaa jin gur peh ma(n)niaa subhai ||
verses.translation: When good karma dawns, the wall of doubt is torn down. He lovingly accepts the Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur ma(n)tr avakhadh naam dheenaa jan naanak sa(n)kaT jon na pai ||5||2||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the medicine of the GurMantra, the Name of the Lord, O servant Nanak, does not suffer the agonies of reincarnation. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: re nar in bidh paar parai ||
verses.translation: O man, in this way, you shall cross over to the other side.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaai har jeeau hoi mritak tiaag dhoojaa bhaau || rahaau dhoojaa ||2||11||
verses.translation: Meditate on your Dear Lord, and be dead to the world; renounce your love of duality. ||Second Pause||2||11||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: baahar ddooddan te chhooT pare gur ghar hee maeh dhikhaiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: I have quit searching outside; the Guru has shown me that God is within the home of my own heart.

verses.original: ਅਨਭਉ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anabhau acharaj roop prabh pekhiaa meraa man chhodd na katahoo jaiaa thaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have seen God, fearless, of wondrous beauty; my mind shall never leave Him to go anywhere else. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: maanak paio re paio har pooraa paiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the jewel; I have found the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mol amol na paiaa jaiee kar kirapaa guroo dhivaiaa thaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The invaluable value cannot be obtained; in His Mercy, the Guru bestows it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: adhisaT agochar paarabraham mil saadhoo akath kathaiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is imperceptible and unfathomable; meeting the Holy Saint, I speak the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਵਜਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh dhasam dhuaar vajio teh a(n)mirat naam chuaaiaa thaa ||2||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Naam trickles down there. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: toT naahee man tirasanaa boojhee akhuT bha(n)ddaar samaiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: I lack nothing; the thirsty desires of my mind are satisfied. The inexhaustible treasure has entered into my being.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan charan charan gur seve aghaR ghaRio ras paiaa thaa ||3||
verses.translation: I serve the feet, the feet, the feet of the Guru, and manage the unmanageable. I have found the juice, the sublime essence. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje aavaa sahaje jaavaa sahaje man khelaiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bharam gur khoiaa taa har mahalee mahal paiaa thaa ||4||3||12||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh saaj nivaajiaa tiseh siau ruch naeh ||
verses.translation: You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ ਬੋਈਐ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan rootee aan boieeaai fal na foolai taeh ||1||
verses.translation: The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਜਣ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: re man vatr beejan naau ||
verses.translation: O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.

verses.original: ਬੋਇ ਖੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਭਲੋ ਸਮਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: boi khetee lai manooaa bhalo samau suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Focus your mind, and cultivate this crop; at the proper time, make this your purpose. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਇ ਖਹੜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khoi khahaRaa bharam man kaa satigur saranee jai ||
verses.translation: Eradicate the stubbornness and doubt of your mind, and go to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam jis kau dhurahu likhiaa soiee kaar kamai ||2||
verses.translation: He alone does such deeds, who has such pre-ordained karma. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਿਉ ਘਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau laagaa gobidh siau ghaal paiee thai ||
verses.translation: He falls in love with the Lord of the Universe, and his efforts are approved.

verses.original: ਖੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khet merai ja(n)miaa nikhuT na kabahoo jai ||3||
verses.translation: My crop has germinated, and it shall never be used up. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa amol padhaaratho chhodd na katahoo jai ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the priceless wealth, which shall never leave me or go anywhere else.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sukh paiaa tirapat rahe aaghai ||4||4||13||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found peace; I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||4||13||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫੂਟੋ ਆਂਡਾ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: fooTo aa(n)ddaa bharam kaa maneh bhio paragaas ||
verses.translation: The egg of doubt has burst; my mind has been enlightened.

verses.original: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਪਗਹ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaaTee beree pageh te gur keenee ba(n)dh khalaas ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru has shattered the shackles on my feet, and has set me free. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahio ||
verses.translation: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended.

verses.original: ਤਪਤ ਕੜਾਹਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tapat kaRaahaa bujh giaa gur seetal naam dheeo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The boiling cauldron has cooled down; the Guru has blessed me with the cooling, soothing Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਗਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jab te saadhoo sa(n)g bhiaa tau chhodd ge nigahaar ||
verses.translation: Since I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, those who were eyeing me have left.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਟਕ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਟਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis kee aTak tis te chhuTee tau kahaa karai koTavaar ||2||
verses.translation: The one who tied me up, has released me; what can the Watchman of Death do to me now? ||2||

verses.original: ਚੂਕਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: chookaa bhaaraa karam kaa hoe nihakaramaa ||
verses.translation: The load of my karma has been removed, and I am now free of karma.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚੜੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saagar te ka(n)ddai chaRe gur keene dharamaa ||3||
verses.translation: I have crossed the world-ocean, and reached the other shore; the Guru has blessed me with this Dharma. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਠਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach thaan sach baiThakaa sach suaau banaiaa ||
verses.translation: True is my place, and True is my seat; I have made Truth my life's purpose.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sach poo(n)jee sach vakharo naanak ghar paiaa ||4||5||14||
verses.translation: True is my capital, and True is the merchandise, which Nanak has placed into the home of the heart. ||4||5||14||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਤ ਕਾਮਾਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh pukaarai mukh te pa(n)ddat kaamaaman kaa maaThaa ||
verses.translation: The Pandit, the religious scholar, proclaims the Vedas, but he is slow to act on them.

verses.original: ਮੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਇਕਾਂਤੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਲਪਨ ਗਾਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: monee hoi baiThaa ikaa(n)tee hiradhai kalapan gaaThaa ||
verses.translation: Another person on silence sits alone, but his heart is tied in knots of desire.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਠਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi udhaasee girahu taj chalio chhuTakai naahee naaThaa ||1||
verses.translation: Another becomes an Udaasi, a renunciate; he abandons his home and walks out on his family, but his wandering impulses do not leave him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee kai peh baat kahaa ||
verses.translation: Who can I tell about the state of my soul?

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਾ ਲਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap mukat mo kau prabh mele aaiso kahaa lahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Where can I find such a person who is liberated, and who can unite me with my God? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਪਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tapasee kar kai dhehee saadhee manooaa dheh dhis dhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Someone may practice intensive meditation, and discipline his body, but his mind still runs around in ten directions.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਜੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: brahamachaar brahamachaj keenaa hiradhai bhiaa gumaanaa ||
verses.translation: The celibate practices celibacy, but his heart is filled with pride.

verses.original: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਉਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)niaasee hoi kai teerath bhramio us meh karodh bigaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Sannyaasi wanders around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but his mindless anger is still within him. ||2||

verses.original: ਘੂੰਘਰ ਬਾਧਿ ਭਏ ਰਾਮਦਾਸਾ ਰੋਟੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਓਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghoo(n)ghar baadh bhe raamadhaasaa roTeean ke opaavaa ||
verses.translation: The temple dancers tie bells around their ankles to earn their living.

verses.original: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਮ ਖਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: barat nem karam khaT keene baahar bhekh dhikhaavaa ||
verses.translation: Others go on fasts, take vows, perform the six rituals and wear religious robes for show.

verses.original: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਅਲਾਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: geet naadh mukh raag alaape man nahee har har gaavaa ||3||
verses.translation: Some sing songs and melodies and hymns, but their minds do not sing of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog lobh moh rahat heh niramal har ke sa(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saints are immaculately pure; they are beyond pleasure and pain, beyond greed and attachment.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhooR paae man meraa jaa dhiaa kare bhagava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: My mind obtains the dust of their feet, when the Lord God shows mercy.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur pooraa miliaa taa(n) utaree man kee chi(n)taa ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I met the Perfect Guru, and then the anxiety of my mind was removed. ||4||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meraa a(n)tarajaamee har raiaa ||
verses.translation: My Sovereign Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਬਕਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੬॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh jaanai mere jeea kaa preetam bisar ge bakabaiaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||6||15||
verses.translation: The Beloved of my soul knows everything; all trivial talk is forgotten. ||1||Second Pause||6||15||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: koT laakh sarab ko raajaa jis hiradhai naam tumaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who has Your Name in his heart is the king of all the hundreds of thousands and millions of beings.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kau naam na dheeaa merai satigur se mar janameh gaavaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Those, whom my True Guru has not blessed with Your Name, are poor idiots, who die and are reborn. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere satigur hee pat raakh ||
verses.translation: My True Guru protects and preserves my honor.

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਲੀਐ ਖਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: cheet aaveh tab hee pat pooree bisarat raleeaai khaak ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When You come to mind, Lord, then I obtain perfect honor. Forgetting You, I roll in the dust. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਭੋਗਣ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: roop ra(n)g khuseeaa man bhogan te te chhidhr vikaaraa ||
verses.translation: The mind's pleasures of love and beauty bring just as many blames and sins.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nidhaan kaliaanaa sookh sahaj ih saaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the treasure of Emancipation; it is absolute peace and poise. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ra(n)g bira(n)g khinai meh jiau baadhar kee chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of Maya fade away in an instant, like the shade of a passing cloud.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se laal bhe gooRai ra(n)g raate jin gur mil har har gaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: They alone are dyed in the deep crimson of the Lord's Love, who meet the Guru, and sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: uooch mooch apaar suaamee agam dharabaaraa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is lofty and exalted, grand and infinite. The Darbaar of His Court is inaccessible.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naamo vaddiaaiee sobhaa naanak khasam piaaraa ||4||7||16||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, glorious greatness and respect are obtained; O Nanak, my Lord and Master is my Beloved. ||4||7||16||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar utapaatee ||
verses.translation: The One Universal Creator Lord created the creation.

verses.original: ਕੀਆ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: keeaa dhinas sabh raatee ||
verses.translation: He made all the days and the nights.

verses.original: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran tirabhavan paanee ||
verses.translation: The forests, meadows, three worlds, water,

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: chaar bedh chaare khaanee ||
verses.translation: the four Vedas, the four sources of creation,

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd dheep sabh loaa ||
verses.translation: the countries, the continents and all the worlds,

verses.original: ਏਕ ਕਵਾਵੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek kavaavai te sabh hoaa ||1||
verses.translation: have all come from the One Word of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: karanaihaaraa boojhahu re ||
verses.translation: Hey - understand the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta soojhai re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you meet the True Guru, then you'll understand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun keeaa pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: He formed the expanse of the entire universe from the three gunas, the three qualities.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: narak surag avataaraa ||
verses.translation: People are incarnated in heaven and in hell.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai aavai jaiee ||
verses.translation: In egotism, they come and go.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man Tikan na paavai raiee ||
verses.translation: The mind cannot hold still, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo gubaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mil satigur nisataaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one is emancipated. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karam kamaane ||
verses.translation: All the deeds done in egotism,

verses.original: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਗਲਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: te te ba(n)dh galaane ||
verses.translation: are just chains around the neck.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Harboring self-conceit and self-interest

verses.original: ਓਹਾ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੋਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ohaa pair lohaaree ||
verses.translation: is just like placing chains around one's ankles.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: so gur mil ek pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone meets with the Guru, and realizes the One Lord,

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis hovai bhaag mathaanai ||3||
verses.translation: who has such destiny written on his forehead. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so miliaa j har man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone meets the Lord, who is pleasing to His Mind.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so bhoolaa j prabhoo bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is deluded, who is deluded by God.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਆਪਹੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: neh aapahu moorakh giaanee ||
verses.translation: No one, by himself, is ignorant or wise.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: j karaavai su naam vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord inspires to do so.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
verses.translation: You have no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sadh balihaaraa ||4||1||17||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||17||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mohanee moh le'ee trai guneeaa ||
verses.translation: Maya, the enticer, has enticed the world of the three gunas, the three qualities.

verses.original: ਲੋਭਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: lobh viaapee jhooThee dhuneeaa ||
verses.translation: The false world is engrossed in greed.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਚੀ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਲੇ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meree meree kar kai sa(n)chee a(n)t kee baar sagal le chhaleeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"" they collect possessions, but in the end, they are all deceived. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦਇਅਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau nira(n)kaar dhialeeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is fearless, formless and merciful.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sagale pratipaleeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Cherisher of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਗਡਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ekai sram kar gaaddee gaddahai ||
verses.translation: Some collect wealth, and bury it in the ground.

verses.original: ਏਕਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਦਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਡਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ekeh supanai dhaam na chhaddahai ||
verses.translation: Some cannot abandon wealth, even in their dreams.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਚਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raaj kamai karee jin thailee taa kai sa(n)g na cha(n)chal chaleeaa ||2||
verses.translation: The king exercises his power, and fills his money-bags, but this fickle companion will not go along with him. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਿੰਡ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ekeh praan pi(n)dd te piaaree ||
verses.translation: Some love this wealth even more than their body and breath of life.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਸੰਚੀ ਤਜਿ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ek sa(n)chee taj baap mahataaree ||
verses.translation: Some collect it, forsaking their fathers and mothers.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤੇ ਗੁਹਜੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਖਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sut meet bhraat te guhajee taa kai nikaT na hoiee khaleeaa ||3||
verses.translation: Some hide it from their children, friends and siblings, but it will not remain with them. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਬੈਠੇ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hoi aaudhoot baiThe lai taaree ||
verses.translation: Some become hermits, and sit in meditative trances.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jogee jatee pa(n)ddit beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Some are Yogis, celibates, religious scholars and thinkers.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਊਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਲੀਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gireh maRee masaanee ban meh basate uooTh tinaa kai laagee paleeaa ||4||
verses.translation: Some dwell in homes, graveyards, cremation grounds and forests; but Maya still clings to them there. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaTe ba(n)dhan Thaakur jaa ke ||
verses.translation: When the Lord and Master releases one from his bonds,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਿਓ ਜੀਅ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam basio jeea taa kai ||
verses.translation: the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell in his soul.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਲੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhe jan mukate gat paiee naanak nadhar nihaleeaa ||5||2||18||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, His humble servants are liberated; O Nanak, they are redeemed and enraptured by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||5||2||18||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: simarahu ek nira(n)jan souoo ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te birathaa jaat na kouoo ||
verses.translation: No one is turned away from Him empty-handed.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh meh jin pratipaariaa ||
verses.translation: He cherished and preserved you in your mother's womb;

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhe saaj savaariaa ||
verses.translation: He blessed you with body and soul, and embellished you.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: soiee bidhaataa khin khin japeeaai ||
verses.translation: Each and every instant, meditate on that Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਢਕੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat avagun sabh ddakeeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all faults and mistakes are covered.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal ur a(n)tar dhaarahu ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet deep within the nucleus of your self.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨ ਤੇ ਜੀਉ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa ban te jeeau udhaarahu ||
verses.translation: Save your soul from the waters of corruption.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: karan palaeh miTeh bilalaaTaa ||
verses.translation: Your cries and shrieks shall be ended;

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਫਾਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap govidh bharam bhau faaTaa ||
verses.translation: meditating on the Lord of the Universe, your doubts and fears shall be dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g viralaa ko paae ||
verses.translation: Rare is that being, who finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kai bal bal jaae ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam man tan aadhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the support of my mind and body.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo simarai tis kaa nisataaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa vasat sat kar maanee ||
verses.translation: He believes that the false thing is true.

verses.original: ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਸਠ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: hit laio saTh mooR agiaanee ||
verses.translation: The ignorant fool falls in love with it.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh madh maataa ||
verses.translation: He is intoxicated with the wine of sexual desire, anger and greed;

verses.original: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kauddee badhalai janam gavaataa ||
verses.translation: he loses this human life in exchance for a mere shell.

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa chhodd paraiaai raataa ||
verses.translation: He abandons his own, and loves that of others.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa madh man tan sa(n)g jaataa ||
verses.translation: His mind and body are permeated with the intoxication of Maya.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਤ ਕਲੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tirasan na boojhai karat kalolaa ||
verses.translation: His thirsty desires are not quenched, although he indulges in pleasures.

verses.original: ਊਣੀ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: uoonee aas mithiaa sabh bolaa ||
verses.translation: His hopes are not fulfilled, and all his words are false.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavat ikelaa jaat ikelaa ||
verses.translation: He comes alone, and he goes alone.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham tum sa(n)g jhooThe sabh bolaa ||
verses.translation: False is all his talk of me and you.

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: pai Thagauree aap bhulaio ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself administers the poisonous potion, to mislead and delude.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kirat na jai miTaio ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the the karma of past actions cannot be erased. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਅਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pas pa(n)khee bhoot ar pretaa ||
verses.translation: Beasts, birds, demons and ghosts

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਤ ਅਨੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh jonee firat anetaa ||
verses.translation: - in these many ways, the false wander in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jaano teh rahan na paavai ||
verses.translation: Wherever they go, they cannot remain there.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: thaan bihoon uTh uTh fir dhaavai ||
verses.translation: They have no place of rest; they rise up again and again and run around.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan baasanaa bahut bisathaaraa ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are filled with immense, expansive desires.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਮੂਠੋ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)mev mooTho bechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The poor wretches are cheated by egotism.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anik dhokh ar bahut sajaiee ||
verses.translation: They are filled with countless sins, and are severely punished.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The extent of this cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bisarat narak meh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Forgetting God, they fall into hell.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teh maat na ba(n)dh na meet na jaiaa ||
verses.translation: There are no mothers there, no siblings, no friends and no spouses.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau hot kirapaal suaamee ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord and Master becomes Merciful,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so jan naanak paaragaraamee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, cross over. ||3||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhramat bhramat prabh saranee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Rambling and roaming, wandering around, I came to seek the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath jagat pit maiaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the meek, the father and mother of the world.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਦਾਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhiaal dhukh dharadh bidhaaran ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord God is the Destroyer of sorrow and suffering.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਣ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis hee nisataaran ||
verses.translation: He emancipates whoever He pleases.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te kaaddanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He lifts them up and pulls him out of the deep dark pit.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat hovat nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: Emancipation comes through loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਰੂਪ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadh roop apanaa tan dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saint is the very embodiment of the Lord's form.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa agan te aap ubaariaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself saves us from the great fire.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam is te kichh naahee ||
verses.translation: By myself, I cannot practice meditation, austerities, penance and self-discipline.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t prabh agam agaahee ||
verses.translation: In the beginning and in the end, God is inaccessible and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam dheh maagai dhaas teraa ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord; Your slave begs only for this.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: har jeevan padh naanak prabh meraa ||4||3||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my Lord God is the Giver of the true state of life. ||4||3||19||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕਾਵਹੁ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kat kau ddahakaavahu logaa mohan dheen kirapaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Why do you try to deceive others, O people of the world? The Fascinating Lord is Merciful to the meek. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee jaan paiee ||
verses.translation: This is what I have come to know.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saran sooro gur dhaataa raakhai aap vaddaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The brave and heroic Guru, the Generous Giver, gives Sanctuary and preserves our honor. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kaa aagiaakaaree sadhaa sadhaa sukhadhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: He submits to the Will of His devotees; He is forever and ever the Giver of peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: apane kau kirapaa kareeahu ik naam dhiaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may meditate on Your Name alone. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak dheen naam maagai dhuteeaa bharam chukaiee ||4||4||20||
verses.translation: Nanak, the meek and humble, begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it eradicates duality and doubt. ||4||4||20||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa Thaakur at bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is utterly powerful.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh sevak bechaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: I am just His poor servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mohan laal meraa preetam man praanaa ||
verses.translation: My Enticing Beloved is very dear to my mind and my breath of life.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau dheh dhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He blesses me with His gift. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagale mai dhekhe joiee ||
verses.translation: I have seen and tested all.

verses.original: ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: beejau avar na koiee ||2||
verses.translation: There is none other than Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeean pratipaal samaahai ||
verses.translation: He sustains and nurtures all beings.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hai hosee aahe ||3||
verses.translation: He was, and shall always be. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa moh keejai dhevaa ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, O Divine Lord,

verses.translit: naanak laago sevaa ||4||5||21||
verses.translation: and link Nanak to Your service. ||4||5||21||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaran taaran bal bal bale bal jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Redeemer of sinners, who carries us across; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisaa koiee bheTai sa(n)t jit har hare har dhiaaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: If only I could meet with such a Saint, who would inspire me to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau koi na jaanat kaheeat dhaas tumaaraa ||
verses.translation: No one knows me; I am called Your slave.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਓਟ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa oT aadhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is my support and sustenance. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab dhaaran pratipaaran ik binau dheenaa ||
verses.translation: You support and cherish all; I am meek and humble - this is my only prayer.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਹਮ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tumaree bidh tum hee jaanahu tum jal ham meenaa ||2||
verses.translation: You alone know Your Way; You are the water, and I am the fish. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
verses.translit: pooran bisatheeran suaamee aaeh aaio paachhai ||
verses.translation: O Perfect and Expansive Lord and Master, I follow You in love.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੋ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਛੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagalo bhoo ma(n)ddal kha(n)ddal prabh tum hee aachhai ||3||
verses.translation: O God, You are pervading all the worlds, solar systems and galaxies. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਅਖਇਓ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aTal akhio dhevaa mohan alakh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are eternal and unchanging, imperishable, invisible and infinite, O divine fascinating Lord.

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਨੁ ਦਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: dhaan paavau sa(n)taa sa(n)g naanak ren dhaasaaraa ||4||6||22||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Society of the Saints, and the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||6||22||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਆਘਾਏ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tirapat aaghaae sa(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The Saints are fulfilled and satisfied;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur jaane jin ma(n)taa ||
verses.translation: they know the Guru's Mantra and the Teachings.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee kichh kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: They cannot even be described;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kau naam baddaiee ||1||
verses.translation: they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: laal amolaa laalo ||
verses.translation: My Beloved is a priceless jewel.

verses.original: ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਨਾਮੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ageh atolaa naamo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His Name is unattainable and immeasurable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: avigat siau maaniaa maano ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is satisfied believing in the imperishable Lord God,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tat giaano ||
verses.translation: becomes Gurmukh and attains the essence of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਤ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: pekhat sagal dhiaano ||
verses.translation: He sees all in his meditation.

verses.original: ਤਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tajio man te abhimaano ||2||
verses.translation: He banishes egotistical pride from his mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਠਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal tin kaa Thaanaa ||
verses.translation: Permanent is the place of those

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur te mahal pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: who, through the Guru, realize the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin gur mil jaage ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, they remain awake and aware night and day;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kee sevaa laage ||3||
verses.translation: they are committed to the Lord's service. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pooran tirapat aghaae ||
verses.translation: They are perfectly fulfilled and satisfied,

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj samaadh subhaae ||
verses.translation: intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har bha(n)ddaar haath aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's treasure comes into their hands;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gur te paiaa ||4||7||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Guru, they attain it. ||4||7||23||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd sagal siaanapaa mil saadh tiaag gumaan ||
verses.translation: Abandon all your clever tricks; meet with the Holy, and renounce your egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar sabh kichh mithiaa rasanaa raam raam vakhaan ||1||
verses.translation: Everything else is false; with your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man karan sun har naam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, with your ears, listen to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਘ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: miTeh agh tere janam janam ke kavan bapuro jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sins of your many past lifetimes shall be washed away; then, what can the wretched Messenger of Death do to you? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਦੀਨ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dheen na bhau biaapai milai sukh bisraam ||
verses.translation: Pain, poverty and fear shall not afflict you, and you shall find peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak bakhaanai har bhajan tat giaan ||2||1||24||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak speaks; meditation on the Lord is the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||2||1||24||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਖੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa se hot dhekhe kheh ||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord - I have seen them reduced to dust.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤੂਟਤੇ ਏ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: putr mitr bilaas banitaa tooTate e neh ||1||
verses.translation: The love of children and friends, and the pleasures of married life are torn apart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam nit nit leh ||
verses.translation: O my mind, continually, continuously chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jalat naahee agan saagar sookh man tan dheh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall not burn in the ocean of fire, and your mind and body shall be blessed with peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਪਵਨ ਝੂਲਤ ਮੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: birakh chhaiaa jaise binasat pavan jhoolat meh ||
verses.translation: Like the shade of a tree, these things shall pass away, like the clouds blown away by the wind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਆਵਤ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: har bhagat dhiraR mil saadh naanak terai kaam aavat eh ||2||2||25||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy, devotional worship to the Lord is implanted within; O Nanak, only this shall work for you. ||2||2||25||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੋ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: purakh pooran sukheh dhaataa sa(n)g basato neet ||
verses.translation: The perfect, primal Lord is the Giver of peace; He is always with you.

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਸਨ ਨ ਸੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: marai na aavai na jai binasai biaapat usan na seet ||1||
verses.translation: He does not die, and he does not come or go in reincarnation. He does not perish, and He is not affected by heat or cold. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam siau kar preet ||
verses.translation: O my mind, be in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਏਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chet man meh har har nidhaanaa eh niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Within the mind, think of the Lord, Har, Har, the treasure. This is the purest way of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੀਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaal dhiaal gopaal gobidh jo japai tis seedh ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on the merciful compassionate Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is successful.

verses.original: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਧਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naval navatan chatur su(n)dhar man naanak tis sa(n)g beedh ||2||3||26||
verses.translation: He is always new, fresh and young, clever and beautiful; Nanak's mind is pierced through with His Love. ||2||3||26||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: chalat baisat sovat jaagat gur ma(n)tr ridhai chitaar ||
verses.translation: While walking and sitting, sleeping and waking, contemplate within your heart the GurMantra.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan saran bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo bhav saagar utareh paar ||1||
verses.translation: Run to the Lord's lotus feet, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other side. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam hiradhai dhaar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar preet man tan lai har siau avar sagal visaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Love the Lord, and commit your mind and body to Him; forget everything else. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau man tan praan prabh ke too aapan aap nivaar ||
verses.translation: Soul, mind, body and breath of life belong to God; eliminate your self-conceit.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: govidh bhaj sabh suaarath poore naanak kabahu na haar ||2||4||27||
verses.translation: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and all your desires shall be fulfilled; O Nanak, you shall never be defeated. ||2||4||27||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਤਾਪੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਥੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: taj aap binasee taap ren saadhoo theeau ||
verses.translation: Renounce your self-conceit, and the fever shall depart; become the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat naam teraa kar kirapaa jis dheeau ||1||
verses.translation: He alone receives Your Name, Lord, whom You bless with Your Mercy. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam a(n)mrit peeau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan saadh bisaar hochhe amar jug jug jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon other bland, insipid tastes; become immortal, and live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam ik ras ra(n)g naamaa naam laagee leeau ||
verses.translation: Savor the essence of the One and only Naam; love the Naam, focus and attune yourself to the Naam.

verses.original: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਉ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap har ek naanak keeau ||2||5||28||
verses.translation: Nanak has made the One Lord his only friend, companion and relative. ||2||5||28||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਗਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਸੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: pratipaal maataa udhar raakhai lagan dhet na sek ||
verses.translation: He nourishes and preserves mortals in the womb of the mother, so that the fiery heat does not hurt them.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਈਹਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਬੂਝੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soiee suaamee ieehaa raakhai boojh budh bibek ||1||
verses.translation: That Lord and Master protects us here. Understand this in your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: mere man naam kee kar Tek ||
verses.translation: O my mind, take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੂਝੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh boojh jin too keeaa prabh karan kaaran ek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Understand the One who created you; the One God is the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: chet man meh taj siaanap chhodd sagale bhekh ||
verses.translation: Remember the One Lord in your mind, renounce your clever tricks, and give up all your religious robes.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਕਈ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: simar har har sadhaa naanak tare kiee anek ||2||6||29||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, countless beings have been saved. ||2||6||29||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan naam jaa ko anaath ko hai naath ||
verses.translation: His Name is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Master of the masterless.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੁਲਹੋ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa bhaujal maeh tulaho jaa ko likhio maath ||1||
verses.translation: In the vast and terrifying world-ocean, he is the raft for those who have such destiny inscribed on their foreheads. ||1||

verses.original: ਡੂਬੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: ddoobe naam bin ghan saath ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, huge numbers of companions have drowned.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran chit na aavai dhe kar raakhai haath ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Even if someone does not remember the Lord, the Cause of causes, still, the Lord reaches out with His hand, and saves him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat gun uchaaran har naam a(n)mirat paath ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and take the Path of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਥ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa muraar maadhau sun naanak jeevai gaath ||2||7||30||
verses.translation: Shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord; listening to Your sermon, Nanak lives. ||2||7||30||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: maaroo a(n)julee mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jog vijog dhurahu hee hooaa ||
verses.translation: Union and separation are ordained by the Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhaat kar putalaa keeaa ||
verses.translation: The puppet is made from the five elements.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੈ ਕੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਅੜੈ ਜੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saahai kai furamaiaRai jee dhehee vich jeeau aai piaa ||1||
verses.translation: By the Command of the Dear Lord King, the soul came and entered into the body. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jithai agan bhakhai bhaRahaare ||
verses.translation: In that place, where the fire rages like an oven,

verses.original: ਊਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: uooradh mukh mahaa gubaare ||
verses.translation: in that darkness where the body lies face down

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਓਥੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saas saas samaale soiee othai khasam chhaddai liaa ||2||
verses.translation: - there, one remembers his Lord and Master with each and every breath, and then he is rescued. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਰਭੈ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu garabhai nikal aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Then, one comes out from within the womb,

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khasam visaar dhunee chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: and forgetting his Lord and Master, he attaches his consciousness to the world.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਕਿਤਹੀ ਥਾਇ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aavai jai bhavaieeaai jonee rahan na kitahee thai bhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: He comes and goes, and wanders in reincarnation; he cannot remain anywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਰਖਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: miharavaan rakh lian aape ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself emancipates.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh tis ke thaape ||
verses.translation: He created and established all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jin chaliaa naanak aaiaa so paravaan thiaa ||4||1||31||
verses.translation: Those who depart after having been victorious in this priceless human life - O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved. ||4||1||31||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੈਦੋ ਨ ਵਾਈ ਭੈਣੋ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vaidho na vaiee bhaino na bhaiee eko sahaiee raam he ||1||
verses.translation: The One Lord alone is our help and support; neither physician nor friend, nor sister nor brother can be this. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੋ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keetaa jiso hovai paapaa(n) malo dhovai so simarahu paradhaan he ||2||
verses.translation: His actions alone come to pass; He washes off the filth of sins. Meditate in remembrance on that Supreme Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaTe vaasee sarab nivaasee asathir jaa kaa thaan he ||3||
verses.translation: He abides in each and every heart, and dwells in all; His seat and place are eternal. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aavai na jaavai sa(n)ge samaavai pooran jaa kaa kaam he ||4||
verses.translation: He does not come or go, and He is always with us. His actions are perfect. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kaa raakhanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is the Savior and the Protector of His devotees.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t jeeveh jap praan adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Saints live by meditating on God, the support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis kurabaan he ||5||2||32||
verses.translation: The Almighty Lord and Master is the Cause of causes; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||5||2||32||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam sadhaa sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is forever the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਹੂ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau simar ajaamal udhario ganikaa hoo gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on it, Ajaamal was saved, and Ganika the prostitute was emancipated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)chaalee kau raaj sabhaa meh raam naam sudh aaiee ||
verses.translation: Dropadi the princess of Panchaala remembered the Lord's Name in the royal court.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਬਢਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa ko dhookh hario karunaa mai apanee paij baddaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the embodiment of mercy, removed her suffering; thus His own glory was increased. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh nar jas kirapaa nidh gaio taa kau bhio sahaiee ||
verses.translation: That man, who sings the Praise of the Lord, the treasure of mercy, has the help and support of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਇਹੀ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਗਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai ihee bharosai gahee aan saranaiee ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have come to rely on this. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab mai kahaa karau ree maiee ||
verses.translation: What should I do now, O mother?

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਨੑਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal janam bikhian siau khoiaa simario naeh kan(h)aiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have wasted my whole life in sin and corruption; I never remembered the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaal faas jab gar meh melee teh sudh sabh bisaraiee ||
verses.translation: When Death places the noose around my neck, then I lose all my senses.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਯਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin yaa sa(n)kaT meh ko ab hot sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Now, in this disaster, other than the Name of the Lord, who will be my help and support? ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
