verses.translit: jo sa(n)pat apanee kar maanee chhin meh bhiee paraiee ||
verses.translation: That wealth, which he believes to be his own, in an instant, belongs to another.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਯਹ ਸੋਚ ਰਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak yeh soch rahee man har jas kabahoo na gaiee ||2||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this still really bothers my mind - I never sang the Praises of the Lord. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: maiee mai man ko maan na tiaagio ||
verses.translation: O my mother, I have not renounced the pride of my mind.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਦਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਇਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ke madh janam siraio raam bhajan nahee laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have wasted my life intoxicated with Maya; I have not focused myself in meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਬ ਸੋਵਤ ਤੈ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: jam ko dda(n)dd pario sir uoopar tab sovat tai jaagio ||
verses.translation: When Death's club falls on my head, then I will be wakened from my sleep.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਅਬ ਕੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਛੂਟਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਭਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa hot ab kai pachhutaae chhooTat naahin bhaagio ||1||
verses.translation: But what good will it do to repent at that time? I cannot escape by running away. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: eeh chi(n)taa upajee ghaT meh jab gur charanan anuraagio ||
verses.translation: When this anxiety arises in the heart, then, one comes to love the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਸੁਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: sufal janam naanak tab hooaa jau prabh jas meh paagio ||2||3||
verses.translation: My life becomes fruitful, O Nanak, only when I am absorbed in the Praises of God. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: maaroo asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਥੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan kathe sune haare munee anekaa ||
verses.translation: Reciting and listening to the Vedas and the Puraanas, countless wise men have grown weary.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath bahu ghanaa bhram thaake bhekhaa ||
verses.translation: So many in their various religious robes have grown weary, wandering to the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saacho saahib niramalo man maanai ekaa ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master is immaculate and pure. The mind is satisfied only by the One Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too ajaraavar amar too sabh chaalanahaaree ||
verses.translation: You are eternal; You do not grow old. All others pass away.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਭਾਇ ਲੈ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam rasain bhai lai parahar dhukh bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who lovingly focuses on the Naam, the source of nectar - his pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har paReeaai har bujheeaai gurmatee naam udhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Study the Lord's Name, and understand the Lord's Name; follow the Guru's Teachings, and through the Naam, you shall be saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pooree mat hai poorai sabadh beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath har naam hai kilavikh kaaTanahaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the Eradicator of sins. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਜਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਤਤੁ ਲੋੜੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal bilovai jal mathai tat loRai a(n)dh agiaanaa ||
verses.translation: The blind ignorant mortal stirs the water and churns the water, wishing to obtain butter.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦਧਿ ਮਥੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee dhadh matheeaai a(n)mrit paieeaai naam nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, one churns the cream, and the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam is obtained.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਪਸੂ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh tat na jaananee pasoo maeh samaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is a beast; he does not know the essence of reality that is contained within himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰੀ ਮਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa maree mar mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: Dying in egotism and self-conceit, one dies, and dies again, only to be reincarnated over and over again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadhe je marai fir marai na dhoojee vaar ||
verses.translation: But when he dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, then he does not die, ever again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmatee jagajeevan man vasai sabh kul udhaaranahaar ||4||
verses.translation: When he follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines the Lord, the Life of the World, within his mind, he redeems all his generations. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa vakhar naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the true object, the true commodity.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa naam sa(n)saar hai gurmatee veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the only true profit in this world. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and contemplate it.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai kaar kamaavanee nit toTaa saisaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: To work in the love of duality, brings constant loss in this world. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥ ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachee sa(n)gat thaan sach sache ghar baaraa || sachaa bhojan bhaau sach sach naam adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: True is one's association, true is one's place, and true is one's hearth and home, when one has the support of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee sa(n)tokhiaa sachaa sabadh veechaaraa ||6||
verses.translation: Contemplating the True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, one becomes content. ||6||

verses.original: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਘਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ras bhogan paatisaaheeaa dhukh sukh sa(n)ghaaraa ||
verses.translation: Enjoying princely pleasures, one shall be destroyed in pain and pleasure.

verses.original: ਮੋਟਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਈਐ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: moTaa naau dharaieeaai gal aaugan bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Adopting a name of greatness, one strings heavy sins around his neck.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: maanas dhaat na hoviee too dhaataa saaraa ||7||
verses.translation: Mankind cannot give gifts; You alone are the Giver of everything. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar too dhanee avigat apaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; O Lord, You are imperishable and infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜੋਈਐ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee dhar joieeaai mukate bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, seeking at the Lord's Door, one finds the treasure of liberation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak mel na chookiee saache vaapaaraa ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this union is not broken, if one deals in the merchandise of Truth. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bikh bohithaa laadhiaa dheeaa samu(n)dh ma(n)jhaar ||
verses.translation: The boat is loaded with sin and corruption, and launched into the sea.

verses.original: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dhee dhis na aaviee naa uravaar na paar ||
verses.translation: The shore cannot be seen on this side, nor on the shore beyond.

verses.original: ਵੰਝੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਖੇਵਟੂ ਜਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: va(n)jhee haath na khevaToo jal saagar asaraal ||1||
verses.translation: There are no oars, nor any boatmen, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa jag faathaa mahaa jaal ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the world is caught in the great noose.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ubare sachaa naam samaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are saved, contemplating the True Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo hai bohithaa sabadh la(n)ghaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the boat; the Word of the Shabad will carry them across.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tithai pavan na paavako naa jal naa aakaar ||
verses.translation: There is neither wind nor fire, neither water nor form there.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tithai sachaa sach nai bhavajal taaranahaar ||2||
verses.translation: The True Name of the True Lord is there; it carries them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh la(n)ghe se paar pe sache siau liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs reach the shore beyond, lovingly focusing on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun nivaariaa jotee jot milai ||
verses.translation: Their comings and goings are ended, and their light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sahaj uoopajai sache rahai samai ||3||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, intuitive peace wells up within them, and they remain merged in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਪੁ ਪਿੜਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sap piRaiee paieeaai bikh a(n)tar man ros ||
verses.translation: The snake may be locked in a basket, but it is still poisonous, and the anger within its mind remains.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa paieeaai kis no dheejai dhos ||
verses.translation: One obtains what is pre-ordained; why does he blame others?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਰੜੁ ਜੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੰਤੋਸੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gaaraR je sune ma(n)ne naau sa(n)tos ||4||
verses.translation: If one, as Gurmukh, hears and believes in the Name, the charm against poison, his mind becomes content. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਗਰਮਛੁ ਫਹਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maagaramachh fahaieeaai ku(n)ddee jaal vatai ||
verses.translation: The crocodile is caught by the hook and line;

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਥਾ ਫਾਹੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat faathaa faaheeaai fir fir pachhotai ||
verses.translation: caught in the trap of evil-mindedness, he regrets and repents, again and again.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran na sujhiee kirat na meTiaa jai ||5||
verses.translation: He does not understand birth and death; the inscription of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai bikh pai jagat upaiaa sabadh vasai bikh jai ||
verses.translation: Injecting the poison of egotism, the world was created; with the Shabad enshrined within, the poison is eliminated.

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaraa joh na sakiee sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: Old age cannot torment one who remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat so aakheeaai jis vichahu haumai jai ||6||
verses.translation: He alone is called Jivan-Mikta, liberated while yet alive, from within whom egotism is eradicated. ||6||

verses.original: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhai dhaavat jag baadhiaa naa boojhai veechaar ||
verses.translation: The world is chasing after worldly affairs; caught and bound, it does not understand contemplative meditation.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran visaariaa manmukh mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The foolish, ignorant, self-willed manmukh has forgotten birth and death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare sachaa sabadh veechaar ||7||
verses.translation: Those whom the Guru has protected are saved, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੂਹਟੁ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: soohaT pi(n)jar prem kai bolai bolanahaar ||
verses.translation: In the cage of divine love, the parrot, speaks.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਤ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sach chugai a(n)mrit peeaai uddai ta ekaa vaar ||
verses.translation: It pecks at the Truth, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; it flies away, only once.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai khasam pachhaaneeaai kahu naanak mokh dhuaar ||8||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, one recognizes his Lord and Master; says Nanak, he finds the gate of liberation. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਭਾਗੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai taa maar mar bhaago kis peh jaau ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers death; otherwise, where can you run?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਡਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai ddar bhai bhaageeaai a(n)mrit taa ko naau ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, fear runs away; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maareh raakheh ek too beejau naahee thaau ||1||
verses.translation: You alone kill and protect; except for You, there is no place at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਕਾਚਉ ਮਤਿਹੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa mai kucheel kaachau matiheen ||
verses.translation: O Baba, I am filthy, shallow and totally without understanding.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa ko kachh nahee gur poorai pooree mat keen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, no one is anything; the Perfect Guru has made my intellect perfect. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੁਭਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avagan subhar gun nahee bin gun kiau ghar jaau ||
verses.translation: I am full of faults, and I have no virtue at all. Without virtues, how can I go home?

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sabadh sukh uoopajai bin bhaagaa dhan naeh ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace wells up; without good destiny, the wealth is not obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin kai naam na man vasai se baadhe dhookh sahaeh ||2||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are not filled with the Naam are bound and gagged, and suffer in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam - why have they even come into the world?

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਡੇ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aagai paachhai sukh nahee gaadde laadhe chhaar ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, they do not find any peace; they have loaded their carts with ashes.

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa melaa nahee dhookh ghano jam dhuaar ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are separated, do not meet with the Lord; they suffer in terrible pain at Death's Door. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: agai kiaa jaanaa naeh mai bhoole too samajhai ||
verses.translation: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - please teach me, Lord!

verses.original: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੋ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhoole maarag jo dhase tis kai laagau pai ||
verses.translation: I am confused; I would fall at the feet of one who shows me the Way.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur bin dhaataa ko nahee keemat kahan na jai ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, there is no giver at all; His value cannot be described. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: saajan dhekhaa taa gal milaa saach paThaio lekh ||
verses.translation: If I see my friend, then I will embrace Him; I have sent Him the letter of Truth.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਮਾਣੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: mukh dhimaanai dhan khaRee gurmukh aakhee dhekh ||
verses.translation: His soul-bride stands waiting expectantly; as Gurmukh, I see Him with my eyes.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai too man vaseh nadharee karam visekh ||5||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You abide in my mind, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||5||

verses.original: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhookh piaaso je bhavai kiaa tis maagau dhei ||
verses.translation: One who is wandering hungry and thirsty - what can he give, and what can anyone ask from him?

verses.original: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: beejau soojhai ko nahee man tan pooran dhei ||
verses.translation: I cannot conceive of any other, who can bless my mind and body with perfection.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa aap vaddaiee dhei ||6||
verses.translation: The One who created me takes care of me; He Himself blesses me with glory. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਲੀਲ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: nagaree naik navatano baalak leel anoop ||
verses.translation: In the body-village is my Lord and Master, whose body is ever-new, Innocent and child-like, incomparably playful.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪੰਖਣੂ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: naar na purakh na pa(n)khanoo saachau chatur saroop ||
verses.translation: He is neither a woman, nor a man, nor a bird; the True Lord is so wise and beautiful.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਤੂ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤੂ ਧੂਪੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai too dheepak too dhoop ||7||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, happens; You are the lamp, and You are the incense. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੀਤ ਸਾਦ ਚਾਖੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: geet saadh chaakhe sune baadh saadh tan rog ||
verses.translation: He hears the songs and tastes the flavors, but these flavors are useless and insipid, and bring only disease to the body.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਵੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach bhaavai saachau chavai chhooTai sog vijog ||
verses.translation: One who loves the Truth and speaks the Truth, escapes from the sorrow of separation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai jo tis bhaavai su hog ||8||3||
verses.translation: Nanak does not forget the Naam; whatever happens is by the Lord's Will. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਲਾਲਚ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: saachee kaar kamaavanee hor laalach baadh ||
verses.translation: Practice Truth - other greed and attachments are useless.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih man saachai mohiaa jihavaa sach saadh ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has fascinated this mind, and my tongue enjoys the taste of Truth.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin naavai ko ras nahee hor chaleh bikh laadh ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Name, there is no juice; the others depart, loaded with poison. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa laalaa mere laal ko sun khasam hamaare ||
verses.translation: I am such a slave of Yours, O my Beloved Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau furamaaveh tiau chalaa sach laal piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I walk in harmony with Your Command, O my True, Sweet Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲੇ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਗੋਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin laale chaakaree gole sir meeraa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, the slave works for his overlord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee man vechiaa sabadh man dheeraa ||
verses.translation: I have sold my mind for the Word of the Guru's Shabad; my mind is comforted and consoled by the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਪੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poore saabaas hai kaaTai man peeraa ||2||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is honored and celebrated; He has taken away the pains of my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਧਣੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: laalaa golaa dhanee ko kiaa kahau vaddiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I am the servant and slave of my Master; what glorious greatness of His can I describe?

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai bakhase pooraa dhanee sach kaar kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, forgives, and then one practices Truth.

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa kau mel le gur kau bal jaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who re-unites the separated ones. ||3||

verses.original: ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਮਤਿ ਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: laale gole mat kharee gur kee mat neekee ||
verses.translation: The intellect of His servant and slave is noble and true; it is made so by the Guru's intellect.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: saachee surat suhaavanee manmukh mat feekee ||
verses.translation: The intuition of those who are true is beautiful; the intellect of the self-willed manmukh is insipid.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਚੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man tan teraa too prabhoo sach dheerak dhur kee ||4||
verses.translation: My mind and body belong to You, God; from the very beginning, Truth has been my only support. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਉਠਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saachai baisan uThanaa sach bhojan bhaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: In Truth I sit and stand; I eat and speak the Truth.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਸਚੈ ਵਿਤੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chit sachai vito sachaa saachaa ras chaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: With Truth in my consciousness, I gather the wealth of Truth, and drink in the sublime essence of Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saachai ghar saachai rakhe gur bachan subhaakhiaa ||5||
verses.translation: In the home of Truth, the True Lord protects me; I speak the Words of the Guru's Teachings with love. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਘਣੋ ਫਾਥੇ ਓਜਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kau aalas ghano faathe ojaaRee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is very lazy; he is trapped in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਚੋਗੜੀ ਲਗਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: faathaa chugai nit chogaRee lag ba(n)dh vigaaRee ||
verses.translation: He is drawn to the bait, and continually pecking at it, he is trapped; his link to the Lord is ruined.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਜ ਤਾੜੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee mukat hoi saache nij taaRee ||6||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is liberated, absorbed in the primal trance of Truth. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anahat laalaa bedhiaa prabh het piaaree ||
verses.translation: His slave remains continually pierced through with love and affection for God.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਝੂਠੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin saache jeeau jal balau jhooThe vekaaree ||
verses.translation: Without the True Lord, the soul of the false, corrupt person is burnt to ashes.

verses.original: ਬਾਦਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਛੋਡੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: baadh kaaraa sabh chhoddeeaa saachee tar taaree ||7||
verses.translation: Abandoning all evil actions, he crosses over in the boat of Truth. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa tinaa Thaur na Thaau ||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam have no home, no place of rest.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੈ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laalai laalach tiaagiaa paiaa har naau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slave renounces greed and attachment, and obtains the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: too bakhaseh taa mel laih naanak bal jaau ||8||4||
verses.translation: If You forgive him, Lord, then He is united with You; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਲੈ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: laalai gaarab chhoddiaa gur kai bhai sahaj subhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slave renounces his egotistical pride, through the Guru's Fear, intuitively and easily.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: laalai khasam pachhaaniaa vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The slave realizes his Lord and Master; glorious is his greatness!

verses.original: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khasam miliaai sukh paiaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with his Lord and Master, he finds peace; His value cannot be desribed. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: laalaa golaa khasam kaa khasamai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I am the slave and servant of my Lord and Master; all glory is to my Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ubare har kee saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I am saved, in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਾਲੇ ਨੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: laale no sir kaar hai dhur khasam furamaiee ||
verses.translation: The slave has been given the most excellent task, by the Primal Command of the Master.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: laalai hukam pachhaaniaa sadhaa rahai rajaiee ||
verses.translation: The slave realizes the Hukam of His Command, and submits to His Will forever.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੀਰਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape meeraa bakhas le vaddee vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord King Himself grants forgiveness; how glorious is His greatness! ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap sachaa sabh sach hai gur sabadh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is True, and everything is True; this is revealed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੈਹਿ ਤੂ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teree sevaa so kare jis no laih too laiee ||
verses.translation: He alone serves You, whom You have enjoined to do so.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin sevaa kinai na paiaa dhoojai bharam khuaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Without serving Him, no one finds Him; in duality and doubt, they are ruined. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau manahu visaareeaai nit dhevai chaRai savaiaa ||
verses.translation: How could we forget Him from our minds? The gifts which he bestows increase day by day.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa saahu tinai vich paiaa ||
verses.translation: Soul and body, all belong to Him; He infused the breath into us.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jaa kirapaa kare taa seveeaai sev sach samaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: If he shows His Mercy, then we serve Him; serving Him, we merge in Truth. ||4||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਾ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: laalaa so jeevat marai mar vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive, and eradicates egotism from within.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan tooTeh mukat hoi tirasanaa agan bujhaae ||
verses.translation: His bonds are broken, the fire of his desire is quenched, and he is liberated.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabh meh naam nidhaan hai gurmukh ko paae ||5||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within all, but how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it. ||5||

verses.original: ਲਾਲੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: laale vich gun kichh nahee laalaa avaganiaar ||
verses.translation: Within the Lord's slave, there is no virtue at all; the Lord's slave is totally unworthy.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd dhaataa ko nahee too bakhasanahaar ||
verses.translation: There is no Giver as great as You, Lord; You alone are the Forgiver.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: teraa hukam laalaa ma(n)ne eh karanee saar ||6||
verses.translation: Your slave obeys the Hukam of Your Command; this is the most excellent action. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur saagar a(n)mirat sar jo ichhe so fal paae ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the pool of nectar in the world-ocean; whatever one desires, that fruit is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath amar hai hiradhai ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam brings immortality; enshrine it in your heart and mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa sadhaa sukh hai jis no hukam manaae ||7||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, eternal peace is obtained, by those whom the Lord inspires to obey the Hukam of His Command. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: suinaa rupaa sabh dhaat hai maaTee ral jaiee ||
verses.translation: Gold and silver, and all metals, mix with dust in the end

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai naal na chaliee satigur boojh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, nothing goes along with you; the True Guru has imparted this understanding.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate se niramale saachai rahe samaiee ||8||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; they remain merged in the Truth. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam bhiaa rahanaa nahee dhur faaTe cheerai ||
verses.translation: The Order is issued, and he cannot remain; the permit to stay has been torn up.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: eh man avagan baadhiaa sahu dheh sareerai ||
verses.translation: This mind is tied to its faults; it suffers terrible pain in its body.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਾਈਅਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਨਹ ਫਕੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poorai gur bakhasaie'eeh sabh guneh fakeerai ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru forgives all the mistakes of the beggar at His Door. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਬੁਝੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau raheeaai uTh chalanaa bujh sabadh beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: How can he stay here? He must get up and depart. Contemplate the Word of the Shabad, and understand this.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis too meleh so milai dhur hukam apaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is united, whom You, O Lord, unite. Such is the Primal Command of the Infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau too raakheh tiau rahaa jo dheh su khaau ||
verses.translation: As You keep me, I remain; whatever You give me, I eat.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau too chalaaveh tiau chalaa mukh a(n)mirat naau ||
verses.translation: As You lead me, I follow, with the Ambrosial Name in my mouth.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur hath vaddiaaieeaa meleh man chaau ||2||
verses.translation: All glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Lord and Master; my mind yearns to unite with You. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai kar dhekhai soiee ||
verses.translation: Why should anyone praise any other created being? That Lord acts and sees.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa so man vasai mai avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: The One who created me, abides within my mind; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so saachaa saalaaheeaai saachee pat hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: So praise that True Lord, and you shall be blessed with true honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਈ ਬਹੁ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paR na pahuchiee bahu aal ja(n)jaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads, but does not reach the Lord; he is totally entangled in worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n dhui sa(n)game khudhiaa jamakaalaa ||
verses.translation: He keeps the company of both virtue and vice, tormented by hunger and the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਭਉ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: vichhoRaa bhau veesarai pooraa rakhavaalaa ||4||
verses.translation: One who is protected by the Perfect Lord, forgets separation and fear. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kee lekhai pat pavai se poore bhaiee ||
verses.translation: They alone are perfect, O Siblings of Destiny, whose honor is certified.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: poore pooree mat hai sachee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Perfect is the intellect of the Perfect Lord. True is His glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhedhe toT na aaviee lai lai thak paiee ||5||
verses.translation: His gifts never run short, although those who receive may grow weary of receiving. ||5||

verses.original: ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: khaar samudhr dda(n)ddoleeaai ik maneeaa paavai ||
verses.translation: Searching the salty sea, one finds the pearl.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhui dhin chaar suhaavanaa maaTee tis khaavai ||
verses.translation: It looks beautiful for a few days, but in the end, it is eaten away by dust.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur saagar sat seveeaai dhe toT na aavai ||6||
verses.translation: If one serves the Guru, the ocean of Truth, the gifts one receives never run short. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਭ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: mere prabh bhaavan se uoojale sabh mail bhareejai ||
verses.translation: They alone are pure, who are pleasing to my God; all others are soiled with filth.

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਾਰਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: mailaa uoojal taa theeaai paaras sa(n)g bheejai ||
verses.translation: The filthy become pure, when they meet with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

verses.original: ਵੰਨੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: va(n)nee saache laal kee kin keemat keejai ||7||
verses.translation: Who can estimate the value of the color of the true jewel? ||7||

verses.original: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhee haath na labhiee teerath nahee dhaane ||
verses.translation: Wearing religious robes, the Lord is not obtained, nor is He obtained by giving donations at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਪੂਛਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜੰਤਿਆ ਮੂਠੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: poochhau bedh paRa(n)tiaa mooThee vin maane ||
verses.translation: Go and ask the readers of the Vedas; without faith, the world is cheated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak keemat so kare pooraa gur giaane ||8||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone values the jewel, who is blessed with the spiritual wisdom of the Perfect Guru. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਹਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh lahar ghar taj vigoochai avaraa ke ghar herai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh, in a fit of passion, abandons his home, and is ruined; then, he spies on the homes of others.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gireh dharam gavaae satigur na bheTai dhuramat ghooman gherai ||
verses.translation: He neglects his household duties, and does not meet with the True Guru; he is caught in the whirlpool of evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਧੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhisa(n)tar bhavai paaTh paR thaakaa tirasanaa hoi vadherai ||
verses.translation: Wandering in foreign lands and reading scriptures, he grows weary, and his thirsty desires only increase.

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaachee pi(n)ddee sabadh na cheenai udhar bharai jaise ddorai ||1||
verses.translation: His perishable body does not remember the Word of the Shabad; like a beast, he fills his belly. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa aaisee ravat ravai sa(n)niaasee ||
verses.translation: O Baba, this is the way of life of the Sannyaasi, the renunciate.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh ek liv laagee terai naam rate tirapataasee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is to enshrine love for the One Lord. Imbued with Your Name, Lord, he remains satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘੋਲੀ ਗੇਰੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gholee geroo ra(n)g chaRaiaa vasatr bhekh bhekhaaree ||
verses.translation: He dyes his robes with saffron dye, and wearing these robes, he goes out begging.

verses.original: ਕਾਪੜ ਫਾਰਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaapaR faar banaiee khi(n)thaa jholee maiaadhaaree ||
verses.translation: Tearing his robes, he makes a patched coat, and puts the money in his wallet.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar maagai jag parabodhai man a(n)dhai pat haaree ||
verses.translation: From house to house he goes begging, and tries to teach the world; but his mind is blind, and so he loses his honor.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaanaa sabadh na cheenai jooaai baajee haaree ||2||
verses.translation: He is deluded by doubt, and does not remember the Word of the Shabad. He loses his life in the gamble. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੂਅਰ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agan na gur bin boojhai baahar pooar taapai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the fire within is not quenched; and outside, the fire still burns.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hovee kiau kar cheenas aapai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship. How can anyone, by himself, know the Lord?

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa kar kar narak nivaasee a(n)tar aatam jaapai ||
verses.translation: Slandering others, one lives in hell; within him is hazy darkness.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਪਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath bharam vigoocheh kiau mal dhopai paapai ||3||
verses.translation: Wandering to the eixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, he is ruined. How can the filth of sin be washed away? ||3||

verses.original: ਛਾਣੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: chhaanee khaak bibhoot chaRaiee maiaa kaa mag johai ||
verses.translation: He sifts through the dust, and applies ashes to his body, but he is searching for the path of Maya's wealth.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਛੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar ek na jaanai saach kahe te chhohai ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, he does not know the One Lord; if someone tells him the Truth, he grows angry.

verses.original: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: paaTh paRai mukh jhooTho bolai nigure kee mat ohai ||
verses.translation: He reads the scriptures, but tells lies; such is the intellect of one who has no guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam na japiee kiau sukh paavai bin naavai kiau sohai ||4||
verses.translation: Without chanting the Naam, how can he find peace? Without the Name, how can he look good? ||4||

verses.original: ਮੂੰਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇ ਜਟਾ ਸਿਖ ਬਾਧੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: moo(n)dd muddai jaTaa sikh baadhee mon rahai abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: Some shave their heads, some keep their hair in matted tangles; some keep it in braids, while some keep silent, filled with egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਤ ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa ddolai dheh dhis dhaavai bin rat aatam giaanaa ||
verses.translation: Their minds waver and wander in ten directions, without loving devotion and enlightenment of the soul.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit chhodd mahaa bikh peevai maiaa kaa dhevaanaa ||
verses.translation: They abandon the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink the deadly poison, driven mad by Maya.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਸੂਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kirat na miTiee hukam na boojhai pasooaa maeh samaanaa ||5||
verses.translation: Past actions cannot be erased; without understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they become beasts. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: haath kama(n)ddal kaapaReeaa man tirasanaa upajee bhaaree ||
verses.translation: With bowl in hand, wearing his patched coat, great desires well up in his mind.

verses.original: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eisatree taj kar kaam viaapiaa chit laiaa par naaree ||
verses.translation: Abandoning his own wife, he is engrossed in sexual desire; his thoughts are on the wives of others.

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sikh kare kar sabadh na cheenai la(n)paT hai baajaaree ||
verses.translation: He teaches and preaches, but does not contemplate the Shabad; he is bought and sold on the street.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar bikh baahar nibharaatee taa jam kare khuaaree ||6||
verses.translation: With poison within, he pretends to be free of doubt; he is ruined and humiliated by the Messenger of Death. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so sa(n)niaasee jo satigur sevai vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Sannyaasi, who serves the True Guru, and removes his self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadhan bhojan kee aas na kariee achi(n)t milai so paae ||
verses.translation: He does not ask for clothes or food; without asking, he accepts whatever he receives.

verses.original: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bakai na bolai khimaa dhan sa(n)grahai taamas naam jalaae ||
verses.translation: He does not speak empty words; he gathers in the wealth of tolerance, and burns away his anger with the Naam.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: dhan girahee sa(n)niaasee jogee j har charanee chit laae ||7||
verses.translation: Blessed is such a householder, Sannyaasi and Yogi, who focuses his consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aas niraas rahai sa(n)niaasee ekas siau liv laae ||
verses.translation: Amidst hope, the Sannyaasi remains unmoved by hope; he remains lovingly focused on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ras peevai taa saat aavai nij ghar taaRee laae ||
verses.translation: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, and so finds peace and tranquility; in the home of his own being, he remains absorbed in the deep trance of meditation.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa na ddolai gurmukh boojhai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
verses.translation: His mind does not waver; as Gurmukh, he understands. He restrains it from wandering out.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: girahu sareer gurmatee khoje naam padhaarath paae ||8||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, he searches the home of his body, and obtains the wealth of the Naam. ||8||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes saresaT naam rate veechaaree ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are exalted, imbued with contemplative meditation on the Naam.

verses.original: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਗਨ ਪਤਾਲੀ ਜੰਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaanee baanee gagan pataalee ja(n)taa jot tumaaree ||
verses.translation: The sources of creation, speech, the heavens and the underworld, all beings and creatures, are infused with Your Light.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sukh mukat naam dhun baanee sach naam ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: All comforts and liberation are found in the Naam, and the vibrations of the Guru's Bani; I have enshrined the True Name within my heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੯॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam binaa nahee chhooTas naanak saachee tar too taaree ||9||7||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, no one is saved; O Nanak, with the Truth, cross over to the other side. ||9||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sa(n)jog upaae rakat bi(n)dh mil pi(n)dd kare ||
verses.translation: Through the union of mother and father, the fetus is formed. The egg and sperm join together to make the body.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਉਰਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar garabh uradh liv laagee so prabh saare dhaat kare ||1||
verses.translation: Upside-down within the womb, it lovingly dwells on the Lord; God provides for it, and gives it nourishment there. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar bhavajal kiau tarai ||
verses.translation: How can he cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam nira(n)jan paieeaai afario bhaar afaar Tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unbearable load of sins is removed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: te gun visar ge aparaadhee mai bauraa kiaa karau hare ||
verses.translation: I have forgotten Your Virtues, Lord; I am insane - what can I do now?

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa dhiaal sabhai sir ahinis dhaat samaar kare ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Merciful Giver, above the heads of all. Day and night, You give gifts, and take care of all. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath lai jag janamiaa siv sakatee ghar vaas dhare ||
verses.translation: One is born to achieve the four great objectives of life. The spirit has taken up its home in the material world.

verses.original: ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: laagee bhookh maiaa mag johai mukat padhaarath moh khare ||3||
verses.translation: Driven by hunger, it sees the path of Maya's riches; this emotional attachment takes away the treasure of liberation. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: karan palaav kare nahee paavai it ut ddooddat thaak pare ||
verses.translation: Weeping and wailing, he does not receive them; he searches here and there, and grows weary.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar viaape kooR kuTa(n)b siau preet kare ||4||
verses.translation: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he falls in love with his false relatives. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਾਵੈ ਭੋਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਾਲ ਘਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khaavai bhogai sun sun dhekhai pahir dhikhaavai kaal ghare ||
verses.translation: He eats and enjoys, listens and watches, and dresses up to show off in this house of death.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਟਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na aap pachhaanai bin har naam na kaal Tare ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not undersand himself. Without the Lord's Name, death cannot be avoided. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਛੀਨਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa moh haumai kar bhoole meree meree karate chheen khare ||
verses.translation: The more attachment and egotism delude and confuse him, the more he cries out, ""Mine, mine!"", and the more he loses out.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਹਸੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tan dhan binasai sahasai sahasaa fir pachhutaavai mukh dhoor pare ||6||
verses.translation: His body and wealth pass away, and he is torn by skepticism and cynicism; in the end, he regrets and repents, when the dust falls on his face. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਕਫੁ ਕੰਠੁ ਬਿਰੂਧੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਢਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: biradh bhiaa joban tan khisiaa kaf ka(n)Th biroodho nainahu neer ddare ||
verses.translation: He grows old, his body and youth waste away, and his throat is plugged with mucous; water flows from his eyes.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: charan rahe kar ka(n)pan laage saakat raam na ridhai hare ||7||
verses.translation: His feet fail him, and his hands shake and tremble; the faithless cynic does not enshrine the Lord in his heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਖਿਓ ਘਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: surat giee kaalee hoo dhaule kisai na bhaavai rakhio ghare ||
verses.translation: His intellect fails him, his black hair turns white, and no one wants to keep him in their home.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bisarat naam aaise dhokh laageh jam maar samaare narak khare ||8||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, these are the stigmas which stick to him; the Messenger of Death beats him, and drags him to hell. ||8||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: poorab janam ko lekh na miTiee janam marai kaa kau dhos dhare ||
verses.translation: The record of one's past actions cannot be erased; who else is to blame for one's birth and death?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin gur baadh jeevan hor maranaa bin gur sabadhai janam jare ||9||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, life and death are pointless; without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, life just burns away. ||9||

verses.original: ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰ ਭਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khusee khuaar bhe ras bhogan fokaT karam vikaar kare ||
verses.translation: The pleasures enjoyed in happiness bring ruin; acting in corruption is useless indulgence.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naam bisaar lobh mool khoio sir dharam rai kaa dda(n)dd pare ||10||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, and caught by greed, he betrays his own source; the club of the Righteous Judge of Dharma will strike him over the head. ||10||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam gun gaaveh jaa kau har prabh nadhar kare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name; the Lord God blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: te niramal purakh apara(n)par poore te jag meh gur govi(n)dh hare ||11||
verses.translation: Those beings are pure, perfect unlimited and infinite; in this world, they are the embodiment of the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||11||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har simarahu gur bachan samaarahu sa(n)gat har jan bhaau kare ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord; meditate and contemplate the Guru's Word, and love to associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: har jan gur paradhaan dhuaarai naanak tin jan kee ren hare ||12||8||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants are the embodiment of the Guru; they are supreme and respected in the Court of the Lord. Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||12||8||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo kaafee mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Kaafee, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਆਵਉ ਵੰਞਉ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਕਿਤੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: aavau va(n)n(j)au ddu(n)manee kitee mitr kareau ||
verses.translation: The double-minded person comes and goes, and has numerous friends.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਾਢੀ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੇਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa dhan ddoiee na lahai vaaddee kiau dheereau ||1||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is separated from her Lord, and she has no place of rest; how can she be comforted? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈਡਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪਿਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiddaa man rataa aapanaRe pir naal ||
verses.translation: My mind is attuned to the Love of my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੀਤੀ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau ghol ghumaiee kha(n)neeaai keetee hik bhoree nadhar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to the Lord; if only He would bless me with His Glance of Grace, even for an instant! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai ddohaaganee saahuraRai kiau jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a rejected bride, abandoned in my parents' home; how can I go to my in-laws now?

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai gal aaugan muThaRee bin pir jhoor maraau ||2||
verses.translation: I wear my faults around my neck; without my Husband Lord, I am grieving, and wasting away to death. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai pir sa(n)malaa saahuraRai ghar vaas ||
verses.translation: But if, in my parents' home, I remember my Husband Lord, then I will come to dwell in the home of my in-laws yet.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਧਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukh sava(n)dh sohaaganee pir paiaa gunataas ||3||
verses.translation: The happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they find their Husband Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||3||

verses.original: ਲੇਫੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lef nihaalee paT kee kaapaR a(n)g banai ||
verses.translation: Their blankets and mattresses are made of silk, and so are the clothes on their bodies.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਮੁਤੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pir mutee ddohaaganee tin ddukhee rain vihai ||4||
verses.translation: The Lord rejects the impure soul-brides. Their life-night passes in misery. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਿਤੀ ਚਖਉ ਸਾਡੜੇ ਕਿਤੀ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: kitee chakhau saaddaRe kitee ves kareau ||
verses.translation: I have tasted many flavors, and worn many robes,

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਇਅਮੁ ਵਾਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pir bin joban baadh giam vaaddee jhooredhee jhooreau ||5||
verses.translation: but without my Husband Lord, my youth is slipping away uselessly; I am separated from Him, and I cry out in pain. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sache sa(n)dhaa sadhaRaa suneeaai gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sache sachaa baihanaa nadharee nadhar piaar ||6||
verses.translation: True is the home of the True Lord; by His Gracious Grace, I love Him. ||6||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਡੇਖੈ ਡੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee a(n)jan sach kaa ddekhai ddekhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The spiritual teacher applies the ointment of Truth to his eyes, and sees God, the Seer.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh boojhai jaaneeaai haumai garab nivaar ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh comes to know and understand; ego and pride are subdued. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਤਉ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਮੂ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਕਿਤੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: tau bhaavan tau jeheeaa moo jeheeaa kiteeaaeh ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are pleased with those who are like Yourself; there are many more like me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੈ ਰਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naahu na veechhuRai tin sachai rataReeaaeh ||8||1||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Husband does not separate from those who are imbued with Truth. ||8||1||9||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਭੈਣਾ ਭਰਜਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਸਸੁੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: naa bhainaa bharajaieeaa naa se sasuReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Neither the sisters, nor the sisters-in-law, nor the mothers-in-law, shall remain.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹੀਆਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachaa saak na tuTiee gur mele saheeaaeh ||1||
verses.translation: The true relationship with the Lord cannot be broken; it was established by the Lord, O sister soul-brides. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਤਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਮੁ ਦਿਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin etaa bhav thakee gur pir melim dhitam milai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wandering so far without the Guru, I grew weary; now, the Guru has united me in Union with my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਫੁਫੀ ਨਾਨੀ ਮਾਸੀਆ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: fufee naanee maaseeaa dher jeThaanaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Aunts, uncles, grandparents and sisters-in-law

verses.original: ਆਵਨਿ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਨਾ ਰਹਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਹੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aavan va(n)n(j)n naa rahan poor bhare paheeaaeh ||2||
verses.translation: - they all come and go; they cannot remain. They are like boatloads of passengers embarking. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਾਣੀਆ ਭਾਇਰ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maame tai maamaaneeaa bhair baap na maau ||
verses.translation: Uncles, aunts, and cousins of all sorts, cannot remain.

verses.original: ਸਾਥ ਲਡੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਠੀਆ ਭੀੜ ਘਣੀ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saath ladde tin naaTheeaa bheeR ghanee dhareeaau ||3||
verses.translation: The caravans are full, and great crowds of them are loading up at the riverbank. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੋ ਸਖੀ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachau ra(n)g ra(n)gaavalo sakhee hamaaro ka(n)t ||
verses.translation: O sister-friends, my Husband Lord is dyed in the color of Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sach vichhoRaa naa theeaai so sahu ra(n)g rava(n)t ||4||
verses.translation: She who lovingly remembers her True Husband Lord is not separated from Him again. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe rutee cha(n)geeaa jit sache siau neh ||
verses.translation: All the seasons are good, in which the soul-bride falls in love with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਡੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saa dhan ka(n)t pachhaaniaa sukh sutee nis ddeh ||5||
verses.translation: That soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord, sleeps in peace, night and day. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਤਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੁਕਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: patan kooke paatanee va(n)n(j)h dhruk vilaaR ||
verses.translation: At the ferry, the ferryman announces, ""O travellers, hurry up and cross over.""

verses.original: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੜੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: paar pava(n)dhaRe ddiTh mai satigur bohith chaaR ||6||
verses.translation: I have seen them crossing over there, on the boat of the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਿਕਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਿਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਹਿਕਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hikanee ladhiaa hik ladh ge hik bhaare bhar naal ||
verses.translation: Some are getting on board, and some have already set out; some are weighed down with their loads.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa se sache prabh naal ||7||
verses.translation: Those who deal in Truth, remain with their True Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਖੀਅਹ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa ham cha(n)ge aakhe'eeh buraa na dhisai koi ||
verses.translation: I am not called good, and I see none who are bad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak haumai maareeaai sache jehaRaa soi ||8||2||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who conquers and subdues his ego, becomes just like the True Lord. ||8||2||10||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa jaanaa moorakh hai koiee naa jaanaa siaanaa ||
verses.translation: I do not believe that anyone is foolish; I do not believe that anyone is clever.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa saahib kai ra(n)ge raataa anadhin naam vakhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued forever with the Love of my Lord and Master, I chant His Name, night and day. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa moorakh haa naavai bal jaau ||
verses.translation: O Baba, I am so foolish, but I am a sacrifice to the Name.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa too dhaanaa beenaa terai naam taraau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, You are wise and all-seeing. Through Your Name, we are carried across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh siaanaa ek hai ek jot dhui naau ||
verses.translation: The same person is foolish and wise; the same light within has two names.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moorakhaa sir moorakh hai j ma(n)ne naahee naau ||2||
verses.translation: The most foolish of the foolish are those who do not believe in the Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhuaarai naau paieeaai bin satigur palai na pai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Gate, the Gurdwara, the Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, it is not received.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai man vasai taa ahinis rahai liv lai ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will, the Name comes to dwell in the mind, and then, night and day, one remains lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੰ ਰੰਗੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਮਾਲੰ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: raaja(n) ra(n)ga(n) roopa(n) maala(n) joban te jooaaree ||
verses.translation: In power, pleasures, beauty, wealth and youth, one gambles his life away.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਸੈ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਏਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hukamee baadhe paasai kheleh chaupaR ekaa saaree ||4||
verses.translation: Bound by the Hukam of God's Command, the dice are thrown; he is just a piece in the game of chess. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jag chatur siaanaa bharam bhulaanaa naau pa(n)ddit paReh gaavaaree ||
verses.translation: The world is clever and wise, but it is deluded by doubt, and forgets the Name; the Pandit, the religious scholar, studies the scriptures, but he is still a fool.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naau visaareh bedh samaaleh bikh bhoole lekhaaree ||5||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Name, he dwells upon the Vedas; he writes, but he is confused by his poisonous corruption. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਲਰ ਖੇਤੀ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੰਠੇ ਬਾਗਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਜਲੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kalar khetee taravar ka(n)The baagaa pahireh kajal jharai ||
verses.translation: He is like the crop planted in the salty soil, or the tree growing on the river bank, or the white clothes sprinkled with dirt.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਸੋ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਰੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eh sa(n)saar tisai kee koThee jo paisai so garab jarai ||6||
verses.translation: This world is the house of desire; whoever enters it, is burnt down by egotistical pride. ||6||

verses.original: ਰਯਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਹਾ ਸਬਾਏ ਦੁਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: rayat raaje kahaa sabaae dhuh a(n)tar so jaasee ||
verses.translation: Where are all the kings and their subjects? Those who are immersed in duality are destroyed.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਰਹਸੀ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੭॥੩॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak gur sache kee pauRee rahasee alakh nivaasee ||7||3||11||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, these are the steps of the ladder, of the Teachings of the True Guru; only the Unseen Lord shall remain. ||7||3||11||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ghar panjavaa asaTapadhee
verses.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehla, Fifth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no prem ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is filled with the Lord's Love,

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: is intuitively exalted by the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਵੇਦਨ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ehaa vedhan soiee jaanai avar k jaanai kaaree jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: He alone knows the pain of this love; what does anyone else know about its cure? ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape mele aap milaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself unites in His Union.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa piaar aape laae ||
verses.translation: He Himself inspires us with His Love.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prem kee saar soiee jaanai jis no nadhar tumaaree jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone appreciates the value of Your Love, upon whom You shower Your Grace, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhib dhirasaT jaagai bharam chukaae ||
verses.translation: One whose spiritual vision is awakened - his doubt is driven out.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paae ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so jogee ieh jugat pachhaanai gur kai sabadh beechaaree jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: He alone is a Yogi, who understands this way, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jogee dhan pir melaa hovai ||
verses.translation: By good destiny, the soul-bride is united with her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat vichahu dhuramat khovai ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, she eradicates her evil-mindedness from within.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g siau nit raleeaa maanai apane ka(n)t piaaree jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: With love, she continually enjoys pleasure with Him; she becomes the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu vaidh na koiee ||
verses.translation: Other than the True Guru, there is no physician.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap nira(n)jan soiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai marai ma(n)dhaa hovai giaan beechaaree jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, evil is conquered, and spiritual wisdom is contemplated. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eh sabadh saar jis no laae ||
verses.translation: One who is committed to this most sublime Shabad

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tirasanaa bhukh gavaae ||
verses.translation: becomes Gurmukh, and is rid of thirst and hunger.

verses.original: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aapan leeaa kichhoo na paieeaai kar kirapaa kal dhaaree jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: By one's own efforts, nothing can be accomplished; the Lord, in His Mercy, bestows power. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agam nigam satiguroo dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed the essence of the Shaastras and the Vedas.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He has come into the home of my self.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan jaataa jin kau nadhar tumaaree jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: In the midst of Maya, the Immaculate Lord is known, by those upon whom You bestow Your Grace. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so tat paae ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, obtains the essence of reality;

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap vichahu gavaae ||
verses.translation: he eradictes his self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu sabh dha(n)dh kamaavai vekhahu man veechaaree jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, all are entangled in worldly affairs; consider this in your mind, and see. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhram bhoole fireh aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: Some are deluded by doubt; they strut around egotistically.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa gurmukh haumai maaree ||
verses.translation: Some, as Gurmukh, subdue their egotism.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh rate bairaagee hor bharam bhule gaavaaree jeeau ||8||
verses.translation: Attuned to the True Word of the Shabad, they remain detached from the world. The other ignorant fools wander, confused and deluded by doubt. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jinee naam na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have not become Gurmukh, and who have not found the Naam, the Name of the Lord

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: those self-willed manmukhs waste their lives uselessly.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: agai vin naavai ko belee naahee boojhai gur beechaaree jeeau ||9||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter, nothing except the Name will be of any assistance; this is understood by contemplating the Guru. ||9||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam is the Giver of peace forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai jug chaare jaataa ||
verses.translation: Throughout the four ages, it is known through the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis too dheveh soiee paae naanak tat beechaaree jeeau ||10||1||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||10||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh bhramate bhramate dhulabh janam ab paio ||1||
verses.translation: Wandering and roaming through 8.4 million incarnations, you have now been given this human life, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਤੂ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: re mooRe too hochhai ras lapaTaio ||
verses.translation: You fool! You are attached and clinging to such trivial pleasures!

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit sa(n)g basat hai terai bikhiaa siau urajhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar abides with you, but you are engrossed in sin and corruption. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਬਨਜਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ratan javehar banajan aaio kaalar laadh chalaio ||2||
verses.translation: You have come to trade in gems and jewels, but you have loaded only barren soil. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਹਨਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeh ghar meh tudh rahanaa basanaa so ghar cheet na aaio ||3||
verses.translation: That home within which you live - you have not kept that home in your thoughts. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aTal akha(n)dd praan sukhadhaiee ik nimakh nahee tujh gaio ||4||
verses.translation: He is immovable, indestructible, the Giver of peace to the soul; and yet you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jahaa jaanaa so thaan visaario ik nimakh nahee man laio ||5||
verses.translation: You have forgotten that place where you must go; you have not attached your mind to the Lord, even for an instant. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr gireh dhekh samagree is hee meh urajhaio ||6||
verses.translation: Gazing upon your children, spouse, household and paraphernalia, you are entangled in them. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jit ko laio tit hee laagaa taise karam kamaio ||7||
verses.translation: As God links the mortals, so are they linked, and so are the deeds they do. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau bhio kirapaal taa saadhasa(n)g paiaa jan naanak braham dhiaaio ||8||1||
verses.translation: When He becomes Merciful, then the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is found; servant Nanak meditates on God. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar anugrahu raakh leeno bhio saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He has protected me; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰੈ ਮਿਸਟ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam ras rasanaa uchaarai misaT gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: My tongue lovingly chants the Lord's Name; this love is so sweet and intense! ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere maan ko asathaan ||
verses.translation: He is the place of rest for my mind,

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: my friend, companion, associate and relative; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||
