verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar jin upaio saran prabh kee gahee ||
verses.translation: He created the world-ocean; I seek the Sanctuary of that God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadhee prabh araadhe jamaka(n)kar kichh na kahee ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I worship and adore God; the Messenger of Death can't say anything to me. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mokh mukat dhuaar jaa kai sa(n)t ridhaa bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Emancipation and liberation are at His Door; He is the treasure in the hearts of the Saints.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeea jugat sujaan suaamee sadhaa raakhanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: The all-knowing Lord and Master shows us the true way of life; He is our Savior and Protector forever. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਲੇਸ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh kales binaseh jis basai man maeh ||
verses.translation: Pain, suffering and troubles are eradicated, when the Lord abides in the mind.

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mrit narak asathaan bikhaRe bikh na pohai taeh ||4||
verses.translation: Death, hell and the most horrible dwelling of sin and corruption cannot even touch such a person. ||4||

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: ridh sidh nav nidh jaa kai a(n)mritaa paravaeh ||
verses.translation: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures come from the Lord, as do the streams of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)te madh pooran uooch agam agaeh ||5||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is perfect, lofty, unapproachable and unfathomable. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik dhev mun jan bedh kareh uchaar ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas, seekers, angelic beings, silent sages, and the Vedas speak of Him.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: simar suaamee sukh sahaj bhu(n)cheh nahee a(n)t paaraavaar ||6||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, celestial peace is enjoyed; He has no end or limitation. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik praachhat miTeh khin meh ridhai jap bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: Countless sins are erased in an instant, meditating on the Benevolent Lord within the heart.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਨਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: paavanaa te mahaa paavan koT dhaan isanaan ||7||
verses.translation: Such a person becomes the purest of the pure, and is blessed with the merits of millions of donations to charity and cleansing baths. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: bal budh sudh paraan sarabas sa(n)tanaa kee raas ||
verses.translation: God is power, intellect, understanding, the breath of life, wealth, and everything for the Saints.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: bisar naahee nimakh man te naanak kee aradhaas ||8||2||
verses.translation: May I never forget Him from my mind, even for an instant - this is Nanak's prayer. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਤੀਖਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sasatr teekhan kaaT ddaario man na keeno ros ||
verses.translation: The sharp tool cuts down the tree, but it does not feel anger in its mind.

verses.original: ਕਾਜੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਲੇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਨੋ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaaj uaa ko le savaario til na dheeno dhos ||1||
verses.translation: It serves the purpose of the cutter, and does not blame him at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere raam rau nit neet ||
verses.translation: O my mind, continually, continuously, meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal dhev kirapaal gobi(n)dh sun sa(n)tanaa kee reet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is merciful, divine and compassionate. Listen - this is the way of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਉਗਾਹਿ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan talai ugaeh baisio sram na rahio sareer ||
verses.translation: He plants his feet in the boat, and then sits down in it; the fatigue of his body is relieved.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਤੀਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahaa saagar neh viaapai khineh utario teer ||2||
verses.translation: The great ocean does not even affect him; in an instant, he arrives on the other shore. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਅਗਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਲੇਪਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan agar kapoor lepan tis sa(n)ge nahee preet ||
verses.translation: Sandalwood, aloe, and camphor-paste - the earth does not love them.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਖੋਦਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਮਨੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa mootr khodh til til man na manee bipareet ||3||
verses.translation: But it doesn't mind, if someone digs it up bit by bit, and applies manure and urine to it. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਲਗਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
verses.translit: uooch neech bikaar sukirat sa(n)lagan sabh sukh chhatr ||
verses.translation: High and low, bad and good - the comforting canopy of the sky stretches evenly over all.

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਤ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mitr satr na kachhoo jaanai sarab jeea samat ||4||
verses.translation: It knows nothing of friend and enemy; all beings are alike to it. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: kar pragaas pracha(n)dd pragaTio a(n)dhakaar binaas ||
verses.translation: Blazing with its dazzling light, the sun rises, and dispels the darkness.

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਹ ਕਿਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਖਾਦੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pavitr apavitreh kiran laage man na bhio bikhaadh ||5||
verses.translation: Touching both the pure and the impure, it harbors no hatred to any. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: seet ma(n)dh suga(n)dh chalio sarab thaan samaan ||
verses.translation: The cool and fragrant wind gently blows upon all places alike.

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਸਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਹਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jahaa saa kichh tahaa laagio til na sa(n)kaa maan ||6||
verses.translation: Wherever anything is, it touches it there, and does not hesitate a bit. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਭਾਇ ਜੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੀਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: subhai abhai ju nikaT aavai seet taa kaa jai ||
verses.translation: Good or bad, whoever comes close to the fire - his cold is taken away.

verses.original: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai sadhaa sahaj subhai ||7||
verses.translation: It knows nothing of its own or others'; it is constant in the same quality. ||7||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸਨਾਥ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: charan saran sanaath ih man ra(n)g raate laal ||
verses.translation: Whoever seeks the Sancuary of the feet of the Sublime Lord - his mind is attuned to the Love of the Beloved.

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: gopaal gun nit gaau naanak bhe prabh kirapaal ||8||3||
verses.translation: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, O Nanak, God becomes merciful to us. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚਾਦਨਾ ਚਾਦਨੁ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਦਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaadhanaa chaadhan aa(n)gan prabh jeeau a(n)tar chaadhanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Moonlight, moonlight - in the courtyard of the mind, let the moonlight of God shine down. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaraadhanaa araadhan neekaa har har naam araadhanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meditation, meditation - sublime is meditation on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tiaaganaa tiaagan neekaa kaam karodh lobh tiaaganaa ||3||
verses.translation: Renunciation, renunciation - noble is the renunciation of sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਗਨਾ ਮਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: maaganaa maagan neekaa har jas gur te maaganaa ||4||
verses.translation: Begging, begging - it is noble to beg for the Lord's Praise from the Guru. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਨਾ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jaaganaa jaagan neekaa har keeratan meh jaaganaa ||5||
verses.translation: Vigils, vigils - sublime is the vigil spent singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||5||

verses.original: ਲਾਗਨਾ ਲਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: laaganaa laagan neekaa gur charanee man laaganaa ||6||
verses.translation: Attachment, attachment - sublime is the attachment of the mind to the Guru's Feet. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh tiseh paraapate jaa kai masatak bhaaganaa ||7||
verses.translation: He alone is blessed with this way of life, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਨਾ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis sabh kichh neekaa jo prabh kee saranaaganaa ||8||1||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, everything is sublime and noble, for one who enters the Sanctuary of God. ||8||1||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਉ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aau jee too aau hamaarai har jas sravan sunaavanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please come, O please come into the home of my heart, that I may hear with my ears the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudh aavat meraa man tan hariaa har jas tum sa(n)g gaavanaa ||1||
verses.translation: With your coming, my soul and body are rejuvenated, and I sing with you the Lord's Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kirapaa te hiradhai vaasai dhoojaa bhaau miTaavanaa ||2||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saint, the Lord dwells within the heart, and the love of duality is eradicated. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਤਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagat dhiaa te budh paragaasai dhuramat dhookh tajaavanaa ||3||
verses.translation: By the kindness of the devotee, the intellect is enlightened, and pain and evil-mindedness are eradicated. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTat hot puneetaa punarap garabh na paavanaa ||4||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is sanctified, and is no longer consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: nau nidh ridh sidh paiee jo tumarai man bhaavanaa ||5||
verses.translation: The nine treasures, wealth and miraculous spiritual powers are obtained, by one who is pleasing to Your mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t binaa mai thaau na koiee avar na soojhai jaavanaa ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Saint, I have no place of rest at all; I cannot think of any other place to go. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: moh niragun kau koi na raakhai sa(n)taa sa(n)g samaavanaa ||7||
verses.translation: I am unworthy; no one gives me sanctuary. But in the Society of the Saints, I merge in God. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur chalat dhikhaiaa man madhe har har raavanaa ||8||2||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed this miracle; within my mind, I enjoy the Lord, Har, Har. ||8||2||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevanaa safal jeevan sun har jap jap sadh jeevanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the life, the life of one who hears about the Lord, and chants and meditates on Him; he lives forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੀਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: peevanaa jit man aaghaavai naam a(n)mirat ras peevanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The real drink is that which satisfies the mind; this drink is the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਾਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khaavanaa jit bhookh na laagai sa(n)tokh sadhaa tirapateevanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The real food is that which will never leave you hungry again; it will leave you contented and satisfied forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੈਨਣਾ ਰਖੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: painanaa rakh pat paramesur fir naage nahee theevanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The real clothes are those which protect your honor before the Transcendent Lord, and do not leave you naked ever again. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੋਗਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhoganaa man madhe har ras sa(n)tasa(n)gat meh leevanaa ||4||
verses.translation: The real enjoyment within the mind is to be absorbed in the sublime essence of the Lord, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਈ ਆਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin taage bin sooiee aanee man har bhagatee sa(n)g seevanaa ||5||
verses.translation: Sew devotional worship to the Lord into the mind, without any needle or thread. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਅਉਖੀਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: maatiaa har ras meh raate tis bahuR na kabahoo aaukheevanaa ||6||
verses.translation: Imbued and intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, this experience will never wear off again. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: milio tis sarab nidhaanaa prabh kirapaal jis dheevanaa ||7||
verses.translation: One is blessed with all treasures, when God, in His Mercy, gives them. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: sukh naanak sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan sa(n)t dhoi peevanaa ||8||3||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, service to the Saints beings peace; I drink in the wash water of the feet of the Saints. ||8||3||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅੰਜੁਲੀਆ
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ghar atthvaa a(n)juleeaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis gireh bahut tisai gireh chi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The household which is filled with abundance - that household suffers anxiety.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis gireh thoree su firai bhrama(n)taa ||
verses.translation: One whose household has little, wanders around searching for more.

verses.original: ਦੁਹੂ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਾਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuhoo bivasathaa te jo mukataa soiee suhelaa bhaaleeaai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone is happy and at peace, who is liberated from both conditions. ||1||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰੋਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: gireh raaj meh narak udhaas karodhaa ||
verses.translation: Householders and kings fall into hell, along with renunciates and angry men,

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh bedh paaTh sabh sodhaa ||
verses.translation: and all those who study and recite the Vedas in so many ways.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhehee meh jo rahai alipataa tis jan kee pooran ghaaleeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Perfect is the work of that humble servant, who remains unattached while in the body. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat sootaa bharam vigootaa ||
verses.translation: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur mukat na hoieeaai meetaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, friend.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g tuTeh hau ba(n)dhan eko ek nihaaleeaai ||3||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the bonds of egotism are released, and one comes to behold the One and only Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਬੰਧਾ ਨਹ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: karam karai ta ba(n)dhaa neh karai ta ni(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Doing deeds, one is placed in bondage; but if he does not act, he is slandered.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: moh magan man viaapiaa chi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with emotional attachment, the mind is afflicted with anxiety.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਜਾਣੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh sukh dhukh sam jaanai ghaT ghaT raam hiaaleeaai ||4||
verses.translation: One who looks alike upon pleasure and pain, by Guru's Grace, sees the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saarai meh sahasaa biaapai ||
verses.translation: Within the world, one is afflicted by skepticism;

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa agochar nahee jaapai ||
verses.translation: he does not know the imperceptible Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗੀ ਪਾਲੀਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jiseh bujhaae soiee boojhai oh baalak vaagee paaleeaai ||5||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Lord cherishes him as His child. ||5||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd bahai tau chhooTai naahee ||
verses.translation: He may try to abandon Maya, but he is not released.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jau sa(n)chai tau bhau man maahee ||
verses.translation: If he collects things, then his mind is afraid of losing them.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਉਰੁ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eis hee meh jis kee pat raakhai tis saadhoo chaur ddaaleeaai ||6||
verses.translation: I wave the fly-brush over that holy person, whose honor is protected in the midst of Maya. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo sooraa tis hee hoi maranaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a warrior hero, who remains dead to the world.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਭਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo bhaagai tis jonee firanaa ||
verses.translation: One who runs away will wander in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo varataae soiee bhal maanai bujh hukamai dhuramat jaaleeaai ||7||
verses.translation: Whatever happens, accept that as good. Realize the Hukam of His Command, and your evil-mindedness will be burnt away. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laaveh tit tit laganaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever He links us to, to that we are linked.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਜਚਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai apane jachanaa ||
verses.translation: He acts, and does, and watches over His Creation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak ke pooran sukhadhaate too dheh ta naam samaaleeaai ||8||1||7||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of peace, the Perfect Lord of Nanak; as You grant Your blessings, I dwell upon Your Name. ||8||1||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਰਖੈ ਹੇਠਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ਇਕਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: birakhai heTh sabh ja(n)t ikaThe ||
verses.translation: Beneath the tree, all beings have gathered.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਤਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik tate ik bolan miThe ||
verses.translation: Some are hot-headed, and some speak very sweetly.

verses.original: ਅਸਤੁ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਅਉਧ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asat udhot bhiaa uTh chale jiau jiau aaudh vihaaneeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Sunset has come, and they rise up and depart; their days have run their course and expired. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇਦੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: paap karedhaR sarapar muThe ||
verses.translation: Those who committed sins are sure to be ruined.

verses.original: ਅਜਰਾਈਲਿ ਫੜੇ ਫੜਿ ਕੁਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: ajaraieel faRe faR kuThe ||
verses.translation: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, seizes and tortures them.

verses.original: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhojak paae sirajanahaarai lekhaa ma(n)gai baaneeaa ||2||
verses.translation: They are consigned to hell by the Creator Lord, and the Accountant calls them to give their account. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਭਈਆ ਬੇਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g na koiee bhieeaa bebaa ||
verses.translation: No brothers or sisters can go with them.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਞੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: maal joban dhan chhodd van(j)esaa ||
verses.translation: Leaving behind their property, youth and wealth, they march off.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karan kareem na jaato karataa til peeRe jiau ghaaneeaa ||3||
verses.translation: They do not know the kind and compassionate Lord; they shall be crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||3||

verses.original: ਖੁਸਿ ਖੁਸਿ ਲੈਦਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khus khus laidhaa vasat paraiee ||
verses.translation: You happily, cheerfully steal the possessions of others,

verses.original: ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vekhai sune terai naal khudhaiee ||
verses.translation: but the Lord God is with you, watching and listening.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਬਿ ਪਇਆ ਖਾਤ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਗਲ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa lab piaa khaat a(n)dhar agalee gal na jaaneeaa ||4||
verses.translation: Through worldly greed, you have fallen into the pit; you know nothing of the future. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ॥
verses.translit: jam jam marai marai fir ja(n)mai ||
verses.translation: You shall be born and born again, and die and die again, only to be reincarnated again.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ਦੇਸਿ ਲੰਮੈ ॥
verses.translit: bahut sajai piaa dhes la(n)mai ||
verses.translation: You shall suffer terrible punishment, on your way to the land beyond.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jin keetaa tisai na jaanee a(n)dhaa taa dhukh sahai paraaneeaa ||5||
verses.translation: The mortal does not know the One who created him; he is blind, and so he shall suffer. ||5||

verses.original: ਖਾਲਕ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: khaalak thaavahu bhulaa muThaa ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Creator Lord, he is ruined.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਰੁਠ ਤੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa khel buraa ruTh tuThaa ||
verses.translation: The drama of the world is bad; it brings sadness and then happiness.

verses.original: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਤੈ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sidhak sabooree sa(n)t na milio vatai aapan bhaaneeaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who does not meet the Saint does not have faith or contentment; he wanders just as he pleases. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਉਲਾ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥ ਇਕਿ ਕਢੇ ਇਕਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: maulaa khel kare sabh aape || ik kadde ik lahar viaape ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself stages all this drama. Some, he lifts up, and some he throws into the waves.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਚਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਚਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jiau nachaae tiau tiau nachan sir sir kirat vihaaneeaa ||7||
verses.translation: As He makes them dance, so do they dance. Everyone lives their lives according to their past actions. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: mihar kare taa khasam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord and Master grants His Grace, then we meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat narak na paiee ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, one is not consigned to hell.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam dhaan naanak kau gun geetaa nit vakhaaneeaa ||8||2||8||12||20||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord; he continually sings the songs of Your Glories. ||8||2||8||12||20||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
verses.translit: maaroo solahe mahalaa pehilaa
verses.translation: Maaroo, Solahas, First Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa sach soiee avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is True; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin sirajee tin hee fun goiee ||
verses.translation: He who created, shall in the end destroy.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਕਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu rahanaa tum siau kiaa mukaraiee he ||1||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, so You keep me, and so I remain; what excuse could I offer to You? ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae aap khapaae ||
verses.translation: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape sir sir dha(n)dhai laae ||
verses.translation: You yourself link each and every person to their tasks.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape veechaaree gunakaaree aape maarag laiee he ||2||
verses.translation: You contemplate Yourself, You Yourself make us worthy; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaanaa aape beenaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are all-wise, You Yourself are all-knowing.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap upai pateenaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the Universe, and You are pleased.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape paun paanee baisa(n)tar aape mel milaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the air, water and fire; You Yourself unite in Union. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape sas sooraa pooro pooraa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the moon, the sun, the most perfect of the perfect.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape giaan dhiaan gur sooraa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are spiritual wisdom, meditation, and the Guru, the Warrior Hero.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaal jaal jam joh na saakai saache siau liv laiee he ||4||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death, and his noose of death, cannot touch one, who is lovingly focused on You, O True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape purakh aape hee naaree ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the male, and You Yourself are the female.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape paasaa aape saaree ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the chess-board, and You Yourself are the chessman.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੜ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape piR baadhee jag khelai aape keemat paiee he ||5||
verses.translation: You Yourself staged the drama in the arena of the world, and You Yourself evaluate the players. ||5||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਵਰੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhavar ful fal taravar ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the bumble bee, the flower, the fruit and the tree.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape jal thal saagar saravar ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the water, the desert, the ocean and the pool.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀਕਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aape machh kachh karaneekar teraa roop na lakhanaa jaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the great fish, the tortoise, the Cause of causes; Your form cannot be known. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhinas aape hee rainee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the day, and You Yourself are the night.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap pateejai gur kee bainee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are pleased by the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh anaahadh anadhin ghaT ghaT sabadh rajaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the unstruck sound current resounds, night and day; in each and every heart, the Word of the Shabad, echoes Your Will. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: aape ratan anoop amolo ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the jewel, incomparably beautiful and priceless.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: aape parakhe pooraa tolo ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Assessor, the Perfect Weigher.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਸਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape kis hee kas bakhase aape dhe lai bhaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: You Yourself test and forgive. You Yourself give and take, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਧਨਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhanakh aape sarabaanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the bow, and He Himself is the archer.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape sughaR saroop siaanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is all-wise, beautiful and all-knowing.

verses.original: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਣਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: kahataa bakataa sunataa soiee aape banat banaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: He is the speaker, the orator and the listener. He Himself made what is made. ||9||

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: paun guroo paanee pit jaataa ||
verses.translation: Air is the Guru, and water is known to be the father.

verses.original: ਉਦਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: audhar sa(n)jogee dharatee maataa ||
verses.translation: The womb of the great mother earth gives birth to all.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas dhui dhaiee dhaiaa jag khelai khelaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: Night and day are the two nurses, male and female; the world plays in this play. ||10||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape machhulee aape jaalaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape guoo aape rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the cows, and You yourself are their keeper.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa jag jot tumaaree jaisee prabh furamaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: Your Light fills all the beings of the world; they walk according to Your Command, O God. ||11||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape jogee aape bhogee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Yogi, and You Yourself are the enjoyer.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape raseeaa param sa(n)jogee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the reveller; You form the supreme Union.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aape vebaanee nira(n)kaaree nirabhau taaRee laiee he ||12||
verses.translation: You Yourself are speechless, formless and fearless, absorbed in the primal ecstasy of deep meditation. ||12||

verses.original: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaanee baanee tujheh samaanee ||
verses.translation: The sources of creation and speech are contained within You, Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai sabh aavan jaanee ||
verses.translation: All that is seen, is coming and going.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: seiee saeh sache vaapaaree satigur boojh bujhaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: They are the true bankers and traders, whom the True Guru has inspired to understand. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh bujhaae satigur pooraa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is understood through the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa saache bharapooraa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is overflowing with all powers.

verses.original: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: afario veparavaahu sadhaa too naa tis til na tamaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: You are beyond our grasp, and forever independent. You do not have even an iota of greed. ||14||

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaal bikaal bhe dhevaane ||
verses.translation: Birth and death are meaningless, for those

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਹਜ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh sahaj ras a(n)tar maane ||
verses.translation: who enjoy the sublime celestial essence of the Shabad within their minds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aape mukat tirapat varadhaataa bhagat bhai man bhaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver of liberation, satisfaction and blessings, to those devotees who love Him in their minds. ||15||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap niraalam gur gam giaanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is immaculate; by contact with the Guru, spiritual wisdom is obtained.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai tujh maeh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen, shall merge into You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak neech bhikhiaa dhar jaachai mai dheejai naam vaddaiee he ||16||1||
verses.translation: Nanak, the lowly, begs for charity at Your Door; please, bless him with the glorious greatness of Your Name. ||16||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਅਕਾਸੰ ॥
verses.translit: aape dharatee dhaul akaasa(n) ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the earth, the mythical bull which supports it and the Akaashic ethers.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸੰ ॥
verses.translit: aape saache gun paragaasa(n) ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself reveals His Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jatee satee sa(n)tokhee aape aape kaar kamaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is celibate, chaste and contented; He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis karanaa so kar kar vekhai ||
verses.translation: He who created the creation, beholds what He has created.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: koi na meTai saache lekhai ||
verses.translation: No one can erase the Inscription of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae aape aape dhe vaddiaaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes; He Himself is the One who bestows glorious greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch chor cha(n)chal chit chaaleh ||
verses.translation: The five thieves cause the fickle consciousness to waver.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: par ghar joheh ghar nahee bhaaleh ||
verses.translation: It looks into the homes of others, but does not search its own home.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar ddahai ddeh dderee bin sabadhai pat jaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: The body-village crumbles into dust; without the Word of the Shabad, one's honor is lost. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur te boojhai tirabhavan soojhai ||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Lord through the Guru, comprehends the three worlds.

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maar manai siau loojhai ||
verses.translation: He subdues his desires, and struggles with his mind.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਜੇਹੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo tudh seveh se tudh hee jehe nirabhau baal sakhaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: Those who serve You, become just like You; O Fearless Lord, You are their best friend from infancy. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape surag machh piaalaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the heavenly realms, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape jot saroopee baalaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the embodiment of light, forever young.

verses.original: ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jaTaa bikaT bikaraal saroopee roop na rekhiaa kaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: With matted hair, and a horrible, dreadful form, still, You have no form or feature. ||5||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bedh katebee bhedh na jaataa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas and the Bible do not know the mystery of God.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis maat pitaa sut bhraataa ||
verses.translation: He has no mother, father, child or brother.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਸੈਲ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sagale sail upai samaae alakh na lakhanaa jaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: He created all the mountains, and levels them again; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਮੀਤ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar thaakee meet ghanere ||
verses.translation: I have grown weary of making so many friends.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koi na kaaTai avagun mere ||
verses.translation: No one can rid me of my sins and mistakes.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sur nar naath saahib sabhanaa sir bhai milai bhau jaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: God is the Supreme Lord and Master of all the angels and mortal beings; blessed with His Love, their fear is dispelled. ||7||

verses.original: ਭੂਲੇ ਚੂਕੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhoole chooke maarag paaveh ||
verses.translation: He puts back on the Path those who have wandered and strayed.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhulai toohai samajhaaveh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself make them stray, and You teach them again.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bin naavai mai avar na dheesai naavahu gat mit paiee he ||8||
verses.translation: I cannot see anything except the Name. Through the Name comes salvation and merit. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa jamunaa kel kedhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Ganges, the Jamunaa where Krishna played, Kaydar Naat'h,

verses.original: ਕਾਸੀ ਕਾਂਤੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaasee kaa(n)tee puree dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: Benares, Kanchivaram, Puri, Dwaarkaa,

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa saagar benee sa(n)gam aThasaTh a(n)k samaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: Ganga Saagar where the Ganges empties into the ocean, Trivaynee where the three rivers come together, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, are all merged in the Lord's Being. ||9||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape sidh saadhik veechaaree ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker, in meditative contemplation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape raajan pa(n)chaa kaaree ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the King and the Council.

verses.original: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: takhat bahai adhalee prabh aape bharam bhedh bhau jaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: God Himself, the wise Judge, sits on the throne; He takes away doubt, duality and fear. ||10||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape kaajee aape mulaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Qazi; He Himself is the Mullah.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap abhul na kabahoo bhulaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is infallible; He never makes mistakes.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aape mihar dhiaapat dhaataa naa kisai ko bairaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver of Grace, compassion and honor; He is no one's enemy. ||11||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis bakhase tis dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Whoever He forgives, He blesses with glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਸਭਸੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabhasai dhaataa til na tamaiee ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of all; He does not have even an iota of greed.

verses.original: ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: bharapur dhaar rahiaa nihakeval gupat pragaT sabh Thaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord is all pervading, permeating everywhere, both hidden and manifest. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa saalaahee agam apaarai ||
verses.translation: How can I praise the inaccessible, infinite Lord?

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਮੁਰਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saache sirajanahaar muraarai ||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord is the Enemy of ego.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare tis mele mel milai melaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: He unites those whom He blesses with His Grace; uniting them in His Union, they are united. ||13||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes dhuaarai ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva stand at His Door;

verses.original: ਊਭੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: uoobhe seveh alakh apaarai ||
verses.translation: they serve the unseen, infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: hor ketee dhar dheesai bilalaadhee mai ganat na aavai kaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: Millions of others can be seen crying at His door; I cannot even estimate their numbers. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saachee keerat saachee baanee ||
verses.translation: True is the Kirtan of His Praise, and True is the Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: hor na dheesai bedh puraanee ||
verses.translation: I can see no other in the Vedas and the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee saach sache gun gaavaa mai dhar hor na kaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: Truth is my capital; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. I have no other support at all. ||15||

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug saachaa hai bhee hosee ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, the True Lord is, and shall always be.

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaun na mooaa kaun na marasee ||
verses.translation: Who has not died? Who shall not die?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak neech kahai bena(n)tee dhar dhekhahu liv laiee he ||16||2||
verses.translation: Nanak the lowly offers this prayer; see Him within your own self, and lovingly focus on the Lord. ||16||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਨੀ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojee dhuramat a(n)nee bolee ||
verses.translation: In duality and evil-mindedness, the soul-bride is blind and deaf.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੀ ਕਚੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh kee kachee cholee ||
verses.translation: She wears the dress of sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਛੋਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghar var sahaj na jaanai chhohar bin pir needh na paiee he ||1||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord is within the home of her own heart, but she does not know Him; without her Husband Lord, she cannot go to sleep. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਭੜਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agan jalai bhaRakaare ||
verses.translation: The great fire of desire blazes within her.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh take ku(n)ddaa chaare ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh looks around in the four directions.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve kiau sukh paieeaai saache haath vaddaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, how can she find peace? Glorious greatness rests in the hands of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar nivaare ||
verses.translation: Eradicating sexual desire, anger and egotism,

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tasakar pa(n)ch sabadh sa(n)ghaare ||
verses.translation: she destroys the five thieves through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: giaan khaRag lai man siau loojhai manasaa maneh samaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: Taking up the sword of spiritual wisdom, she struggles with her mind, and hope and desire are smoothed over in her mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maa kee rakat pitaa bidh dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: From the union of the mother's egg and the father's sperm,

verses.original: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: moorat soorat kar aapaaraa ||
verses.translation: the form of infinite beauty has been created.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jot dhaat jetee sabh teree too karataa sabh Thaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: The blessings of light all come from You; You are the Creator Lord, pervading everywhere. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tujh hee keeaa ja(n)man maranaa ||
verses.translation: You have created birth and death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur te samajh paRee kiaa ddaranaa ||
verses.translation: Why should anyone fear, if they come to understand through the Guru?

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: too dhiaal dhiaa kar dhekheh dhukh dharadh sareerahu jaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: When You, O Merciful Lord, look with Your kindness, then pain and suffering leave the body. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਉ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar bais rahe bhau khaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who sits in the home of his own self, eats his own fears.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat raakhe Thaak rahaiaa ||
verses.translation: He quiets and holds his wandering mind still.

verses.original: ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kamal bigaas hare sar subhar aatam raam sakhaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: His heart-lotus blossoms forth in the overflowing green pool, and the Lord of his soul becomes his companion and helper. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: maran likhai ma(n)ddal meh aae ||
verses.translation: With their death already ordained, mortals come into this world.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਚਲਣਾ ਪਰਥਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kiau raheeaai chalanaa parathaae ||
verses.translation: How can they remain here? They have to go to the world beyond.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sachaa amar sache amaraa pur so sach milai vaddaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: True is the Lord's Command; the true ones dwell in the eternal city. The True Lord blesses them with glorious greatness. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaiaa jagat sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the whole world.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin siriaa tin dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: The One who made it, assigns the tasks to it.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sachai uoopar avar na dheesai saache keemat paiee he ||8||
verses.translation: I cannot see any other above the True Lord. The True Lord does the appraisal. ||8||

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਗੋਇਲੜਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai goilaRaa dhin chaare ||
verses.translation: In this green pasture, the mortal stays only a few days.

verses.original: ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khel tamaasaa dhu(n)dhookaare ||
verses.translation: He plays and frolics in utter darkness.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭਖਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: baajee khel ge baajeegar jiau nis supanai bhakhalaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: The jugglers have staged their show, and left, like people mumbling in a dream. ||9||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin kau takhat milee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: They alone are blessed with glorious greatness at the Lord's throne,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau man vasiaa liv laiee ||
verses.translation: who enshrine the fearless Lord in their minds, and lovingly center themselves on Him.

verses.original: ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰੀਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kha(n)ddee brahama(n)ddee paataalee pureeiee tirabhavan taaRee laiee he ||10||
verses.translation: In the galaxies and solar systems, nether regions, celestial realms and the three worlds, the Lord is in the primal void of deep absorption. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachee nagaree takhat sachaavaa ||
verses.translation: True is the village, and true is the throne,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saach milai sukh paavaa ||
verses.translation: of those Gurmukhs who meet with the True Lord, and find peace.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: saache saachai takhat vaddaiee haumai ganat gavaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: In Truth, seated upon the true throne, they are blessed with glorious greatness; their egotism is eradicated, along with the calculation of their account. ||11||

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਐ ਸਹਸਾ ਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ganat ganeeaai sahasaa jeeaai ||
verses.translation: Calculating its account, the soul becomes anxious.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੂਐ ਤੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kiau sukh paavai dhooaai teeaai ||
verses.translation: How can one find peace, through duality and the three gunas - the three qualities?

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: niramal ek nira(n)jan dhaataa gur poore te pat paiee he ||12||
verses.translation: The One Lord is immaculate and formless, the Great Giver; through the Perfect Guru, honor is obtained. ||12||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug viralee gurmukh jaataa ||
verses.translation: In each and every age, very rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa rav rahiaa man raataa ||
verses.translation: Their minds are imbued with the True, all-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: tis kee oT gahee sukh paiaa man tan mail na kaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: Seeking His Shelter, they find peace, and their minds and bodies are not stained with filth. ||13||

verses.original: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeebh rasain saachai raatee ||
verses.translation: Their tongues are imbued with the True Lord, the source of nectar;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਉ ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh sa(n)gee bhau na bharaatee ||
verses.translation: abiding with the Lord God, they have no fear or doubt.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਰਜੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sravan srot raje gurbaanee jotee jot milaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, their ears are satisfied, and their light merges into the Light. ||14||

verses.original: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੇ ਪਉ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: rakh rakh pair dhare pau dharanaa ||
verses.translation: Carefully, carefully, I place my feet upon the ground.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat dhekhau teree saranaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, I behold Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh dheh toohai man bhaaveh tujh hee siau ban aaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: Whether You grant me pain or pleasure, You are pleasing to my mind. I am in harmony with You. ||15||

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal ko belee naahee ||
verses.translation: No one is anyone's companion or helper at the very last moment;

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaataa tudh saalaahee ||
verses.translation: as Gurmukh, I realize You and praise You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee he ||16||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, I am detached; in the home of my own self deep within, I am absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||16||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee apar apaare ||
verses.translation: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You are infinite and incomparable.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aadh nira(n)jan khasam hamaare ||
verses.translation: You are my primal, immaculate Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saache jog jugat veechaaree saache taaRee laiee he ||1||
verses.translation: I contemplate the Way of Yoga, the Way of Union with the True Lord. I am truly absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ketaRiaa jug dhu(n)dhookaarai ||
verses.translation: For so many ages, there was only pitch darkness;

verses.original: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: taaRee laiee sirajanahaarai ||
verses.translation: the Creator Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach naam sachee vaddiaaiee saachai takhat vaddaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: There was the True Name, the glorious greatness of the Truth, and the glory of His true throne. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: satajug sat sa(n)tokh sareeraa ||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Truth, Truth and contentment filled the bodies.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat varatai gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
verses.translation: Truth was pervasive, Truth, deep, profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib sach parakhai saachai hukam chalaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: The True Lord appraises the mortals on the Touchstone of Truth, and issues His True Command. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokhee satigur pooraa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru is true and contented.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh mane so sooraa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a spiritual hero, who believes in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saachee dharageh saach nivaasaa maanai hukam rajaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: He alone obtains a true seat in the True Court of the Lord, who surrenders to the Command of the Commander. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satajug saach kahai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: In the Golden Age of Truth, everyone spoke the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach varatai saachaa soiee ||
verses.translation: Truth was pervasive - the Lord was Truth.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: man mukh saach bharam bhau bha(n)jan gurmukh saach sakhaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: With Truth in their minds and mouths, mortals were rid of doubt and fear. Truth was the friend of the Gurmukhs. ||5||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਇਕ ਚੂਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: tretai dharam kalaa ik chookee ||
verses.translation: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yoga, one power of Dharma was lost.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਚਰਣ ਇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸੂਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: teen charan ik dhubidhaa sookee ||
verses.translation: Three feet remained; through duality, one was cut off.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su saach vakhaanai manmukh pachai avaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: Those who were Gurmukh spoke the Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs wasted away in vain. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kadhe na dharageh seejhai ||
verses.translation: The manmukh never succeeds in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰੀਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai kiau a(n)tar reejhai ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can one be pleased within?

verses.original: ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: baadhe aaveh baadhe jaaveh sojhee boojh na kaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: In bondage they come, and in bondage they go; they understand and comprehend nothing. ||7||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਅਧੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhuaapur adhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, compassion was cut in half.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralaa cheenai koiee ||
verses.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, remembered the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: dhui pag dharam dhare dharaneedhar gurmukh saach tithaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: Dharmic faith, which upholds and supports the earth, had only two feet; Truth was revealed to the Gurmukhs. ||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਥਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: raaje dharam kareh parathaae ||
verses.translation: The kings acted righteously only out of self-interest.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ba(n)dhe dhaan karaae ||
verses.translation: Tied to hopes of reward, they gave to charities.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee thaake karam kamaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, liberation did not come, although they grew weary of performing rituals. ||9||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੰਗਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam kar mukat ma(n)gaahee ||
verses.translation: Practicing religious rituals, they sought liberation,

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath sabadh salaahee ||
verses.translation: but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadhai mukat na hoiee parapa(n)ch kar bharamaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, liberation is not obtained; practicing hypocrisy, they wander around confused. ||10||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਛੋਡੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa chhoddee na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Love and attachment to Maya cannot be abandoned.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: se chhooTe sach kaar kamaiee ||
verses.translation: They alone find release, who practice deeds of Truth.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ahinis bhagat rate veechaaree Thaakur siau ban aaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: Day and night, the devotees remain imbued with contemplative meditation; they become just like their Lord and Master. ||11||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik jap tap kar kar teerath naaveh ||
verses.translation: Some chant and practice intensive meditation, and take cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh ||
verses.translation: They walk as You will them to walk.

verses.original: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਪਤੀਜੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: haTh nigreh apateej na bheejai bin har gur kin pat paiee he ||12||
verses.translation: By stubborn rituals of self-suppression, the Lord is not pleased. No one has ever obtained honor, without the Lord, without the Guru. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: kalee kaal meh ik kal raakhee ||
verses.translation: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only one power remains.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur poore kinai na bhaakhee ||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one has even described it.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh kooR varatai varataaraa bin satigur bharam na jaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have staged the show of falsehood. Without the True Guru, doubt does not depart. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur veparavaahu sira(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Creator Lord, independent and carefree.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa jam kaan na chha(n)dhaa ba(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: He does not fear death, and He is not dependent on mortal men.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jo tis seve so abinaasee naa tis kaal sa(n)taiee he ||14||
verses.translation: Whoever serves Him becomes immortal and imperishable, and will not be tortured by death. ||14||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur meh aap rakhiaa karataare ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has enshrined Himself within the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh koT asa(n)kh udhaare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh saves countless millions.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa jagajeevan dhaataa nirabhau mail na kaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: The Life of the World is the Great Giver of all beings. The Fearless Lord has no filth at all. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagale jaacheh gur bha(n)ddaaree ||
verses.translation: Everyone begs from the Guru, God's Treasurer.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap nira(n)jan alakh apaaree ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the immaculate, unknowable, infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saach kahai prabh jaachai mai dheejai saach rajaiee he ||16||4||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth; he begs from God. Please bless me with the Truth, by Your Will. ||16||4||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachai mele sabadh milaae ||
verses.translation: The True Lord unites with those who are united with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaanaa sahaj samaae ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, we intuitively merge with Him.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan jot dharee paramesar avar na dhoojaa bhaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: The Light of the Transcendent Lord pervades the three worlds; there is no other at all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke chaakar tis kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: I am His servant; I serve Him.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh pateejai alakh abhevaa ||
verses.translation: He is unknowable and mysterious; He is pleased by the Shabad.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kaa gunakaaree karataa bakhas le vaddiaaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: The Creator is the Benefactor of His devotees. He forgives them - such is His greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhedhe toT na aavai saache ||
verses.translation: The True Lord gives and gives; His blessings never run short.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਉਦੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: lai lai mukar paudhe kaache ||
verses.translation: The false ones receive, and then deny having received.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਰੀਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mool na boojheh saach na reejheh dhoojai bharam bhulaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: They do not understand their origins, they are not pleased with the Truth, and so they wander in duality and doubt. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaag rahe dhin raatee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware, day and night.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: saache kee liv gurmat jaatee ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, they know the Love of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: manmukh soi rahe se looTe gurmukh saabat bhaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs remain asleep, and are plundered. The Gurmukhs remain safe and sound, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

verses.original: ਕੂੜੇ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRe aavai kooRe jaavai ||
verses.translation: The false come, and the false go;

verses.original: ਕੂੜੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRe raatee kooR kamaavai ||
verses.translation: imbued with falsehood, they practice only falsehood.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabadh mile se dharageh paidhe gurmukh surat samaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; the Gurmukhs focus their consciousness on Him. ||5||

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਠਗੀ ਠਗਵਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: kooR muThee Thagee ThagavaaRee ||
verses.translation: The false are cheated, and robbed by the robbers.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਵਾੜੀ ਓਜਾੜਿ ਉਜਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: jiau vaaRee ojaaR ujaaRee ||
verses.translation: The garden is laid waste, like the rough wilderness.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kichh saadh na laagai har bisariaai dhukh paiee he ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow. ||6||

verses.original: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhojan saach milai aaghaiee ||
verses.translation: Receiving the food of Truth, one is satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan saachee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: True is the glorious greatness of the jewel of the Name.

verses.original: ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: cheenai aap pachhaanai soiee jotee jot milaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: One who understands his own self, realizes the Lord. His light merges into the Light. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naavahu bhulee choTaa khaae ||
verses.translation: Wandering from the Name, he endures beatings.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bahut siaanap bharam na jaae ||
verses.translation: Even great cleverness does not dispel doubt.

verses.original: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: pach pach mue achet na cheteh ajagar bhaar ladhaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: The unconscious fool does not remain conscious of the Lord; he putrifies and rots away to death, carrying his heavy load of sin. ||8||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਰੋਧਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin baadh birodheh koiee naahee ||
verses.translation: No one is free of conflict and strife.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhekhaalih tis saalaahee ||
verses.translation: Show me anyone who is, and I will praise him.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: man tan arap milai jagajeevan har siau banat banaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: Dedicating mind and body to God, one meets the Lord, the Life of the World, and becomes just like Him. ||9||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee gat mit koi na paavai ||
verses.translation: No one knows the state and extent of God.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko vaddaa kahai vaddaiee khaavai ||
verses.translation: Whoever calls himself great, will be eaten by his greatness.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਦਾਤੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saache saahib toT na dhaatee sagalee tineh upaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: There is no lack of gifts of our True Lord and Master. He created all. ||10||

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee veparavaahe ||
verses.translation: Great is the glorious greatness of the independent Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae dhaan samaahe ||
verses.translation: He Himself created, and gives sustanance to all.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaal dhoor nahee dhaataa miliaa sahaj rajaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord is not far away; the Great Giver spontaneously unites with Himself, by His Will. ||11||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸੋਗੀ ਇਕਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik sogee ik rog viaape ||
verses.translation: Some are sad, and some are afflicted with disease.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aape aape ||
verses.translation: Whatever God does, He does by Himself.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhaau gur kee mat pooree anahadh sabadh lakhaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: Through loving devotion, and the Perfect Teachings of the Guru, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad is realized. ||12||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਭਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik naage bhookhe bhaveh bhavaae ||
verses.translation: Some wander and roam around, hungry and naked.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik haTh kar mareh na keemat paae ||
verses.translation: Some act in stubbornness and die, but do not know the value of God.

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gat avigat kee saar na jaanai boojhai sabadh kamaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: They do not know the difference between good and bad; this is understood only through the practice of the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik teerath naaveh a(n)n na khaaveh ||
verses.translation: Some bathe at sacred shrines and refuse to eat.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik agan jalaaveh dheh khapaaveh ||
verses.translation: Some torment their bodies in burning fire.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee kit bidh paar la(n)ghaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained; how can anyone cross over? ||14||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat chhoddeh ujhaR jaiee ||
verses.translation: Abandoning the Guru's Teachings, some wander in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh raam na japai avaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are destitute; they do not meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: pach pach booddeh kooR kamaaveh kooR kaal bairaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: They are ruined, destroyed and drowned from practicing falsehood; death is the enemy of the false. ||15||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukame aavai hukame jaavai ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they come, and by the Hukam of His Command, they go.

verses.original: ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: boojhai hukam so saach samaavai ||
verses.translation: One who realizes His Hukam, merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak saach milai man bhaavai gurmukh kaar kamaiee he ||16||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he merges in the True Lord, and his mind is pleased with the Lord. The Gurmukhs do His work. ||16||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin aape aap upai pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: He evaluates those whom He Himself has created.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape satigur aape sevak aape sirasaT upaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself created the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape neRai naahee dhoore ||
verses.translation: He is near at hand, not far away.

verses.original: ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: boojheh gurmukh se jan poore ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs understand Him; perfect are those humble beings.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee sa(n)gat ahinis laahaa gur sa(n)gat eh vaddaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: Associating with them night and day is profitable. This is the glorious greatness of associating with the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug sa(n)t bhale prabh tere ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, Your Saints are holy and sublime, O God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaaveh rasan rasere ||
verses.translation: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, savoring it with their tongues.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ausatat kareh parahar dhukh dhaaladh jin naahee chi(n)t paraiee he ||3||
verses.translation: They chant His Praises, and their pain and poverty are taken away; they are not afraid of anyone else. ||3||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi jaagat raheh na soote dheeseh ||
verses.translation: They remain awake and aware, and do not appear to sleep.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat kul taare saach pareeseh ||
verses.translation: They serve up Truth, and so save their companions and relatives.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਓਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kalimal mail naahee te niramal oi raheh bhagat liv laiee he ||4||
verses.translation: They are not stained with the filth of sins; they are immaculate and pure, and remain absorbed in loving devotional worship. ||4||

verses.original: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: boojhahu har jan satigur baanee ||
verses.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, understand the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eh joban saas hai dheh puraanee ||
verses.translation: This youth, breath and body shall pass away.

verses.original: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aaj kaal mar jaieeaai praanee har jap jap ridhai dhiaaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: O mortal, you shall die today or tomorrow; chant, and meditate on the Lord within your heart. ||5||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕੂੜ ਕਬਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhoddahu praanee kooR kabaaRaa ||
verses.translation: O mortal, abandon falsehood and your worthless ways.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਉਛਾਹਾੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kooR maare kaal uchhaahaaRaa ||
verses.translation: Death viciously kills the false beings.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saakat kooR pacheh man haumai dhuh maarag pachai pachaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic is ruined through falsehood and his egotistical mind.On the path of duality, he rots away and decomposes. ||6||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿਹੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chhoddih ni(n)dhaa taat paraiee ||
verses.translation: Abandon slander and envy of others.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR dhajheh saat na aaiee ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying, they burn, and do not find tranquility.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat naam salaahahu aatam raam sakhaiee he ||7||
