verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall be your helper and companion. ||7||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: chhoddahu kaam karodh buriaaiee ||
verses.translation: Abandon sexual desire, anger and wickedness.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਲੰਪਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai dha(n)dh chhoddahu la(n)paTaiee ||
verses.translation: Abandon your involvement in egotistical affairs and conflicts.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹੁ ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: satigur saran parahu taa ubarahu iau tareeaai bhavajal bhaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: If you seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, then you shall be saved. In this way you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aagai bimal nadhee agan bikh jhelaa ||
verses.translation: In the hereafter, you shall have to cross over the fiery river of poisonous flames.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tithai avar na koiee jeeau ikelaa ||
verses.translation: No one else will be there; your soul shall be all alone.

verses.original: ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bhaR bhaR agan saagar dhe laharee paR dhajheh manmukh taiee he ||9||
verses.translation: The ocean of fire spits out waves of searing flames; the self-willed manmukhs fall into it, and are roasted there. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur peh mukat dhaan dhe bhaanai ||
verses.translation: Liberation comes from the Guru; He grants this blessing by the Pleasure of His Will.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin paiaa soiee bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows the way, who obtains it.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jin paiaa tin poochhahu bhaiee sukh satigur sev kamaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: So ask one who has obtained it, O Siblings of Destiny. Serve the True Guru, and find peace. ||10||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰਝਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬੇਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin urajh mareh bekaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, he dies entangled in sin and corruption.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jam sir maare kare khuaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death smashes his head and humiliates him.

verses.original: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: baadhe mukat naahee nar ni(n)dhak ddoobeh ni(n)dh paraiee he ||11||
verses.translation: The slanderous person is not freed of his bonds; he is drowned, slandering others. ||11||

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu saach pachhaanahu a(n)dhar ||
verses.translation: So speak the Truth, and realize the Lord deep within.

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੰਦਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhoor naahee dhekhahu kar na(n)dhar ||
verses.translation: He is not far away; look, and see Him.

verses.original: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: bighan naahee gurmukh tar taaree iau bhavajal paar la(n)ghaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: No obstacles shall block your way; become Gurmukh, and cross over to the other side. This is the way to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee a(n)dhar naam nivaasee ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the body.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa hai abinaasee ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord is eternal and imperishable.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naa jeeau marai na maariaa jaiee kar dhekhai sabadh rajaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: The soul does not die, and it cannot be killed; God creates and watches over all. Through the Word of the Shabad, His Will is manifest. ||13||

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh niramal hai naahee a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is immaculate, and has no darkness.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh aape takhat bahai sachiaaraa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself sits upon His throne.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: saakat kooRe ba(n)dh bhavaie'eeh mar janameh aaiee jaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged, and forced to wander in reincarnation. They die, and are reborn, and continue coming and going. ||14||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke sevak satigur piaare ||
verses.translation: The Guru's servants are the Beloveds of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi baiseh takhat su sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, they sit upon His throne.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: tat laheh a(n)taragat jaaneh satasa(n)gat saach vaddaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: They realize the essence of reality, and know the state of their inner being. This is the true glorious greatness of those who join the Sat Sangat. ||15||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਪਿਤਰਾ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap tarai jan pitaraa taare ||
verses.translation: He Himself saves His humble servant, and saves his ancestors as well.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat mukat su paar utaare ||
verses.translation: His companions are liberated; He carries them across.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak tis kaa laalaa golaa jin gurmukh har liv laiee he ||16||6||
verses.translation: Nanak is the servant and slave of that Gurmukh who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Lord. ||16||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤੇ ਗੁਬਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kete jug varate gubaarai ||
verses.translation: For many ages, only darkness prevailed;

verses.original: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: taaRee laiee apar apaarai ||
verses.translation: the infinite, endless Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

verses.original: ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhu(n)dhookaar niraalam baiThaa naa tadh dha(n)dh pasaaraa he ||1||
verses.translation: He sat alone and unaffected in absolute darkness; the world of conflict did not exist. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jug chhateeh tinai varataae ||
verses.translation: Thirty-six ages passed like this.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tis bhaanaa tivai chalaae ||
verses.translation: He causes all to happen by the Pleasure of His Will.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tiseh sareek na dheesai koiee aape apar apaaraa he ||2||
verses.translation: No rival of His can be seen. He Himself is infinite and endless. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੇ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਤੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gupate boojhahu jug chatuaare ||
verses.translation: God is hidden throughout the four ages - understand this well.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT varatai udhar majhaare ||
verses.translation: He pervades each and every heart, and is contained within the belly.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jug jug ekaa ekee varatai koiee boojhai gur veechaaraa he ||3||
verses.translation: The One and Only Lord prevails throughout the ages. How rare are those who contemplate the Guru, and understand this. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਕਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dh rakat mil pi(n)dd sareeaa ||
verses.translation: From the union of the sperm and the egg, the body was formed.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee aganee mil jeeaa ||
verses.translation: From the union of air, water and fire, the living being is made.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape choj kare ra(n)g mahalee hor maiaa moh pasaaraa he ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself plays joyfully in the mansion of the body; all the rest is just attachment to Maya's expanse. ||4||

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: garabh ku(n)ddal meh uradh dhiaanee ||
verses.translation: Within the mother's womb, upside-down, the mortal meditated on God.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saas saas sach naam samaale a(n)tar udhar majhaaraa he ||5||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, he contemplated the True Name, deep within himself, within the womb. ||5||
